name: BrauerChallenge.FDRep.character_eq_sum_induced_linear
statement:
theorem character_eq_sum_induced_linear
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (ns : ι → ℤ)
      (Hs : ι → Subgroup G)
      (ψs : ∀ i, Hs i →* kˣ),
      (∀ i, IsBrauerElementary (Hs i)) ∧
      V.character =
          ∑ i, ns i •
            (FDRep.indLin (k := k) (G := G) (Hs i) (ψs i)).character
proof:
:= by
  rcases BrauerInduction.character_eq_sum_induced_linear (k := k) (G := G) V with
    ⟨ι, hι, ns, Hs, ψs, hElem, hsum⟩
  refine ⟨ι, hι, ns, Hs, ψs, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rcases hElem i with ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩
    dsimp [BrauerInduction.IsPElementary] at hpe
    rcases hpe with ⟨E⟩
    refine ⟨p, hp, ⟨?_⟩⟩
    exact
    { C := E.C
      P := E.P
      C_isCyclic := E.C_isCyclic
      C_isPRegular := by
        intro c hc
        simpa [BrauerChallenge.IsPRegular, _root_.IsPRegular] using E.C_isPRegular hc
      P_isPGroup := E.P_isPGroup
      comm := E.comm
      decompose := E.decompose }
  · trans
      ∑ i, ns i •
        (_root_.FDRep.indLin (k := k) (G := G) (Hs i) (ψs i)).character
    · exact hsum
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [_root_.FDRep.indLin_eq_of_rep_ind]
      rfl

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerLinGen.inducedCharacter_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma inducedCharacter_apply
    (i : BrauerLinGen k G) (g : G) :
    BrauerLinGen.inducedCharacter i g
      =
    (FDRep.indLin i.H i.ψ).character g
proof: := rfl

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanLin.exists_decomposition
statement:
theorem BrauerSpanLin.exists_decomposition
    {χ : ClassFun k G}
    (hχ : χ ∈ BrauerSpanLin) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (ns : ι → ℤ) (Hs : ι → Subgroup G)
      (ψs : ∀ i, Hs i →* kˣ),
      (∀ i, IsBrauerElementary (Hs i)) ∧
      χ = ∑ i, (ns i) • ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin (Hs i) (ψs i))
proof:
:= by
  let P : ClassFun k G → Prop :=
    fun φ =>
      ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι)
        (ns : ι → ℤ) (Hs : ι → Subgroup G)
        (ψs : ∀ i, Hs i →* kˣ),
        (∀ i,  IsBrauerElementary (Hs i)) ∧
        φ = ∑ i, (ns i) • ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin (Hs i) (ψs i))
  have hP : P χ := by
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun φ _ => P φ) ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hχ
    · intro φ hφ
      rcases hφ with ⟨i, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨PUnit, inferInstance,
        (fun _ => (1 : ℤ)), (fun _ => i.H), (fun _ => i.ψ), (fun _ => i.hElem), ?_⟩
      ext g
      simp [BrauerLinGen.inducedCharacter]
    · refine
        ⟨Empty, inferInstance, isEmptyElim, isEmptyElim, isEmptyElim, isEmptyElim, ?_⟩
      simp only [Finset.univ_eq_empty, zsmul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_empty]
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      rcases hx with ⟨ιx, _, nsx, Hsx, ψsx, hHx, rfl⟩
      rcases hy with ⟨ιy, _, nsy, Hsy, ψsy, hHy, rfl⟩
      refine
        ⟨Sum ιx ιy,
         inferInstance,
         Sum.elim nsx nsy,
         Sum.elim Hsx Hsy,
         (fun i => match i with | Sum.inl j => ψsx j | Sum.inr j => ψsy j),
         (fun i => match i with | Sum.inl j => hHx j | Sum.inr j => hHy j),
         ?_⟩
      simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr]
    · intro n x _ hx
      rcases hx with ⟨ιx, _, nsx, Hsx, ψsx, hHx, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨ιx, inferInstance, (fun i => n * nsx i), Hsx, ψsx, hHx, ?_⟩
      rw [Finset.smul_sum]
      simp_rw [mul_smul]
  exact hP

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.le_BrauerSpanLin
statement:
theorem BrauerSpanChar.le_BrauerSpanLin [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k] :
    BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G) ≤ BrauerSpanLin
proof:
:= by
  rw [BrauerSpanChar, InducedCharacterSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro φ ⟨H, hH_elem, V, rfl⟩
  haveI : Group.IsNilpotent H := hH_elem.isNilpotent
  haveI:  NeZero ↑(Nat.card ↥H) := ⟨One.natCard_ne_zero_of_finite H⟩
  have h_decomp : ClassFun.character V ∈
      Submodule.span ℤ { ψ | ∃ (S : FDRep k H)
    (_ : CategoryTheory.Simple S), ψ = ClassFun.character S } := by
    apply ClassFun.character_mem_span_irreducibles
  let P := fun (χ : ClassFun k H) =>
      ClassFun.ind H χ ∈ BrauerSpanLin
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun χ _ => P χ)
      ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul h_decomp
  · rintro σ ⟨S, hS_simple, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨K, ψ_lin, ⟨h_iso⟩⟩ :=
      FDRep.exists_indLin_of_nilpotent_simple (ρ := S)
    have h_char_eq :
        ClassFun.character S =
          ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin K ψ_lin) :=
      ClassFun.char_eq_of_iso h_iso
    rw [h_char_eq]
    letI : DecidablePred fun x : G => x ∈ H := Classical.decPred _
    letI: Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
    letI : Fintype H := H.instFintypeSubtypeMemOfDecidablePred
    rw [ClassFun.character_indLin (G := H) K ψ_lin]
    unfold P
    let K_G : Subgroup G := K.map H.subtype
    let eK : K ≃* K_G :=
      K.equivMapOfInjective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
    let ψ_lin_G : K_G →* kˣ :=
      ψ_lin.comp eK.symm.toMonoidHom
    have hK_elem : IsBrauerElementary K :=
      IsBrauerElementary.ofSubgroup hH_elem K
    have hK_G_elem : IsBrauerElementary K_G :=
      IsBrauerElementary.ofMulEquiv hK_elem eK
    have h_trans_direct :
    ClassFun.ind H
      (ClassFun.ind K
        (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin)))
      =
    ClassFun.ind K_G
      ((ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv eK).symm
        (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin))) := by
      simpa [K_G, eK] using
        (ClassFun.ind_trans (K := H) (H := K)
          (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin)))
    rw [h_trans_direct]
    have h_char_lin_G :
        (ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv eK).symm
            (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin))
          =
        ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin_G) := by
      ext x
      rfl
    have h_indLin_G :
        ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin K_G ψ_lin_G)
          =
        ClassFun.ind K_G
          ((ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv eK).symm
            (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin))) := by
      calc
        ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin K_G ψ_lin_G)
            =
          ClassFun.ind K_G
            (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin_G)) := by
              change
                ClassFun.character
                  (FDRep.ind K_G
                    (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin_G))
                  =
                ClassFun.ind K_G
                  (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin_G))
              exact
                ClassFun.char_ind K_G (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin_G)
        _ =
          ClassFun.ind K_G
            ((ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv eK).symm
              (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ_lin))) := by
                rw [h_char_lin_G]
    rw [← h_indLin_G]
    exact Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨{ H := K_G, hElem := hK_G_elem, ψ := ψ_lin_G }, rfl⟩
  · dsimp [P]
    rw [ClassFun.ind_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    dsimp [P]
    rw [ClassFun.ind_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro n x _ hx
    dsimp [P]
    rw [ClassFun.ind_zsmul n]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.inducedCharacter_mem
statement:
lemma inducedCharacter_mem
    {P : Subgroup G → Prop}
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hH : P H)
    (V : FDRep k H) :
    ClassFun.ind H (ClassFun.character V) ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨H, hH, V, rfl⟩

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.mono
statement:
lemma mono
    {P Q : Subgroup G → Prop}
    (hPQ : ∀ H, P H → Q H) :
    InducedCharacterSpan (k := k) P ≤ InducedCharacterSpan Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [InducedCharacterSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨H, hH, V, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨H, hPQ H hH, V, rfl⟩

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.le_characterSpan
statement:
lemma le_characterSpan
    (P : Subgroup G → Prop) :
    InducedCharacterSpan (k := k) P ≤ ClassFun.characterSpan k G
proof:
:= by
  rw [InducedCharacterSpan, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro _ ⟨H, _, V, rfl⟩
  rw [ClassFun.ind_ofChar]
  exact ClassFun.characterSpan.character_mem (FDRep.ind H V)

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.character_mul_mem
statement:
lemma character_mul_mem
    (P : Subgroup G → Prop)
    (V : FDRep k G)
    {φ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P) :
    ClassFun.character V * φ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun θ _ =>
      ClassFun.character V * θ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hφ
  · rintro θ ⟨H, hH, W, rfl⟩
    rw [ClassFun.projection_formula
      H (ClassFun.character V) (ClassFun.character W)]
    rw [ClassFun.res_ofChar (H := H) V]
    rw [← ClassFun.char_tensor]
    exact inducedCharacter_mem
      H hH (FDRep.tensor (FDRep.res V H) W)
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [mul_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro n x _ hx
    have hcomm :
        ClassFun.character V * (n • x) =
          n • (ClassFun.character V * x) := by
      ext g
      simp only [ClassFun.mul_apply, ClassFun.zsmul_apply]
      rw [mul_smul_comm n]
    rw [hcomm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.characterSpan_mul_mem
statement:
lemma characterSpan_mul_mem
    (P : Subgroup G → Prop)
    {φ ψ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ ClassFun.characterSpan k G)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P) :
    φ * ψ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P
proof:
:= by
  change
    φ ∈ Submodule.span ℤ (ClassFun.characterSet k G)
    at hφ
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun θ _ => θ * ψ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hφ
  · rintro _ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    exact character_mul_mem P V hψ
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [add_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro n x _ hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.mul_mem
statement:
lemma mul_mem
    (P : Subgroup G → Prop)
    {φ ψ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P) :
    φ * ψ ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P
proof:
:=
  characterSpan_mul_mem P (le_characterSpan P hφ) hψ

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterSpan.induction_mem
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ =>
      ClassFun.ind H f ∈ InducedCharacterSpan Q)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hψ

  · rintro f ⟨K, hK, W, rfl⟩
    let K_G : Subgroup G := K.map H.subtype
    let eK : K ≃* K_G :=
      K.equivMapOfInjective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
    let W_G : FDRep k K_G := FDRep.transport eK W
    have h_transport_char :
        ClassFun.character W_G =
          (ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv eK).symm
            (ClassFun.character W) := by
      ext x
      rfl
    rw [ClassFun.ind_trans (K := H) (H := K) (ClassFun.character W)]
    rw [← h_transport_char]
    exact inducedCharacter_mem (P := Q) K_G (hmap K hK) W_G
  · rw [ClassFun.ind_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [ClassFun.ind_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro n x _ hx
    rw [ClassFun.ind_zsmul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterIdeal.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    (P : Subgroup G → Prop)
    (φ : ClassFun.CharacterRing k G) :
    φ ∈ InducedCharacterIdeal P ↔
      (φ : ClassFun k G) ∈ InducedCharacterSpan P
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: BrauerInduction.InducedCharacterIdeal.mono
statement:
lemma mono
    {P Q : Subgroup G → Prop}
    (hPQ : ∀ H, P H → Q H) :
    InducedCharacterIdeal P ≤ InducedCharacterIdeal (k := k) Q
proof:
:= by
  intro φ hφ
  exact InducedCharacterSpan.mono hPQ hφ

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerIdeal.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    (φ : ClassFun.CharacterRing k G) :
    φ ∈ BrauerIdeal ↔ (φ : ClassFun k G) ∈ BrauerSpanChar
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.le_characterSpan
statement:
lemma le_characterSpan :
    BrauerSpanChar ≤ ClassFun.characterSpan k G
proof:
:=
  InducedCharacterSpan.le_characterSpan
    (fun H => IsBrauerElementary H)

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.characterSpan_mul_mem
statement:
lemma characterSpan_mul_mem
    {φ ψ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ ClassFun.characterSpan k G)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ BrauerSpanChar) :
    φ * ψ ∈ BrauerSpanChar
proof:
:=
  InducedCharacterSpan.characterSpan_mul_mem
    (fun H => IsBrauerElementary H) hφ hψ

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.character_mul_mem
statement:
lemma character_mul_mem
    (V : FDRep k G)
    {φ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ BrauerSpanChar) :
    ClassFun.character V * φ ∈ BrauerSpanChar
proof:
:=
  characterSpan_mul_mem
    (ClassFun.characterSpan.character_mem V) hφ

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.mul_mem
statement:
lemma mul_mem
    {φ ψ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ BrauerSpanChar)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ BrauerSpanChar) :
    φ * ψ ∈ BrauerSpanChar
proof:
:=
  characterSpan_mul_mem (le_characterSpan hφ) hψ

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.induction_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply InducedCharacterSpan.induction_mem
    (P := fun K : Subgroup H => IsBrauerElementary K)
    (Q := fun K : Subgroup G => IsBrauerElementary K)
    ?_ hψ
  intro K hK
  exact IsBrauerElementary.ofMulEquiv
    hK (K.equivMapOfInjective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective)

name: BrauerInduction.BrauerSpanChar.character_mem_of_isBrauerElementary
statement:
theorem character_mem_of_isBrauerElementary
    (hG : IsBrauerElementary G)
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character V ∈ BrauerSpanChar
proof:
:= by
  have htop : IsBrauerElementary (⊤ : Subgroup G) :=
      IsBrauerElementary.ofMulEquiv hG Subgroup.topEquiv.symm
  have hgen :
      ClassFun.ind ⊤
        (ClassFun.character (FDRep.res V ⊤)) ∈ BrauerSpanChar := by
    apply Submodule.subset_span
    exact ⟨⊤, htop, FDRep.res V (⊤ : Subgroup G), rfl⟩
  let e : FDRep.ind ⊤ (FDRep.res V ⊤) ≅ V :=
    FDRep.indTopIsoOfTop (FDRep.res V ⊤) ≪≫ FDRep.ofTop_res_top_iso V
  have hchar :
      ClassFun.ind (⊤ : Subgroup G)
          (ClassFun.character (FDRep.res V ⊤))
        =
      ClassFun.character V := by
    rw [ClassFun.ind_ofChar]
    exact ClassFun.char_eq_of_iso e
  rw [hchar] at hgen
  exact hgen

name: BrauerInduction.character_eq_sum_induced_linear_classFun
statement:
theorem character_eq_sum_induced_linear_classFun
    {G k : Type u}
    [Group G] [Finite G]
    [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (ns : ι → ℤ) (Hs : ι → Subgroup G)
      (ψs : ∀ i, Hs i →* kˣ),
      (∀ i, IsBrauerElementary (Hs i)) ∧
      ClassFun.character V =
        ∑ i, ns i •
          ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin (Hs i) (ψs i))
proof:
:= by
  have h1 :
      (1 : ClassFun k G) ∈ BrauerSpanChar := by
    simpa using
      (Bernstein.one_mem_BrauerIdeal (k := k) (G := G))
  have hV :
      ClassFun.character V ∈ BrauerSpanChar := by
    simpa [mul_one] using
      BrauerSpanChar.character_mul_mem V h1
  exact
    BrauerSpanLin.exists_decomposition
      (BrauerSpanChar.le_BrauerSpanLin hV)

name: BrauerInduction.character_eq_sum_induced_linear
statement:
theorem character_eq_sum_induced_linear
    {G k : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (ns : ι → ℤ) (Hs : ι → Subgroup G)
      (ψs : ∀ i, Hs i →* kˣ),
      (∀ i, IsBrauerElementary (Hs i)) ∧
      V.character =
        ∑ i, ns i •
          (FDRep.indLin (Hs i) (ψs i)).character
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ι, hι, ns, Hs, ψs, hElem, hsum⟩ :=
    character_eq_sum_induced_linear_classFun V
  refine ⟨ι, hι, ns, Hs, ψs, hElem, ?_⟩
  ext g
  simpa [ClassFun.char_apply, ClassFun.sum_apply, ClassFun.smul_apply] using
    congrArg (fun F : ClassFun k G => F g) hsum

name: BrauerInduction.virtualCharacterSubmodule_eq_BrauerSpanLin
statement:
theorem virtualCharacterSubmodule_eq_BrauerSpanLin
    {G k : Type u}
    [Group G] [Finite G]
    [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    ClassFun.virtualCharacterSubmodule k G =
      BrauerSpanLin (k := k) (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rw [ClassFun.virtualCharacterSubmodule, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro χ ⟨S, _, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨ι, hι, ns, Hs, ψs, hElem, hsum⟩ :=
      character_eq_sum_induced_linear_classFun S
    rw [hsum]
    exact Submodule.sum_mem _ fun i _ =>
      Submodule.smul_mem _ (ns i)
        (Submodule.subset_span
          ⟨{ H := Hs i, hElem := hElem i, ψ := ψs i }, rfl⟩)
  · haveI : NeZero (Nat.card G : k) :=
      ⟨One.natCast_natCard_ne_zero_of_finite G k⟩
    rw [BrauerSpanLin, Submodule.span_le]
    rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
    rw [ClassFun.virtualCharacterSubmodule]
    simpa [BrauerLinGen.inducedCharacter] using
      (ClassFun.character_mem_span_irreducibles
        (FDRep.indLin i.H i.ψ))

name: LinearMap.trace_pi_diag
statement:
lemma LinearMap.trace_pi_diag (f : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[k] V i) :
    LinearMap.trace k ((i : ι) → V i)
        (LinearMap.pi fun i => f i ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj i)
      =
    ∑ i, LinearMap.trace k (V i) (f i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set M' := LinearMap.pi (fun i => f i ∘ₗ LinearMap.proj i)
  convert LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace k
    (Pi.basis fun i => Module.Free.chooseBasis k (V i)) M' using 1
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ =>
    LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace k
      (Module.Free.chooseBasis k (V i)) (f i)]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_apply,
    Pi.basis_apply, Pi.basis_repr]
  rw [Finset.sum_sigma']
  simp_all only [Finset.univ_sigma_univ, pi_apply, coe_comp, coe_proj, Function.comp_apply,
    Function.eval, Pi.single_eq_same, M']

name: conj_lmap_eq
statement:
private lemma conj_lmap_eq (f : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[k] V i) :
    (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype k ι V).conj (DirectSum.lmap f) =
    LinearMap.pi (fun i =>
      (f i).comp (LinearMap.proj i))
proof:
:= by
  exact (Module.dualMap_dualMap_eq_iff k ((i : ι) → V i)).mp rfl

name: DirectSum.trace_lmap
statement:
lemma DirectSum.trace_lmap (f : ∀ i, V i →ₗ[k] V i) :
    LinearMap.trace k (⨁ i, V i) (DirectSum.lmap f)
      = ∑ i, LinearMap.trace k (V i) (f i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← LinearMap.trace_conj' (DirectSum.lmap f) (DirectSum.linearEquivFunOnFintype k ι V)]
  rw [conj_lmap_eq]
  exact LinearMap.trace_pi_diag f

name: Representation.character_def
statement:
lemma character_def (ρ : Representation k G V) (g : G) :
  character ρ g = LinearMap.trace k V (ρ g)
proof: := rfl

name: Representation.char_equiv
statement:
lemma char_equiv
    {ρ : Representation k G V} {σ : Representation k G W}
     (h : Representation.Equiv ρ σ) (g : G) :
    ρ.character g = σ.character g
proof:
:= by
  simp only [character]
  have h_conj : h.toLinearEquiv.conj (ρ g) = σ g := by
    ext v
    change h (ρ g (h.symm v)) = σ g v
    have h' := LinearMap.congr_fun (h.isIntertwining' g) (h.symm v)
    simpa using h'
  rw [← h_conj]
  exact Eq.symm (LinearMap.trace_conj' (ρ g) h.toLinearEquiv)

name: Representation.char_prod
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_prod [Module.Finite k V] [Module.Finite k W]
  (ρ : Representation k G V) (σ : Representation k G W) :
    (ρ.prod σ).character = ρ.character + σ.character
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  dsimp[Representation.prod]
  exact LinearMap.trace_prodMap' (ρ g) (σ g)

name: Representation.char_directSum
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_directSum (ρ : (i : ι) → Representation k G (V i)) (g : G) :
    (Representation.directSum ρ).character g = ∑ i, (ρ i).character g
proof:
:= by
  dsimp[character]
  exact DirectSum.trace_lmap fun x ↦ (ρ x) g

name: Representation.ofMulAction_trace
statement:
lemma ofMulAction_trace
    {X : Type*} [Finite X] [MulAction G X] (g : G) :
    LinearMap.trace k (MonoidAlgebra k X)
        (Representation.ofMulAction k G X g)
      =
    (Nat.card {x : X // g • x = x} : k)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype X := Fintype.ofFinite X
  let b : Module.Basis X k (MonoidAlgebra k X) :=
    (Finsupp.basisSingleOne (R := k) (ι := X)).map
      (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).symm
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace k b]
  rw [Matrix.trace]
  trans ∑ x : X, if g • x = x then (1 : k) else 0
  · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    change
      (LinearMap.toMatrix b b
        (Representation.ofMulAction k G X g)) x x
        =
      if g • x = x then 1 else 0
    rw [LinearMap.toMatrix_apply]
    dsimp [b]
    simp [Finsupp.single_apply]
  · rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Finset.sum_boole]

name: Representation.average_char_eq_finrank_invariants
statement:
theorem average_char_eq_finrank_invariants
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    [Fintype G] [CharZero k]
    {V : Type w}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module k V] [Module.Finite k V]
    (ρ : Representation k G V) :
    ((Fintype.card G : k)⁻¹) *
        (∑ g : G, ρ.character g)
      =
    (Module.finrank k ρ.invariants : k)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Invertible (Fintype.card G : k) :=
    invertibleOfNonzero (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero)
  have h := ρ.isProj_averageMap.trace
  rw [← h]
  change
    (Fintype.card G : k)⁻¹ *
        ∑ g : G, (LinearMap.trace k V) (ρ g)
      =
    (LinearMap.trace k V) ρ.averageMap
  rw [Representation.averageMap, GroupAlgebra.average]
  simp only [
    MonoidAlgebra.of_apply,
    map_smul,
    map_sum,
    Representation.asAlgebraHom_single,
    one_smul,
    smul_eq_mul,
    invOf_eq_inv
  ]

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_apply_mul_pSingular_not_dvd
statement:
lemma f_apply_mul_pSingular_not_dvd
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (s : G) (hs : IsPSingular p s)
    (hcomm : Commute a s) :
    ∃ n : ℤ,
      PElementary.f (k := k) p a (a * s) = (n : k) ∧
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  let C : Subgroup G :=
    centralizer ({a} : Set G)
  let H : Subgroup C :=
    PElementary.P_in_Z p a
  let sC : C :=
    ⟨s, by
      simpa [C, Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff] using hcomm.eq⟩

  have hsC : IsPSingular p sC := by
    dsimp [IsPSingular] at hs ⊢
    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hs
    refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
    have hord : orderOf sC = orderOf s :=
      (Subgroup.orderOf_coe sC).symm
    rw [hord]
    exact hr

  have hmod :
      Nat.card {c : C ⧸ H // sC • c = c} ≡
        Nat.card (C ⧸ H) [MOD p] :=
    PElementary.card_fixedPoints_pSingular_modEq H sC hsC

  letI : Fintype C := Fintype.ofFinite C
  letI : Fintype H := Fintype.ofFinite H
  letI : Fintype (PElementary.P_of_Z p a) :=
    Fintype.ofFinite (PElementary.P_of_Z p a)

  have hHcard :
      Fintype.card (PElementary.P_of_Z p a) =
        Fintype.card H := by
    symm
    apply Fintype.card_congr
    exact
      (Subgroup.equivMapOfInjective
        _ _ Subtype.coe_injective).toEquiv

  have hquotient :
      Nat.card (C ⧸ H) = PElementary.index p a := by
    unfold PElementary.index
    rw [Subgroup.card_eq_card_quotient_mul_card_subgroup H]
    simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    rw [hHcard, Nat.mul_div_cancel]
    exact Fintype.card_pos

  have hquotient_not_dvd :
      ¬ p ∣ Nat.card (C ⧸ H) := by
    rw [hquotient]
    simpa [PElementary.index] using
      PElementary.p_not_dvd_cardCentralizer_div_cardP
        (p := p) a

  have heval :
      PElementary.f (k := k) p a (a * s) =
        (Nat.card {c : C ⧸ H // sC • c = c} : k) := by
    simpa [C, H, sC] using
      f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_card_fixedCosets
        (k := k) p ha s hs hcomm

  refine
    ⟨(Nat.card {c : C ⧸ H // sC • c = c} : ℤ),
      ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using heval
  · intro hfixed_dvd

    have hquotient_not_dvd_int :
        ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ (Nat.card (C ⧸ H) : ℤ) := by
      simpa only [Int.ofNat_dvd] using hquotient_not_dvd

    apply hquotient_not_dvd_int

    have hdiff :
        (p : ℤ) ∣
          (Nat.card (C ⧸ H) : ℤ) -
            (Nat.card {c : C ⧸ H // sC • c = c} : ℤ) := by
      apply Int.ModEq.dvd
      exact Int.natCast_modEq_iff.mpr hmod

    have hsum :=
      dvd_add hdiff hfixed_dvd

    simpa using hsum

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_apply_not_dvd_of_isConj_pRegular
statement:
lemma f_apply_not_dvd_of_isConj_pRegular
    {a g : G}
    (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (hconj : IsConj a (Group.pRegular p g)) :
    ∃ n : ℤ,
      PElementary.f (k := k) p a g = (n : k) ∧
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  let r := Group.pRegular p g
  let s := Group.pSingular p g

  have hgfin : IsOfFinOrder g :=
    isOfFinOrder_of_finite g

  have hdecomp : g = r * s :=
    (Group.pDecomp' p hgfin).symm

  have hs : IsPSingular p s :=
    Group.isPSingular_pSingular p g

  have hrs : Commute r s :=
    Group.pRegular_pSingular_commute p rfl

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
    isConj_iff.mp hconj

  have hx' : r = x * a * x⁻¹ := by
    simpa [r] using hx.symm

  let s' := x⁻¹ * s * x

  have hs' : IsPSingular p s' := by
    dsimp [s']
    exact IsPSingular.conj' p hs x

  have hs'_comm : Commute a s' := by
    have ha_eq :
        a = x⁻¹ * r * x := by
      calc
        a = x⁻¹ * (x * a * x⁻¹) * x := by group
        _ = x⁻¹ * r * x := by rw [hx]

    rw [ha_eq]
    dsimp [s']

    calc
      (x⁻¹ * r * x) * (x⁻¹ * s * x)
          =
        x⁻¹ * (r * s) * x := by group
      _ =
        x⁻¹ * (s * r) * x := by rw [hrs.eq]
      _ =
        (x⁻¹ * s * x) * (x⁻¹ * r * x) := by group

  have hg_conj :
      IsConj g (a * s') := by
    rw [isConj_iff]
    refine ⟨x⁻¹, ?_⟩
    simp only [inv_inv]
    rw [hdecomp, hx']
    dsimp [s']
    group

  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn_not_dvd⟩ :=
    f_apply_mul_pSingular_not_dvd
      (k := k) p ha s' hs' hs'_comm

  refine ⟨n, ?_, hn_not_dvd⟩

  calc
    PElementary.f (k := k) p a g
        =
      PElementary.f (k := k) p a (a * s') :=
        ClassFun.apply_eq_apply_of_isConj hg_conj
    _ = (n : k) := hn

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.localSum_apply_not_dvd
statement:
lemma localSum_apply_not_dvd
    (g : G) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, PElementary.localSum p g = (n : k) ∧ ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  let r := Group.pRegular p g

  have hr : IsPRegular p r :=
    Group.isPRegular_pRegular p
      (isOfFinOrder_of_finite g)

  obtain ⟨C, hC, hC_unique⟩ :=
    PRegularClass.unique_of_isPRegular p r hr

  obtain ⟨n, hn, hn_not_dvd⟩ :=
    f_apply_not_dvd_of_isConj_pRegular
      (k := k) p
      (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C)
      hC

  refine ⟨n, ?_, hn_not_dvd⟩

  calc
    PElementary.localSum (k := k) p g
        =
      PElementary.f (k := k) p C.repr g := by
        classical
        simp only [
          PElementary.localSum,
          ClassFun.sum_apply
        ]
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single C]
        · intro D _ hDC
          apply PElementary.f_apply_eq_zero_of_not_isConj
          intro h
          exact hDC (hC_unique D h.symm)
        · intro hC_not_mem
          exact (hC_not_mem (Finset.mem_univ C)).elim
    _ = (n : k) := hn

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.localSum_mem_J
statement:
lemma localSum_mem_J [IsAlgClosed k] :
    PElementary.localSum p ∈ J (k := k) (G := G) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold PElementary.localSum
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro C _
  exact
    f_a_mem_J (k := k) p C.repr
      (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.localSumElement_mem_JIdeal
statement:
lemma localSumElement_mem_JIdeal [IsAlgClosed k] :
    PElementary.localSumElement (k := k) (G := G) p ∈ JIdeal p
proof:
:= by
  change
    PElementary.localSum (k := k) p ∈ J p
  exact localSum_mem_J p

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.JIdeal.le_JGlobalIdeal
statement:
lemma JIdeal.le_JGlobalIdeal
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] :
    JIdeal (k := k) (G := G) p ≤ JGlobalIdeal
proof:
:= by
  exact le_iSup_of_le p
    (le_iSup_of_le (inferInstance : Fact p.Prime) le_rfl)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.JIdeal.mem_JGlobalLattice_of_mem
statement:
lemma mem_JGlobalLattice_of_mem
    {f : ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing (k := k) (G := G)}
    (hf : f ∈ JGlobalIdeal) :
    ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.toIntegerValuedClassFun f ∈
      JGlobalLattice (k := k) (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨f, hf, rfl⟩

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.JIdeal.one_mem_JGlobalLattice
statement:
theorem one_mem_JGlobalLattice [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    (1 : ClassFun.IntegerValued (k := k) (G := G)) ∈ JGlobalLattice
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.mem_of_forall_primePow_congr
  intro p hp N
  letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  let F := localSumPower (k := k) (G := G) p N
  let d : ClassFun.IntegerValued :=
    ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.toIntegerValuedClassFun (F - 1)
  have hn :
      (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ)) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast pow_ne_zero N hp.ne_zero
  have hdvd :
      ∀ g : G,
        (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ)) ∣
          ClassFun.IntegerValuedClassFun.intLift d g := by
    intro g
    apply
      localSumPower_sub_one_values_dvd (k := k) (G := G) p N g
    exact
      ClassFun.IntegerValuedClassFun.intValue_spec d g
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ :=
    ClassFun.IntegerValuedClassFun.exists_zsmul_eq_of_intLift_dvd (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ)) hn d hdvd
  refine ⟨-y, ?_⟩
  have hF :
      ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.toIntegerValuedClassFun F ∈ JGlobalLattice := by
    apply mem_JGlobalLattice_of_mem
    apply JIdeal.le_JGlobalIdeal p
    exact localSumPower_mem_JIdeal p N
  have heq :
      (1 : ClassFun.IntegerValued) - (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • (-y)) =
        ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.toIntegerValuedClassFun F := by
    let ι :=
      ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.toIntegerValuedClassFun (k := k) (G := G)
    calc
      1 - (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • (-y))
        = 1 + (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • y) := by rw [smul_neg, sub_neg_eq_add]
      _ = 1 + d := congrArg (fun z => 1 + z) hy
      _ = ι 1 + ι (F - 1) := congrArg₂ (· + ·) ι.map_one.symm rfl
      _ = ι (1 + (F - 1)) := (ι.map_add 1 (F - 1)).symm
      _ = ι F := congrArg ι (by abel)
  rw [heq]
  exact hF

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.one_mem_JGlobalIdeal
statement:
theorem one_mem_JGlobalIdeal [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    (1 : ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing
        (k := k) (G := G)) ∈ JGlobalIdeal
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    JIdeal.one_mem_JGlobalLattice (k := k) (G := G)
  rcases h with ⟨f, hf, hfone⟩
  have hf_eq_one :
      f = (1 : ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing ) := by
    apply
      ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.toIntegerValuedClassFun_injective
    simpa using hfone
  change f ∈ JGlobalIdeal  at hf
  simpa [hf_eq_one] using hf

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_sum
statement:
lemma f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_sum
    [CharZero k] [Fintype G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) (s : G) (hs_sing : IsPSingular p s) (h_comm : Commute a s) :
    f (k := k) (p := p) a (a * s) =
    (Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) : k)⁻¹ *
      ((Finset.univ.filter
          (fun x => x ∈ centralizer ({a} : Set G) ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a)).card : k)  *
      (orderOf a : k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold f
  rw [ClassFun.ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum_mul_inv]
  simp only [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  dsimp [phi]
  have hfa := isOfFinOrder_of_finite a
  have hfs := isOfFinOrder_of_finite s
  have h_sum :
      (∑ x : G, if h : x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a
                then if Group.pRegular p (x * (a * s) * x⁻¹) = a
                then (orderOf a : k) else 0 else 0) =
      ∑ x ∈ Finset.univ.filter
        (fun x => x ∈ centralizer ({a} : Set G) ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a), (orderOf a : k) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_filter]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x _
    have h_reg :
        Group.pRegular p (x * (a * s) * x⁻¹) = x * a * x⁻¹ := by
      rw [Group.pRegular_conj]
      have h_au : Group.pRegular p (a * s) = a := by
        rw [Group.pRegular_mul_eq_left_of_right_pSingular_commute p hfs hfa hs_sing h_comm.symm]
        exact Group.pRegular_eq_self_of_isPRegular p hfa ha
      rw [h_au]
    by_cases hxC : x ∈ centralizer ({a} : Set G)
    · have hax : x * a * x⁻¹ = a := by
        rw [mem_centralizer_iff] at hxC
        have h_comm_xa : x * a = a * x := by exact Eq.symm (SemiconjBy.eq (hxC a rfl))
        calc x * a * x⁻¹ = a * x * x⁻¹ := by rw [h_comm_xa]
          _ = a := by group
      have h_reg_eq_a : Group.pRegular p (x * (a * s) * x⁻¹) = a := by rw [h_reg, hax]
      have h_xaux : x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ = a * (x * s * x⁻¹) := by
        calc x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ = (x * a * x⁻¹) * (x * s * x⁻¹) := by group
          _ = a * (x * s * x⁻¹) := by rw [hax]
      have h_E_iff : x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a ↔ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a := by
        rw [h_xaux]
        constructor
        · intro h_in_E
          have ha_inv_in : a⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a :=
              (E_subgroup p a).inv_mem (mem_sup_left (mem_zpowers a))
          have h_mul := (E_subgroup p a).mul_mem ha_inv_in h_in_E
          have h_cancel : a⁻¹ * (a * (x * s * x⁻¹)) = x * s * x⁻¹ := by group
          rw [h_cancel] at h_mul
          let h_elem := associatedSubgroup ha
          have h_sing : IsPSingular p (x * s * x⁻¹) := (IsPSingular.isConj p hs_sing) (by simp)
          let z : E_subgroup p a := ⟨x * s * x⁻¹, h_mul⟩
          have hz_sing : IsPSingular p z := by
              simpa [z] using
                (IsPSingular.subtype_iff
                  (p := p)
                  (H := E_subgroup p a)
                  (x := z)).1 h_sing
          have hz_mem_P : z ∈ h_elem.P := by exact (mem_P_iff_pSingular h_elem).mpr hz_sing
          exact mem_carrier.mp hz_mem_P
        · intro h_in_P
          have h_P_in_E : x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a := mem_sup_right h_in_P
          have h_a_in_E : a ∈ E_subgroup p a := mem_sup_left (mem_zpowers a)
          exact (E_subgroup p a).mul_mem h_a_in_E h_P_in_E
      by_cases hP : x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a
      · have hE : x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a := h_E_iff.mpr hP
        rw [dif_pos hE, if_pos h_reg_eq_a]
        simp [hxC, hP]
      · have hnE : x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ ∉ E_subgroup p a := fun h => hP (h_E_iff.mp h)
        rw [dif_neg hnE]
        simp [hP]
    · have h_reg_ne_a : Group.pRegular p (x * (a * s) * x⁻¹) ≠ a := by
        intro h_eq
        rw [h_reg] at h_eq
        apply hxC
        rw [mem_centralizer_iff]
        intro y hy
        rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
        subst hy
        have h_xa : x * y = y * x := by
          calc x * y = x * y * x⁻¹ * x := by group
            _ = y * x := by rw [h_eq]
        exact Eq.symm h_xa
      by_cases hE : x * (a * s) * x⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a
      · rw [dif_pos hE, if_neg h_reg_ne_a]
        simp [hxC]
      · rw [dif_neg hE]
        simp [hxC]
  rw [h_sum, Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_assoc]

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_card_fixedCosets
statement:
lemma f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_card_fixedCosets
    [CharZero k] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) (s : G) (hs_sing : IsPSingular p s) (h_comm : Commute a s) :
    f (k := k) p a (a * s) =
    (Nat.card { c : ↥(centralizer ({a} : Set G)) ⧸ (P_in_Z p a : Subgroup _) //
      (⟨s, fun y hy => by rcases hy with rfl; exact h_comm.eq⟩ :
        ↥(centralizer ({a} : Set G))) • c = c } : k)
proof:
:= by
  letI: Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
  rw [f_apply_mul_pSingular_eq_sum p ha s hs_sing h_comm]
  let Z_group := centralizer ({a} : Set G)
  let P_Z : Subgroup Z_group := P_in_Z p a
  let s_Z : Z_group := ⟨s, fun y hy => by rcases hy with rfl; exact h_comm.eq⟩
  have h_set_card :
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun x : G => x ∈ Z_group ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a)).card =
      Nat.card { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a } := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
    exact (Fintype.card_subtype _).symm
  let e_inv :
    { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a } ≃
    { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x⁻¹ * s * x ∈ P_of_Z p a } :=
  { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      have hx := x.property
      refine ⟨Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx.1, ?_⟩
      have : (x.val⁻¹)⁻¹ * s * x.val⁻¹ = x.val * s * x.val⁻¹ := by rw [inv_inv]
      rw [this]
      exact hx.2⟩
    invFun := fun x => ⟨x.val⁻¹, by
      have hx := x.property
      refine ⟨Subgroup.inv_mem _ hx.1, ?_⟩
      have : x.val⁻¹ * s * (x.val⁻¹)⁻¹ = x.val⁻¹ * s * x.val := by rw [inv_inv]
      rw [this]
      exact hx.2⟩
    left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_inv x.val)
    right_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (inv_inv x.val) }
  have h_bij :
    Nat.card { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a } =
    Nat.card { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x⁻¹ * s * x ∈ P_of_Z p a } := Nat.card_congr e_inv
  let e_lift :
    { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x⁻¹ * s * x ∈ P_of_Z p a } ≃
    { x : Z_group // x⁻¹ * s_Z * x ∈ P_Z } :=
  { toFun := fun x =>
      let z_x : Z_group := ⟨x.val, x.property.1⟩
      ⟨z_x, by
        have h_mem := x.property.2
        unfold P_of_Z at h_mem
        rw [Subgroup.mem_map] at h_mem
        rcases h_mem with ⟨w, hw_mem, hw_eq⟩
        have h_eq : z_x⁻¹ * s_Z * z_x = w := by
          ext
          exact hw_eq.symm
        rw [h_eq]
        exact hw_mem⟩
    invFun := fun z =>
      ⟨z.val.val, z.val.property, by
        have h_mem := z.property
        unfold P_of_Z
        rw [Subgroup.mem_map]
        use z.val⁻¹ * s_Z * z.val
        exact ⟨h_mem, rfl⟩⟩
    left_inv := fun x => by ext; rfl
    right_inv := fun z => by ext; rfl }
  have h_card_lift :
      Nat.card { x : G // x ∈ Z_group ∧ x⁻¹ * s * x ∈ P_of_Z p a } =
      Nat.card { x : Z_group // x⁻¹ * s_Z * x ∈ P_Z } :=
    Nat.card_congr e_lift
  have h_equiv := conjMemEquiv_fixedPointsProd P_Z s_Z
  have h_card_prod :
      Nat.card { x : Z_group // x⁻¹ * s_Z * x ∈ P_Z } =
      Nat.card ({ c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } × P_Z) := Nat.card_congr h_equiv
  have h_card_final :
      ((Finset.univ.filter (fun x : G => x ∈ Z_group ∧ x * s * x⁻¹ ∈ P_of_Z p a)).card : k) =
      (Nat.card { c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } : k) * (Nat.card P_Z : k) := by
    rw [h_set_card, h_bij, h_card_lift, h_card_prod, Nat.card_prod, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [h_card_final]
  have hE_card :
      Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) =
        orderOf a * Nat.card (P_of_Z p a) := by
    exact E_card (p := p) (G := G) ha
  have hP_card : Nat.card (P_of_Z p a) = Nat.card P_Z := card_P_of_Z_eq_card_P_in_Z a
  have h_kE : (Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) : k) = (orderOf a : k) * (Nat.card P_Z : k) := by
    rw [hE_card, hP_card, Nat.cast_mul]
  have h_ord_ne_zero : (orderOf a : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (orderOf_pos a).ne'
  have h_P_ne_zero : (Nat.card P_Z : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Nat.card_pos.ne'
  rw [h_kE]
  calc ((orderOf a : k) * (Nat.card P_Z : k))⁻¹ *
      ((Nat.card { c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } : k) * (Nat.card P_Z : k)) * (orderOf a : k)
  _ = (orderOf a : k)⁻¹ * (Nat.card P_Z : k)⁻¹ *
      ((Nat.card { c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } : k) *
      (Nat.card P_Z : k)) * (orderOf a : k) := by rw [mul_inv]
  _ = (Nat.card { c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } : k) * ((Nat.card P_Z : k)⁻¹ *
        (Nat.card P_Z : k)) * ((orderOf a : k)⁻¹ * (orderOf a : k)) := by ring
  _ = (Nat.card { c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } : k) * 1 * 1 :=
        by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h_P_ne_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ h_ord_ne_zero]
  _ = (Nat.card { c : Z_group ⧸ P_Z // s_Z • c = c } : k) := by ring

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.ind_mem_J
statement:
lemma ind_mem_J
    (E : Subgroup G) (hE : IsPElementary p E)
    {q : ClassFun k E}
    (hq : q ∈ ClassFun.Q_sys k G E) :
    ClassFun.ind (k := k) E q ∈ J p
proof:
:= by
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨E, hE, q, hq, rfl⟩

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.zero_mem_J
statement:
lemma zero_mem_J :
    (0 : ClassFun k G) ∈ J p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.zero_mem _

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.add_mem_J
statement:
lemma add_mem_J
    {f g : ClassFun k G} (hf : f ∈ J p) (hg : g ∈ J p) :
    f + g ∈ J p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.add_mem _ hf hg

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.zsmul_mem_J
statement:
lemma zsmul_mem_J
    (n : ℤ) {f : ClassFun k G} (hf : f ∈ J p) :
    n • f ∈ J p
proof:
:=
  Submodule.smul_mem _ n hf

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.JGen_mem_Q_sys
statement:
lemma JGen_mem_Q_sys
    {y : ClassFun k G}
    (hy : y ∈ JGen p) :
    ClassFun.res (⊤ : Subgroup G) y
      ∈ ClassFun.Q_sys k G (⊤ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hy with ⟨E, hE, q, hq_Q, rfl⟩
  exact ClassFun.Q_sys.ind_mem (H := E) hq_Q

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.mul_mem_J
statement:
lemma mul_mem_J [Fact p.Prime]
    (f g : ClassFun k G)
    (hf : f ∈ J p)
    (hg : ClassFun.res (⊤ : Subgroup G) g ∈ ClassFun.Q_sys (k := k) (G := G) ⊤) :
    f * g ∈ J p
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun f _ => f * g ∈ J p) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ hf
  · rintro _ ⟨E, hE, q, ⟨hq_Lambda, hq_Z⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨hg_Lambda, hg_Z⟩ := hg
    rw [mul_comm, ClassFun.projection_formula]
    apply Submodule.subset_span (R := ℤ)
    use E, hE, (ClassFun.res E g * q)
    constructor
    · constructor
      · apply ClassFun.R_Lambda.mul_mem
        · exact ClassFun.R_Lambda.res_top_to_subgroup hg_Lambda
        · exact hq_Lambda
      · apply ClassFun.C_Z.mul_mem
        · apply ClassFun.C_Z.res
          intro x
          exact hg_Z ⟨x, Subgroup.mem_top x⟩
        · exact hq_Z
    · rfl
  · simp only [zero_mul, zero_mem]
  · intro x y _ _ hx_mem hy_mem
    rw [add_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx_mem hy_mem
  · intro n x _ hx_mem
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx_mem

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.JIdeal.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    (f : ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing (k := k) (G := G)) :
    f ∈ JIdeal p ↔ (f : ClassFun k G) ∈ J p
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.JIdeal.ind_mem
statement:
lemma ind_mem
    (E : Subgroup G)
    (hE : IsPElementary p E)
    {q : ClassFun k E}
    (hq : q ∈ ClassFun.Q_sys k G E) :
    ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing.ind E hq ∈ JIdeal p
proof:
:=
      ind_mem_J p E hE hq

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.f_a_mem_J
statement:
lemma f_a_mem_J
    [Fact p.Prime] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (a : G) (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    f (k := k) p a ∈ J p
proof:
:=
      ind_mem_J p
        (E_subgroup p a) (E_isPElementary p ha) (phi_mem_Q p a ha)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.nuStar_projects_E
statement:
lemma nuStar_projects_E
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (E : Subgroup G) (hE : IsPElementary p E)
    (q : ClassFun k E)
    (hq : q ∈ ClassFun.Q_sys k G E) :
    ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B (ClassFun.ind E q) ∧
      nuStar B (ClassFun.ind E q) ∈ BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  have h_Q :
      ∃ l : List (FDRep k E × ClassFun.Lambda k G),
        q =
          (l.map fun P =>
            (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum := by
    have hqR : q ∈ ClassFun.R_Lambda k G E := hq.1
    unfold ClassFun.R_Lambda at hqR
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun q _ =>
        ∃ l : List (FDRep k E × ClassFun.Lambda k G),
          q =
            (l.map fun P =>
              (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum)
      ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hqR
    · rintro χ ⟨W, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨[(W, 1)], ?_⟩
      simp
    · refine ⟨[], ?_⟩
      simp
    · intro q₁ q₂ _ _ hq₁ hq₂
      rcases hq₁ with ⟨l₁, rfl⟩
      rcases hq₂ with ⟨l₂, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨l₁ ++ l₂, ?_⟩
      simp [List.map_append, List.sum_append]
    · intro a q _ hq
      rcases hq with ⟨l, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨l.map fun P => (P.1, a * P.2), ?_⟩
      have scale_list :
          ∀ l : List (FDRep k E × ClassFun.Lambda k G),
            a •
                (l.map fun P =>
                  (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum
              =
                ((l.map fun P => (P.1, a * P.2)).map fun P =>
                  (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum := by
        intro l
        induction l with
        | nil =>
            simp
        | cons hd tl ih_tl =>
            simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
            have hhead :
                a • ((hd.2 : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)
                  =
                (((a * hd.2 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1) := by
              change
                (a : k) • ((hd.2 : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)
                  =
                (((a * hd.2 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)
              rw [show ((a * hd.2 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) =
                    (a : k) * (hd.2 : k) by rfl]
              rw [mul_smul]
            calc
              a •
                  (((hd.2 : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)
                    + (tl.map fun P =>
                        (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum)
                  =
                a • ((hd.2 : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)
                  + a •
                    (tl.map fun P =>
                      (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum := by
                    rw [smul_add]
              _ =
                (((a * hd.2 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)
                  +
                (((tl.map fun P => (P.1, a * P.2)).map fun P =>
                    (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum) := by
                    rw [hhead, ih_tl]
      simpa using scale_list l
  rcases h_Q with ⟨l, hl⟩
  let qOf : List (FDRep k E × ClassFun.Lambda k G) → ClassFun k E :=
    fun l => (l.map fun P => (P.2 : k) • ClassFun.character P.1).sum
  have H :
      ∀ l,
        ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B (ClassFun.ind E (qOf l)) ∧
          nuStar B (ClassFun.ind E (qOf l))
            ∈ BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G) := by
    intro l
    induction l with
    | nil =>
        simp only [qOf, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil]
        rw [ClassFun.ind_zero]
        constructor
        · exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.zero B
        · rw [nuStar_zero]
          exact Submodule.zero_mem _
    | cons hd tl ih =>
        simp only [qOf, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
        have h_ind_char :
            ClassFun.ind E (ClassFun.character hd.1)
              =
            ClassFun.character (FDRep.ind E hd.1) := by
          exact (ClassFun.char_ind E hd.1).symm
        have h_first_coords :
            ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B
              (ClassFun.ind E ((hd.2 : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1)) := by
          rw [ClassFun.ind_smul, h_ind_char]
          exact
            ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.smul B
              hd.2.property
              (ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.character B (FDRep.ind E hd.1))
        have h_first_mem :
            nuStar B
              (ClassFun.ind E ((hd.2 : k) • ClassFun.character hd.1))
                ∈ BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G) := by
          rw [ClassFun.ind_smul, h_ind_char]
          rw [nuStar_smul_char B hd.2.property (FDRep.ind E hd.1)]
          let z : ℤ :=
            nu k G ⟨(hd.2 : k), hd.2.property⟩
          have hz :
              nu_ext (k := k) (G := G) (hd.2 : k) = (z : k) := by
            unfold nu_ext
            rw [dif_pos hd.2.property]
          rw [hz, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul]
          have h_gen :
              ClassFun.ind E (ClassFun.character hd.1)
                ∈ BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G) := by
            apply Submodule.subset_span
            have hBrauer : IsBrauerElementary E := by
              exact IsBrauerElementary.ofIsPElementary p hE
            exact ⟨E, hBrauer, hd.1, rfl⟩
          rw [h_ind_char] at h_gen
          exact Submodule.smul_mem _ z h_gen
        rw [ClassFun.ind_add]
        constructor
        · exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.add B h_first_coords ih.1
        · rw [nuStar_add B h_first_coords ih.1]
          exact Submodule.add_mem _ h_first_mem ih.2
  have hq_eq : q = qOf l := by
    simpa [qOf] using hl
  rw [hq_eq]
  exact H l

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.nuStarLinear_maps_JIdeal
statement:
lemma nuStarLinear_maps_JIdeal [IsAlgClosed k]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    {f : ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing (k := k) (G := G)}
    (hf : f ∈ JIdeal (k := k) (G := G) p) :
    nuStarLinear B f ∈ BrauerIdeal
proof:
:= by
  change
    nuStar B (f : ClassFun k G) ∈
      BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G)

  let P : ClassFun k G → Prop :=
    fun x =>
      ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B x ∧
        nuStar B x ∈ BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G)

  have hzero : P 0 := by
    constructor
    · exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.zero B
    · rw [nuStar_zero B]
      exact Submodule.zero_mem _

  have hadd :
      ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y) := by
    intro x y hx hy
    constructor
    · exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.add B hx.1 hy.1
    · rw [nuStar_add B hx.1 hy.1]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx.2 hy.2

  have H : P (f : ClassFun k G) := by
    change (f : ClassFun k G) ∈ J (k := k) (G := G) p at hf
    refine @Submodule.span_induction ℤ (ClassFun k G) _ _ _ _
      (fun y _ => P y) ?_ hzero ?_ ?_
      (f : ClassFun k G) hf
    · rintro _ ⟨E, hE, q, hq, rfl⟩
      exact nuStar_projects_E B p E hE q hq
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      exact hadd x y hx hy
    · intro z x _ hx
      constructor
      · exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.zsmul B z hx.1
      · rw [nuStar_zsmul B z hx.1]
        exact Submodule.smul_mem _ z hx.2

  exact H.2

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.nuStarLinear_maps_JGlobalIdeal
statement:
lemma nuStarLinear_maps_JGlobalIdeal [IsAlgClosed k]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {f : ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing (k := k) (G := G)}
    (hf : f ∈ JGlobalIdeal) :
    nuStarLinear B f ∈ BrauerIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let Q := ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing (k := k) (G := G)

  let P : Q → Prop :=
    fun x => nuStarLinear B x ∈ BrauerIdeal

  have hzero : P 0 := by
    change
      nuStarLinear B 0 ∈ BrauerIdeal
    simpa only [map_zero] using
      (BrauerIdeal (k := k) (G := G)).zero_mem

  have hadd :
      ∀ x y, P x → P y → P (x + y) := by
    intro x y hx hy
    change
      nuStarLinear B (x + y) ∈ BrauerIdeal
    rw [map_add]
    exact
      (BrauerIdeal (k := k) (G := G)).add_mem hx hy

  change P f
  unfold JGlobalIdeal at hf
  refine @Submodule.iSup_induction Q Q _ _ _ ℕ
    (fun p =>
      ⨆ (_ : Fact p.Prime),
        JIdeal (k := k) (G := G) p)
    P f hf ?_ hzero hadd
  intro p x hx
  refine @Submodule.iSup_induction Q Q _ _ _
    (Fact p.Prime)
    (fun _ =>
      JIdeal (k := k) (G := G) p)
    P x hx ?_ hzero hadd
  intro hp y hy
  letI : Fact p.Prime := hp
  exact
    nuStarLinear_maps_JIdeal B p hy

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.one_mem_BrauerIdeal
statement:
theorem one_mem_BrauerIdeal [IsAlgClosed k] :
    (1 : ClassFun.CharacterRing k G) ∈ BrauerIdeal
proof:
:= by
  let B := ClassFun.irrepCharBasis (k := k) (G := G)
  simpa only [nuStarLinear_one] using
    (nuStarLinear_maps_JGlobalIdeal B one_mem_JGlobalIdeal)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.BrauerIdeal.eq_top
statement:
theorem BrauerIdeal.eq_top [IsAlgClosed k] :

proof:
:= by
  rw [Ideal.eq_top_iff_one]
  exact one_mem_BrauerIdeal (k := k) (G := G)

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.localSumPower_mem_JIdeal

    localSumPower (k := k) (G := G) p r ∈ JIdeal p
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSumPower

    apply Nat.totient_pos.mpr
    exact Nat.pos_of_neZero (p ^ r)
  exact

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.localSumPower_sub_one_apply
statement:
lemma localSumPower_sub_one_apply
    [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (g : G) :
    ∃ m : ℤ,
      ((localSumPower (k := k) (G := G) p r - 1 :
          ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing) :
        ClassFun k G) g =
          (m : k) ∧ (((p ^ r : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ m)
proof:
:= by
  refine ClassFun.pow_totient_sub_one_apply_of_not_dvd p r ?_ g
  intro g
  exact localSum_apply_not_dvd p g

name: BrauerInduction.Bernstein.localSumPower_sub_one_values_dvd
statement:
lemma localSumPower_sub_one_values_dvd
    [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    ∀ g : G, ∀ m : ℤ,
      ((localSumPower (k := k) (G := G) p r - 1 :
          ClassFun.IntegralCyclotomicCharacterRing) :
        ClassFun k G) g = (m : k) → (((p ^ r : ℕ) : ℤ) ∣ m)
proof:
:= by
  intro g m hm
  change
    (PElementary.localSum (k := k) p ^ (p ^ r).totient - 1) g = (m : k)
    at hm
  exact
    ClassFun.pow_totient_sub_one_values_dvd_of_not_dvd
      p r (localSum_apply_not_dvd p) g m hm

name: ClassFun.Lambda.smul_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma smul_apply {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    (a : ClassFun.Lambda k G) (f : ClassFun k G) (x : G) :
    (a • f) x = (a : k) * f x
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: ClassFun.Lambda.one_is_primitive
statement:
lemma one_is_primitive
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [Finite G]
    (m : ℤ) (x : Lambda k G) (h : m • x = 1) :
    IsUnit m
proof:
:= by
  haveI: NeZero (Nat.card G) := ⟨One.natCard_ne_zero_of_finite G⟩
  have h_field : (m : k) * (x : k) = 1 := by
    have h_coe := congrArg (fun y : Lambda k G => (y : k)) h
    simp only [Subring.coe_one, zsmul_eq_mul] at h_coe
    exact h_coe

  have hx_int : IsIntegral ℤ (x : k) := by
    have H_le : Lambda k G ≤ (integralClosure ℤ k).toSubring := by
      rw [Lambda, Subring.closure_le]
      rintro _ ⟨u, rfl⟩
      exact rootsOfUnity.isIntegral k G u
    exact H_le x.property

  have hm_neq_zero : (m : k) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    rw [hz, zero_mul] at h_field
    exact zero_ne_one h_field

  have hx_eq : (x : k) = (m : k)⁻¹ := by
    apply eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_left
    simpa [mul_comm] using h_field

  rw [hx_eq] at hx_int

  have h_rat : (m : k)⁻¹ = algebraMap ℚ k ((m : ℚ)⁻¹) := by
    simp only [map_inv₀, map_intCast]

  rw [h_rat] at hx_int

  have h_int_Q : IsIntegral ℤ ((m : ℚ)⁻¹) :=
    (isIntegral_algebraMap_iff (algebraMap ℚ k).injective).mp hx_int

  have h_in_Z : ∃ z : ℤ, algebraMap ℤ ℚ z = (m : ℚ)⁻¹ :=
    IsIntegrallyClosed.isIntegral_iff.mp h_int_Q

  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := h_in_Z

  have hm_Q_neq_zero : (m : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz_Q
    have : (m : k) = 0 := by exact_mod_cast hz_Q
    exact hm_neq_zero this

  have h_zm_Q : (z : ℚ) * (m : ℚ) = 1 := by
    calc
      (z : ℚ) * (m : ℚ)
          = (m : ℚ)⁻¹ * (m : ℚ) := by
              simp only [mul_eq_mul_right_iff, hm_Q_neq_zero]
              rw [← hz]
              simp only [algebraMap_int_eq, eq_intCast, or_false]
      _ = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hm_Q_neq_zero

  have h_zm_Z : z * m = 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast h_zm_Q

  rw [mul_comm] at h_zm_Z
  exact IsUnit.of_mul_eq_one z h_zm_Z

name: ClassFun.Lambda.rootsOfUnity_orderOf_mem_Lambda
statement:
lemma rootsOfUnity_orderOf_mem_Lambda
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [Finite G]
    (a : G) (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k) :
    (((ζ : kˣ) : k)) ∈ Lambda k G
proof:
:= by

  have hdiv : orderOf a ∣ Nat.card G := by
    simpa using orderOf_dvd_natCard a

  rcases hdiv with ⟨m, hm⟩

  let η : rootsOfUnity (Nat.card G) k :=
    ⟨(ζ : kˣ), by
      calc
        ((ζ : kˣ) ^ Nat.card G)
            = ((ζ : kˣ) ^ orderOf a) ^ m := by
                rw [hm, pow_mul]
        _ = 1 := by
                rw [ζ.property, one_pow]⟩

  change (((ζ : kˣ) : k)) ∈
    Subring.closure (Set.range (fun x : rootsOfUnity (Nat.card G) k => ((x.val : kˣ) : k)))

  exact Subring.subset_closure ⟨η, rfl⟩

name: ClassFun.Lambda.linearChar_apply_mem_Lambda
statement:
lemma linearChar_apply_mem_Lambda
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [Finite G]
    (χ : G →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    ((χ g : kˣ) : k) ∈ Lambda k G
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G

  have hg : g ^ Fintype.card G = 1 := by exact pow_card_eq_one

  have hχ_card : χ g ^ Fintype.card G = 1 := by
    calc
      χ g ^ Fintype.card G = χ (g ^ Fintype.card G) := by
        exact (map_pow χ g (Fintype.card G)).symm
      _ = χ 1 := by
        exact congrArg χ hg
      _ = 1 := by
        exact map_one χ

  have hχ : χ g ^ Nat.card G = 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hχ_card

  let η : rootsOfUnity (Nat.card G) k :=
    ⟨χ g, hχ⟩

  change ((χ g : kˣ) : k) ∈
    Subring.closure
      (Set.range
        (fun x : rootsOfUnity (Nat.card G) k => ((x.val : kˣ) : k)))

  exact Subring.subset_closure ⟨η, rfl⟩

name: ClassFun.Lambda.linearChar_subgroup_apply_mem_Lambda
statement:
lemma linearChar_subgroup_apply_mem_Lambda
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k] [Finite G]
    {H : Subgroup G}
    (χ : H →* kˣ) (h : H) :
    ((χ h : kˣ) : k) ∈ Lambda k G
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G

  have hG : (h : G) ^ Fintype.card G = 1 := by
    exact pow_card_eq_one

  have hH : h ^ Fintype.card G = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp

  have hχ_card : χ h ^ Fintype.card G = 1 := by
    calc
      χ h ^ Fintype.card G = χ (h ^ Fintype.card G) := by
        exact (map_pow χ h (Fintype.card G)).symm
      _ = χ 1 := by
        exact congrArg χ hH
      _ = 1 := by
        exact map_one χ

  have hχ : χ h ^ Nat.card G = 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using hχ_card

  let η : rootsOfUnity (Nat.card G) k :=
    ⟨χ h, hχ⟩

  change ((χ h : kˣ) : k) ∈
    Subring.closure
      (Set.range
        (fun x : rootsOfUnity (Nat.card G) k => ((x.val : kˣ) : k)))

  exact Subring.subset_closure ⟨η, rfl⟩

name: ClassFun.Lambda.char_coeffs
statement:
lemma Lambda.char_coeffs
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (U : FDRep k G) (i : B.ι) :
    B.b.repr (ClassFun.character U) i ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ClassFun.char_coeffs_int B U i
  rw [hm]
  have h_smul : (m : k) = m • (1 : k) := by
    exact (zsmul_one m).symm
  rw [h_smul]
  exact Subring.zsmul_mem (ClassFun.Lambda k G) (Subring.one_mem _) m

name: ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.zero
statement:
lemma zero
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G) :
    HasLambdaCoords B 0
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp

name: ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.add
statement:
lemma add
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {f g : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : HasLambdaCoords B f)
    (hg : HasLambdaCoords B g) :
    HasLambdaCoords B (f + g)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  simp only [HasLambdaCoords, map_add, Finsupp.coe_add, Pi.add_apply] at *
  exact add_mem (hf i) (hg i)

name: ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.character
statement:
lemma character [CharZero k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (U : FDRep k G) :
    HasLambdaCoords B (ClassFun.character U)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  exact Lambda.char_coeffs B U i

name: ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.zsmul
statement:
lemma zsmul
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (z : ℤ) {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : HasLambdaCoords B f) :
    HasLambdaCoords B (z • f)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  have h_zsmul_f :
      z • f = (z : k) • f :=
    Eq.symm (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k z f)
  rw [h_zsmul_f, LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  change (z : k) * (B.b.repr f i) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G
  have h_mul_to_zsmul :
      (z : k) * (B.b.repr f i) =
        z • (B.b.repr f i) := by
    exact Eq.symm (zsmul_eq_mul (B.b.repr f i) z)
  rw [h_mul_to_zsmul]
  exact Subring.zsmul_mem (ClassFun.Lambda k G) (hf i) z

name: ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.smul
statement:
lemma smul
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {a : k} (ha : a ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G)
    {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : HasLambdaCoords B f) :
    HasLambdaCoords B (a • f)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  change a * (B.b.repr f i) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G
  exact Subring.mul_mem _ ha (hf i)

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.top_char_mem
statement:
lemma top_char_mem
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character V ∈ R_Lambda.top k G
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨V, rfl⟩

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.top_one_mem
statement:
lemma top_one_mem :
    (1 : ClassFun k G) ∈ R_Lambda.top k G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ClassFun.char_trivial k G]
  exact top_char_mem (FDRep.trivial k G)

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.top_mul_mem
statement:
lemma top_mul_mem
    {f g : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ R_Lambda.top k G)
    (hg : g ∈ R_Lambda.top k G) :
    f * g ∈ R_Lambda.top k G
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ => f * g ∈ R_Lambda.top k G)
    ?gen_f ?zero_f ?add_f ?smul_f hf
  · rintro _ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun g _ =>
        ClassFun.character V * g ∈ R_Lambda.top k G)
      ?gen_g ?zero_g ?add_g ?smul_g hg
    · rintro _ ⟨W, rfl⟩
      rw [← ClassFun.char_tensor]
      exact top_char_mem (FDRep.tensor V W)
    · simp
    · intro x y _ _ hx hy
      rw [mul_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
    · intro a x _ hx
      rw [mul_smul_comm]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [add_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.ind_mem_top
statement:
lemma ind_mem_top
    (H : Subgroup G)
    {q : ClassFun k H}
    (hq : q ∈ R_Lambda k G H) :
    ClassFun.ind H q ∈ R_Lambda.top k G
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun q _ => ClassFun.ind H q ∈ R_Lambda.top k G)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hq
  · rintro _ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    rw [← ClassFun.char_ind]
    exact top_char_mem (FDRep.ind H V)
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [ClassFun.ind_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    change
      ClassFun.ind H (((a : Lambda k G) : k) • x) ∈
        R_Lambda.top k G
    rw [ClassFun.ind_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: ClassFun.CyclotomicCharacterAlgebra.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    {f : ClassFun k G} :
    f ∈ CyclotomicCharacterAlgebra (k := k) (G := G) ↔
      f ∈ R_Lambda.top k G
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ClassFun.CyclotomicCharacterAlgebra.coe_character
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_character
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    (character V : ClassFun k G) = ClassFun.character V
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ClassFun.CyclotomicCharacterAlgebra.character_trivial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma character_trivial :
    character (FDRep.trivial k G) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact ClassFun.char_trivial k G

name: ClassFun.CyclotomicCharacterAlgebra.character_tensor
statement:
@[simp]
lemma character_tensor
    (V W : FDRep k G) :
    character (FDRep.tensor V W) = character V * character W
proof:

  exact ClassFun.char_tensor V W

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.exists_projection_of_primitive
statement:
lemma exists_projection_of_primitive {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module ℤ M]
    [Module.Free ℤ M] [Module.Finite ℤ M]
    (v : M) (h_prim : ∀ (m : ℤ) (x : M), m • x = v → IsUnit m) :
    ∃ ν : M →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ, ν v = 1
proof:
:= by
  let eval_v : (M →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ℤ := {
    toFun := fun f => f v
    map_add' := fun f g => rfl
    map_smul' := fun c f => rfl
  }
  let I := LinearMap.range eval_v
  haveI : Submodule.IsPrincipal I := inferInstance
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ : ∃ d, Submodule.span ℤ {d} = I :=
    ⟨Submodule.IsPrincipal.generator I, Submodule.IsPrincipal.span_singleton_generator I⟩
  let ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex ℤ M
  letI : Fintype ι := Module.Free.ChooseBasisIndex.fintype ℤ M
  let b := Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ M
  have h_coord_in : ∀ i, b.coord i v ∈ I := by
    intro i
    exact LinearMap.mem_range.mpr ⟨b.coord i, rfl⟩
  have h_w : ∀ i, ∃ w_i : ℤ, b.coord i v = d * w_i := by
    intro i
    have h1 := h_coord_in i
    rw [← hd] at h1
    have h2 := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp h1
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h2
    use y
    rw [← hy, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm]
  choose w hw using h_w
  let W_repr : ι →₀ ℤ := ∑ i, Finsupp.single i (w i)
  let W := b.repr.symm W_repr
  have h_W_repr_i : ∀ i, W_repr i = w i := by
    intro i
    have h_eval : W_repr i = ∑ j, (Finsupp.single j (w j)) i := by
      exact Finsupp.finsetSum_apply Finset.univ (fun j => Finsupp.single j (w j)) i
    rw [h_eval]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · exact Finsupp.single_eq_same
    · intro j _ hj
      exact Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hj.symm
    · intro hi
      exact False.elim (hi (Finset.mem_univ i))
  have h_dW : d • W = v := by
    apply b.repr.injective
    ext i
    have h_lhs : b.repr (d • W) i = d * w i := by
      simp only [map_zsmul, Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply,
        Int.zsmul_eq_mul, mul_eq_mul_left_iff]
      rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rw [h_W_repr_i i]
      simp only [true_or]
    rw [h_lhs]
    have h_cw := hw i
    exact h_cw.symm
  have hd_unit : IsUnit d := h_prim d W h_dW
  have h_1_in : (1 : ℤ) ∈ I := by
    rw [← hd, Submodule.mem_span_singleton]
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hd_unit
    use ↑(u⁻¹)
    rw [← hu, smul_eq_mul]
    exact Units.inv_mul u
  obtain ⟨nu_lin, h_nu_one⟩ := LinearMap.mem_range.mp h_1_in
  use nu_lin
  exact h_nu_one

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.exists_projection
statement:
lemma exists_projection
    [Module.Finite ℤ (ClassFun.Lambda k G)] [Module.Free ℤ (ClassFun.Lambda k G)] :
    ∃ ν : (ClassFun.Lambda k G) →+ ℤ, ν 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h_prim : ∀ (m : ℤ) (x : ClassFun.Lambda k G), m • x = 1 → IsUnit m :=
    ClassFun.Lambda.one_is_primitive (G := G) (k:=k)
  obtain ⟨nu_lin, h_nu_one⟩ := exists_projection_of_primitive (1 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) h_prim
  use nu_lin.toAddMonoidHom
  exact h_nu_one

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nu_zero :
    nu k G 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (nu k G).map_zero

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_one
statement: lemma nu_one : nu k G 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  haveI : NeZero (Nat.card G) := ⟨One.natCard_ne_zero_of_finite G⟩
  exact Classical.choose_spec (exists_projection)

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_ext_one
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nu_ext_one :
    nu_ext k G 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : k) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G := Subring.one_mem _
  unfold nu_ext
  rw [dif_pos h1]
  change ((nu k G) (1 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) = 1
  rw [nu_one, Int.cast_one]

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_ext_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nu_ext_zero :
    nu_ext k G 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : (0 : k) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G := Subring.zero_mem _
  unfold nu_ext
  rw [dif_pos h0]
  change ((nu k G) (0 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) = 0
  rw [nu_zero, Int.cast_zero]

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_ext_add
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nu_ext_add
    {x y : k} (hx : x ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G) (hy : y ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G) :
    nu_ext k G (x + y) = nu_ext k G x + nu_ext k G y
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : x + y ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G := Subring.add_mem _ hx hy
  unfold nu_ext
  rw [dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy, dif_pos hxy]
  have h_add := map_add (nu k G) ⟨x, hx⟩ ⟨y, hy⟩
  change (nu k G ⟨x + y, hxy⟩ : k) = (nu k G ⟨x, hx⟩ : k) + (nu k G ⟨y, hy⟩ : k)
  rw [← Int.cast_add]
  congr 1

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_ext_int_mul
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nu_ext_int_mul
    {x : k} (hx : x ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G) (z : ℤ) :
    nu_ext k G ((z : k) * x) = (z : k) * nu_ext k G x
proof:
:= by
  have hzx : (z : k) * x ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G := by
    have h_smul : (z : k) * x = z • x := by exact Eq.symm (zsmul_eq_mul x z)
    rw [h_smul]
    exact zsmul_mem hx z
  unfold nu_ext
  rw [dif_pos hx, dif_pos hzx]
  have h_eq : (⟨(z : k) * x, hzx⟩ : ClassFun.Lambda k G) = z • ⟨x, hx⟩ := by
    ext
    exact Eq.symm (zsmul_eq_mul x z)
  rw [h_eq, map_zsmul]
  simp only [Int.zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_mul]

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nu_ext_int
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nu_ext_int
    (z : ℤ) : nu_ext k G (z : k) = (z : k)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (z : k) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G := by
    have h_smul : (z : k) = z • (1 : k) := by
      calc (z : k) = (z : k) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
           _ = z • (1 : k) := by exact Eq.symm (zsmul_eq_mul (1 : k) z)
    rw [h_smul]
    exact zsmul_mem (Subring.one_mem _) z
  unfold nu_ext
  rw [dif_pos hz]
  have h_eq : (⟨(z : k), hz⟩ : ClassFun.Lambda k G) = z • (1 : ClassFun.Lambda k G) := by
    ext
    calc (z : k) = (z : k) * 1 := (mul_one _).symm
         _ = z • (1 : k) := by exact Eq.symm (zsmul_eq_mul (1 : k) z)
  rw [h_eq, map_zsmul, nu_one (G:=G) (k:=k)]
  simp only [Int.zsmul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_basis
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nuStar_basis [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G) (i : B.ι) :
    nuStar B (B.b i) = B.b i
proof:
:= by
  unfold nuStar
  simp

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.repr_nuStar_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma repr_nuStar_apply [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G) (f : ClassFun k G) (i : B.ι) :
    B.b.repr (nuStar B f) i =
      nu_ext (k := k) (G := G) (B.b.repr f i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold nuStar
  simp

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_char_basis
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nuStar_char_basis [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G) (i : B.ι) :
    nuStar B (ClassFun.character (B.V i)) =
      ClassFun.character (B.V i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← B.b_eq i]
  simp

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_zero
statement:
@[simp]
lemma nuStar_zero [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G) :
    nuStar B 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply B.b.repr.injective
  ext i
  simp

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_add
statement:
lemma nuStar_add [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {f g : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B f)
    (hg : ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B g) :
    nuStar B (f + g) = nuStar B f + nuStar B g
proof:
:= by
  apply B.b.repr.injective
  ext i
  rw [repr_nuStar_apply]
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_add]
  change
    nu_ext (k := k) (G := G) ((B.b.repr f) i + (B.b.repr g) i)
      =
    (B.b.repr (nuStar B f + nuStar B g)) i
  rw [nu_ext_add (hf i) (hg i)]
  simp

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_smul_char
statement:
lemma nuStar_smul_char [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {a : k} (ha : a ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G)
    (U : FDRep k G) :
    nuStar B (a • ClassFun.character U) =
      nu_ext (k := k) (G := G) a • ClassFun.character U
proof:
:= by
  apply B.b.repr.injective
  ext i
  rw [repr_nuStar_apply]
  have hcoord :
      B.b.repr (a • ClassFun.character U) i =
        a * B.b.repr (ClassFun.character U) i := by
    rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    rfl
  rw [hcoord]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ClassFun.char_coeffs_int B U i
  rw [hm]
  have hmul : a * (m : k) = (m : k) * a := by ring
  rw [hmul]
  rw [nu_ext_int_mul (k := k) (G := G) ha m]
  rw [LinearEquiv.map_smul]
  simp only [Finsupp.coe_smul, Pi.smul_apply, hm, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_zsmul
statement:
lemma nuStar_zsmul [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (z : ℤ) {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B f) :
    nuStar B (z • f) = z • nuStar B f
proof:
:= by
  apply B.b.repr.injective
  ext i
  rw [repr_nuStar_apply]
  have hcoord :
      B.b.repr (z • f) i = (z : k) * (B.b.repr f i) := by
    have hz :
        z • f = (z : k) • f :=
      Eq.symm (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k z f)
    rw [hz, LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    rfl
  rw [hcoord]
  rw [nu_ext_int_mul (k := k) (G := G) (hf i) z]
  have hcoord_rhs :
      B.b.repr (z • nuStar B f) i =
        z • (B.b.repr (nuStar B f) i) := by
    have hz :
        z • nuStar B f = (z : k) • nuStar B f :=
      Eq.symm (Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul k z (nuStar B f))
    rw [hz, LinearEquiv.map_smul]
    change (z : k) * (B.b.repr (nuStar B f) i) =
      z • (B.b.repr (nuStar B f) i)
    exact Eq.symm (zsmul_eq_mul (B.b.repr (nuStar B f) i) z)
  rw [hcoord_rhs, repr_nuStar_apply, zsmul_eq_mul]

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_fixes_char
statement:
lemma nuStar_fixes_char [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    (U : FDRep k G) :
    nuStar B (ClassFun.character U) = ClassFun.character U
proof:
:= by
  apply B.b.repr.injective
  ext i
  rw [repr_nuStar_apply]
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := ClassFun.char_coeffs_int B U i
  rw [hm]
  simp

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_one
statement:
lemma nuStar_one [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G) :
    nuStar B (1 : ClassFun k G) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have htriv :
      ClassFun.character (FDRep.trivial k G) = (1 : ClassFun k G) :=
    ClassFun.char_trivial (k := k) (G := G)
  rw [← htriv]
  exact nuStar_fixes_char B (FDRep.trivial k G)

name: BrauerInduction.Cyclotomic.nuStar_mem_characterSpan
statement:
lemma nuStar_mem_characterSpan [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B f) :
    nuStar B f ∈ ClassFun.characterSpan k G
proof:
:= by
  have hexpand :
      nuStar B f =
        ∑ i : B.ι, (B.b.repr (nuStar B f) i) • B.b i := by
    simp only [Module.Basis.sum_repr]
  rw [hexpand]
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro i _
  rw [repr_nuStar_apply]
  let z : ℤ := nu k G ⟨B.b.repr f i, hf i⟩
  have hz :
      nu_ext (k := k) (G := G) (B.b.repr f i) = (z : k) := by
    unfold nu_ext
    rw [dif_pos (hf i)]
  rw [hz, Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul, B.b_eq]
  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ z
    (ClassFun.characterSpan.character_mem (B.V i))

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.char_mem
statement:
lemma char_mem
    (H : Subgroup G) (V : FDRep k H) :
    ClassFun.character V ∈ R_Lambda k G H
proof:
:= by
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨V, rfl⟩

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.ind_mem
statement:
lemma ind_mem
    (H : Subgroup G)
    {q : ClassFun k H}
    (hq : q ∈ R_Lambda k G H) :
    ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) (⊤ : Subgroup G)
      (ClassFun.ind (G := G) (k := k) H q)
      ∈ R_Lambda k G (⊤ : Subgroup G)
proof:
:= by

  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun q _ =>
      ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) (⊤ : Subgroup G)
        (ClassFun.ind (G := G) (k := k) H q)
        ∈ R_Lambda k G (⊤ : Subgroup G))
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hq

  · rintro χ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    rw [← ClassFun.char_ind]
    rw [ClassFun.res_ofChar]
    exact Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨FDRep.res (k := k) (G := G)
          (FDRep.ind (k := k) (G := G) H V)
          (⊤ : Subgroup G),
        rfl⟩

  · simp only [ClassFun.ind_zero, ClassFun.res_zero, zero_mem]

  · intro x y hx hy ihx ihy
    rw [ClassFun.ind_add, ClassFun.res_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ ihx ihy

  · intro a x hx ihx
    change
      ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) (⊤ : Subgroup G)
        (ClassFun.ind (G := G) (k := k) H
          (((a : Lambda k G) : k) • x))
        ∈ R_Lambda k G (⊤ : Subgroup G)

    rw [ClassFun.ind_smul (H := H) ((a : Lambda k G) : k) x]

    rw [ClassFun.res_smul
      (K := (⊤ : Subgroup G))
      ((a : Lambda k G) : k)
      (ClassFun.ind (G := G) (k := k) H x)]

    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a ihx

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.comp_inclusion_mem
statement:
lemma comp_inclusion_mem
    {H K : Subgroup G} (hHK : H ≤ K)
    (φ : ClassFun k K)
    (hφ : φ ∈ R_Lambda k G K) :
    φ.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hHK)
      ∈ R_Lambda k G H
proof:
:= by

  dsimp [R_Lambda] at hφ ⊢

  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (s := {χ : ClassFun k K |
      ∃ V : FDRep k K, χ = ClassFun.character V})
    (p := fun x _ =>
      x.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hHK)
        ∈ Submodule.span (Lambda k G)
          {χ : ClassFun k H |
            ∃ W : FDRep k H, χ = ClassFun.character W})
    ?mem ?zero ?add ?smul hφ

  · intro ψ hψ
    rcases hψ with ⟨V, rfl⟩

    apply Submodule.subset_span

    let HK : Subgroup K := H.subgroupOf K

    let W₀ : FDRep k HK :=
      FDRep.res (k := k) (G := K) V HK

    let e : HK ≃* H :=
      Subgroup.subgroupOfEquiv (H := H) (K := K) hHK

    let W : FDRep k H :=
      FDRep.transport e W₀

    refine ⟨W, ?_⟩
    ext h
    simp only [ClassFun.comp_apply, ClassFun.char_apply]
    rw [FDRep.char_transport]
    simp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rfl

  · simp

  · intro x y hx hy hx' hy'
    simpa using Submodule.add_mem _ hx' hy'

  · intro a x hx hx'
    have h_smul :
        (a • x).comp (Subgroup.inclusion hHK)
          =
        a • x.comp (Subgroup.inclusion hHK) := by
      ext h
      rfl
    rw [h_smul]
    simpa using Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx'

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.res_top_to_subgroup
statement:
lemma res_top_to_subgroup
     {E : Subgroup G} {g : ClassFun k G}
    (hg :
      ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) (⊤ : Subgroup G) g
        ∈ R_Lambda k G (⊤ : Subgroup G)) :
    ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) E g
      ∈ R_Lambda k G E
proof:
:= by

  have h_le : E ≤ (⊤ : Subgroup G) := by
    intro x hx
    exact Subgroup.mem_top x

  have h_comp :=
    comp_inclusion_mem
      (G := G) (k := k)
      h_le
      (ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) (⊤ : Subgroup G) g)
      hg

  exact (Submodule.mem_toAddSubgroup (R_Lambda k G E)).mp h_comp

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.mul_mem
statement:
lemma mul_mem
    {k : Type u} [Field k] {H : Subgroup G} {f g : ClassFun k H}
    (hf : f ∈ R_Lambda k G H)
    (hg : g ∈ R_Lambda k G H) :
    f * g ∈ R_Lambda k G H
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ => f * g ∈ R_Lambda k G H)
    ?gen_f ?zero_f ?add_f ?smul_f hf
  · rintro _ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    refine Submodule.span_induction
      (p := fun g _ => ClassFun.character V * g ∈ R_Lambda k G H)
      ?gen_g ?zero_g ?add_g ?smul_g hg
    · rintro _ ⟨W, rfl⟩
      rw [(ClassFun.char_tensor V W).symm]
      exact Submodule.subset_span
        ⟨FDRep.tensor V W, rfl⟩
    · simp
    · intro y₁ y₂ _ _ hy₁ hy₂
      rw [mul_add]
      exact Submodule.add_mem _ hy₁ hy₂
    · intro c y _ hy
      have h_comm :
          ClassFun.character V * (c • y)
            =
          c • (ClassFun.character V * y) := by
        ext z
        change
          ClassFun.character V z * ((c : k) * y z)
            =
          (c : k) * (ClassFun.character V z * y z)
        ring
      rw [h_comm]
      exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hy
  · simp
  · intro x₁ x₂ _ _ hx₁ hx₂
    rw [add_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx₁ hx₂
  · intro c x _ hx
    have h_assoc :
        (c • x) * g = c • (x * g) := by
      ext z
      change
        ((c : k) * x z) * g z
          =
        (c : k) * (x z * g z)
      ring
    rw [h_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c hx

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.top_res_to_subgroup
statement:
lemma top_res_to_subgroup
    (H : Subgroup G)
    {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ R_Lambda.top k G) :
    ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) H f ∈ R_Lambda k G H
proof:
:= by

  unfold R_Lambda.top at hf
  unfold R_Lambda

  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ =>
      ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) H f ∈
        Submodule.span (Lambda k G)
          {χ : ClassFun k H |
            ∃ V : FDRep k H, χ = ClassFun.character V})
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hf

  · rintro χ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    rw [ClassFun.res_ofChar]
    exact Submodule.subset_span
      ⟨FDRep.res (k := k) (G := G) V H, rfl⟩

  · rw [ClassFun.res_zero]
    exact Submodule.zero_mem _

  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [ClassFun.res_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy

  · intro a x _ hx
    change
      ClassFun.res (G := G) (k := k) H ((a : k) • x) ∈
        Submodule.span (Lambda k G)
          {χ : ClassFun k H |
            ∃ V : FDRep k H, χ = ClassFun.character V}
    rw [ClassFun.res_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: ClassFun.R_Lambda.top_hasLambdaCoords
statement:
lemma top_hasLambdaCoords
    {k G : Type u}
    [Field k] [CharZero k]
    [Group G] [Finite G]
    (B : ClassFun.IrrepCharBasis k G)
    {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ ClassFun.R_Lambda.top k G) :
    ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B f
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ => ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B f)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hf
  · rintro _ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.character B V
  · exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.zero B
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.add B hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    change ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords B ((a : k) • x)
    exact ClassFun.HasLambdaCoords.smul B a.property hx

statement:
