name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.f_apply_eq_zero_of_not_isConj
statement:
lemma f_apply_eq_zero_of_not_isConj [Finite G]
    (a x : G)
    (hx : ¬ IsConj (Group.pRegular p x) a) :
    f (k := k) p a x = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold f
  rw [ClassFun.ind_apply]

  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro q hq

  by_cases hE : q.out⁻¹ * x * q.out ∈ E_subgroup p a
  · have hne :
        Group.pRegular p (q.out⁻¹ * x * q.out) ≠ a := by
      intro hpreg_eq
      apply hx
      have hpreg_conj :
          Group.pRegular p (q.out⁻¹ * x * q.out)
            =
          q.out⁻¹ * Group.pRegular p x * q.out := by
        simp only [Group.pRegular_conj']
      have hconj_eq :
          q.out⁻¹ * Group.pRegular p x * q.out = a := by
        rw [← hpreg_conj]
        exact hpreg_eq
      rw [isConj_iff]
      refine ⟨q.out⁻¹, ?_⟩
      rw [inv_inv]
      exact hconj_eq
    simp only [hE, ↓reduceDIte, phi, ClassFun.coe_mk, hne, ↓reduceIte]

  · simp [hE]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.conj_inv_mem_E_and_phi_nonzero_iff
statement:
lemma conj_inv_mem_E_and_phi_nonzero_iff [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) (x : G) :
    (x⁻¹ * a * x ∈ E_subgroup p a ∧
        Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x) = a)
      ↔ x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ({a} : Set G)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hxE, hreg⟩
    have hf : IsOfFinOrder a := isOfFinOrder_of_finite a
    have hpreg_conj :
        Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x)
          =
        x⁻¹ * Group.pRegular p a * x := by
      simp only [Group.pRegular_conj']
    have hpreg_a :
        Group.pRegular p a = a :=
      Group.pRegular_eq_self_of_isPRegular p hf ha

    have hx_conj_a :
        x⁻¹ * a * x = a := by
      calc
        x⁻¹ * a * x
          = x⁻¹ * Group.pRegular p a * x := by rw [hpreg_a]
        _ = Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x) := by rw [hpreg_conj]
        _ = a := hreg
    rw [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff]
    intro y hy
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    · calc
        a * x
          = x * (x⁻¹ * a * x) := by group
        _ = x * a := by rw [hx_conj_a]
  · intro hxC
    have h_comm : x * a = a * x := by
      exact Eq.symm (SemiconjBy.eq (hxC a rfl))
    have h_eq : x⁻¹ * a * x = a := by
      calc
        x⁻¹ * a * x = x⁻¹ * (a * x) := by group
        _ = x⁻¹ * (x * a) := by rw [← h_comm]
        _ = a := by group
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_eq]
      apply Subgroup.mem_sup_left
      exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers a
    · rw [h_eq]
      exact Group.pRegular_eq_self_of_isPRegular p (isOfFinOrder_of_finite a) ha

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.f_apply_a_closed_form
statement:
lemma f_apply_a_closed_form
    [CharZero k] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    f (k := k) p a a
      =
    (Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) : k)⁻¹
      * (Nat.card (Subgroup.centralizer ({a} : Set G)) : k)
      * (orderOf a : k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI: Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
  unfold f
  rw [ClassFun.ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum]
  dsimp [phi]

  have h_integrand :
      (fun x : G =>
        if hx : x⁻¹ * a * x ∈ E_subgroup p a then
          if Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x) = a
          then (orderOf a : k)
          else 0
        else 0)
      =
      (fun x : G =>
        if x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ({a} : Set G)
        then (orderOf a : k)
        else 0) := by
    ext x
    by_cases hxC : x ∈ Subgroup.centralizer ({a} : Set G)
    · have hxBoth :
          x⁻¹ * a * x ∈ E_subgroup p a ∧
            Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x) = a :=
        (conj_inv_mem_E_and_phi_nonzero_iff
          p ha x).mpr hxC
      rcases hxBoth with ⟨hxE, hreg⟩
      rw [dif_pos hxE, if_pos hreg, if_pos hxC]
    · have hxNotBoth :
          ¬ (x⁻¹ * a * x ∈ E_subgroup p a ∧
              Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x) = a) :=
        mt (conj_inv_mem_E_and_phi_nonzero_iff
          p ha x).mp hxC

      by_cases hxE : x⁻¹ * a * x ∈ E_subgroup p a
      · have hreg_not :
            Group.pRegular p (x⁻¹ * a * x) ≠ a := by
          intro hreg
          exact hxNotBoth ⟨hxE, hreg⟩
        rw [dif_pos hxE, if_neg hreg_not, if_neg hxC]
      · rw [dif_neg hxE, if_neg hxC]

  have hsum :=
    congrArg
      (fun F : G → k =>
        (Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) : k)⁻¹ * ∑ x : G, F x)
      h_integrand
  rw [hsum]

  rw [Subgroup.sum_ite_mem_centralizer_mul]
  ring_nf

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.f_apply_a_eq_index
statement:
lemma f_apply_a_eq_index
    [CharZero k] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    f p a a = (index p a : k)
proof:
:= by
  rw [f_apply_a_closed_form p ha]
  have hE_card : Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) = orderOf a * Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) := E_card p ha
  have hC_card : Nat.card (centralizer ({a} : Set G)) =
      index p a * Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) := by
    have h_dvd : Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) ∣ Nat.card (centralizer ({a} : Set G)) := by
      rw [card_P_of_Z_eq_card_P_in_Z a]
      exact card_subgroup_dvd_card (P_in_Z p a : Subgroup (centralizer ({a} : Set G)))
    rw [index, Nat.div_mul_cancel h_dvd]
  have h_kE : (Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) : k) =
      (orderOf a : k) * (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k) := by
    rw [hE_card, Nat.cast_mul]
  have h_kC : (Nat.card (centralizer ({a} : Set G)) : k)
      = (index  p a : k) * (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k) := by
    rw [hC_card, Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [h_kE, h_kC]
  have h_ord_ne_zero : (orderOf a : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (orderOf_pos a).ne'
  have h_P_ne_zero : (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Nat.card_pos.ne'
  calc ((orderOf a : k) * (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k))⁻¹ * ((index p a : k) *
          (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k)) * (orderOf a : k)
    _ = (orderOf a : k)⁻¹ * (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k)⁻¹ * ((index p a : k) *
          (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k)) * (orderOf a : k) := by rw [mul_inv]
    _ = (index p a : k) * ((Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k)⁻¹ * (Nat.card (P_of_Z  p a) : k))
          * ((orderOf a : k)⁻¹ * (orderOf a : k)) := by ring
    _ = (index p a : k) * 1 * 1 :=
        by rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ h_P_ne_zero, inv_mul_cancel₀ h_ord_ne_zero]
    _ = (index p a : k) :=
        by ring

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.f_apply_self_coprime
statement:
lemma f_apply_self_coprime
    [CharZero k] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    ∃ n : ℤ,
      f (k := k) p a a = (n : k) ∧
        ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  let n : ℕ := index p a
  refine ⟨(n : ℤ), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [f_apply_a_eq_index (k := k) p ha]
    simp [n]
  · rw [Int.ofNat_dvd]
    simpa [n, index] using
      p_not_dvd_cardCentralizer_div_cardP (p := p) (x := a)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.cycExp_spec
statement:
lemma cycExp_spec {a : G} (x : PElementary.Cyc a) :
    a ^ cycExp x = (x : G)
proof:
:=
  Classical.choose_spec (Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp x.property)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.chiCyc_apply_generator
statement:
lemma chiCyc_apply_generator
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    {a : G}
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k) :
    (chiCyc ζ) (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) = ζ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [chiCyc, MonoidHom.coe_mk, OneHom.coe_mk]
  have h_cyc : a ^ cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) = a :=
    cycExp_spec (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a)
  have h_an_one :
      a ^ (cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) - 1) = 1 := by
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, zpow_add, h_cyc, zpow_neg_one, mul_inv_cancel]
  have h_dvd :
      (orderOf a : ℤ) ∣
        cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) - 1 :=
    orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one.mpr h_an_one
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := h_dvd
  have h_exp :
      cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) =
        1 + (orderOf a : ℤ) * m := by
    calc
      cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a)
          = 1 + (cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) - 1) := by
              ring
      _ = 1 + (orderOf a : ℤ) * m := by rw [hm]
  calc
    (ζ : kˣ) ^ cycExp (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a)
        = (ζ : kˣ) ^ (1 + (orderOf a : ℤ) * m) := by
            rw [h_exp]
    _ = (ζ : kˣ) ^ (1 : ℤ) *
          ((ζ : kˣ) ^ (orderOf a : ℤ)) ^ m := by
            rw [zpow_add, zpow_mul]
    _ = (ζ : kˣ) * 1 ^ m := by
            have hz : (ζ : kˣ) ^ orderOf a = 1 :=
              (mem_rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) (ζ : kˣ)).mp ζ.property
            have hz_zpow : (ζ : kˣ) ^ (orderOf a : ℤ) = 1 := by
              exact_mod_cast hz
            rw [zpow_one, hz_zpow]
    _ = (ζ : kˣ) := by
            simp only [one_zpow, mul_one]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.chiCyc_apply_generator_zpow
statement:
lemma chiCyc_apply_generator_zpow
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    {a : G}
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k)
    (n : ℤ) :
    (chiCyc ζ)
      ((⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : Cyc a) ^ n) = ζ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [map_zpow, chiCyc_apply_generator (a := a) ζ]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.chiCyc_apply_mem_Lambda
statement:
lemma chiCyc_apply_mem_Lambda [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k)
    (y : PElementary.Cyc a) :
    (((chiCyc ζ) y : kˣ) : k) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G
proof:
:= by
  exact ClassFun.Lambda.linearChar_subgroup_apply_mem_Lambda
    (H := PElementary.Cyc a) (chiCyc ζ) y

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.psiE_apply_eq_chiCyc_cycPart
statement:
lemma psiE_apply_eq_chiCyc_cycPart
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k)
    (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    (psiEZeta p ha ζ) x
      =
    (chiCyc ζ) (E_to_Cyc p a ha x)
proof:
:= by
  simp [psiEZeta, psiE]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.psiEZeta_apply_eq_zpow_of_cycPart_eq_zpow
statement:
lemma psiEZeta_apply_eq_zpow_of_cycPart_eq_zpow
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (y : E_subgroup p a)
    {n : ℤ}
    (hn : ((E_to_Cyc p a ha y : PElementary.Cyc a) : G) = a ^ n)
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k) :
    (psiEZeta p ha ζ) y = ζ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [psiE_apply_eq_chiCyc_cycPart p ha ζ y]
  have h_c_pow :
      E_to_Cyc p a ha y =
        (⟨a, Subgroup.mem_zpowers a⟩ : PElementary.Cyc a) ^ n := by
    ext
    exact hn
  rw [h_c_pow]
  exact chiCyc_apply_generator_zpow (a := a) ζ n

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.psiEZeta_apply_a_inv_mem_Lambda
statement:
lemma psiEZeta_apply_a_inv_mem_Lambda [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k)
    (haInvMem : a⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a) :
    (((psiEZeta p ha ζ)
        ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩ : kˣ) : k) ∈ ClassFun.Lambda k G
proof:
:= by

  have hψ :
      (psiEZeta p ha ζ) ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩
        =
      (chiCyc ζ) (E_to_Cyc p a ha ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩) :=
    psiE_apply_eq_chiCyc_cycPart
      p ha ζ ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩

  have hψk :
      (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩ : kˣ) : k)
        =
      (((chiCyc ζ)
        (E_to_Cyc p a ha ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩) : kˣ) : k) := Units.val_inj.mpr hψ

  rw [hψk]

  exact chiCyc_apply_mem_Lambda ζ (E_to_Cyc p a ha ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.psiEZeta_apply_eq_one_of_mem_P
statement:
lemma psiEZeta_apply_eq_one_of_mem_P [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k)
    (y : E_subgroup p a)
    (hyP : (y : G) ∈ P_of_Z p a) :
    psiEZeta p ha ζ y = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [psiE_apply_eq_chiCyc_cycPart p ha ζ y]

  let yG : G := (y : G)
  have hyH : yG ∈ Cyc a ⊔ P_of_Z p a := y.property
  let ySub : ↥(Cyc a ⊔ P_of_Z p a) := ⟨yG, hyH⟩

  have h_c_one_internal :
      ((mulEquivProd (associatedSubgroup ha)).symm ySub).1 = 1 := by
    let H_elem := associatedSubgroup ha
    let iso := mulEquivProd H_elem
    let pElem : H_elem.P := ⟨ySub, hyP⟩
    have h_iso_fwd : iso (1, pElem) = ySub := by
      ext
      exact one_mul yG
    have h_iso_symm := congr_arg iso.symm h_iso_fwd
    rw [MulEquiv.symm_apply_apply] at h_iso_symm
    exact congr_arg Prod.fst h_iso_symm.symm

  have h_c_one : E_to_Cyc p a ha y = 1 := by
    rw [E_to_Cyc_apply]
    exact (MulEquiv.map_eq_one_iff (E_Cyc_equiv p a ha)).mpr h_c_one_internal

  rw [h_c_one]
  exact MonoidHom.map_one (chiCyc ζ)

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.ofIsPElementary
statement:
theorem ofIsPElementary
    (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (hG : IsPElementary p G) :
    IsBrauerElementary G
proof:
:=
  ⟨p, hp.out, hG⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.ofPElementary
statement:
theorem ofPElementary
    (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (eG : PElementary p G) :
    IsBrauerElementary G
proof:
:=
  ofIsPElementary (p := p) ⟨eG⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.ofIsPGroup
statement:
theorem ofIsPGroup
    (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime]
    (hG : IsPGroup p G) :
    IsBrauerElementary G
proof:
:=
  ofIsPElementary (p := p) (IsPElementary.ofIsPGroup (p := p) hG)

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.ofMulEquiv
statement:
theorem ofMulEquiv
    (hG : IsBrauerElementary G) (φ : G ≃* G') :
    IsBrauerElementary G'
proof:
:= by
  rcases hG with ⟨p, hp, hpelem⟩
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, IsPElementary.ofMulEquiv p hpelem φ⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.ofSubgroup
statement:
theorem ofSubgroup
    (hG : IsBrauerElementary G) (K : Subgroup G) :
    IsBrauerElementary K
proof:
:= by
  rcases hG with ⟨p, hp, ⟨eG⟩⟩
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  exact ⟨p, hp, ⟨PElementary.ofSubgroup eG K⟩⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.of_isCyclic
statement:
theorem of_isCyclic
    [Finite G] (hG : IsCyclic G) :
    IsBrauerElementary G
proof:
:= by
  let p : ℕ := 2
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨Nat.prime_two⟩
  haveI : IsCyclic G := hG
  exact ⟨p, Nat.prime_two, IsPElementary.of_isCyclic (p := p) (G := G)⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.isNilpotent
statement:
theorem isNilpotent
    [Finite G] (hG : IsBrauerElementary G) :
    Group.IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  rcases hG with ⟨p, hp, ⟨eG⟩⟩
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  exact eG.isNilpotent

name: BrauerInduction.IsBrauerElementary.isNilpotent_subgroup
statement:
theorem isNilpotent_subgroup
    [Finite G] (hG : IsBrauerElementary G)
    (K : Subgroup G) :
    Group.IsNilpotent K
proof:
:= by
  have hK : IsBrauerElementary K := ofSubgroup hG K
  exact hK.isNilpotent

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phiSum_apply_expand
statement:
lemma phiSum_apply_expand [Finite G]
    {a : G}
    (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    phiSum p ha x =
      ∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
        (((psiEZeta  (k := k) p ha ζ)
            ⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup (p := p) a⟩ : kˣ) : k) *
          (((psiEZeta  (k := k) p ha ζ) x : kˣ) : k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [phiSum, VpsiEZeta, FDRep.ofLinearChar,
    ClassFun.char_apply, ClassFun.sum_apply, ClassFun.smul_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ζ hζ
  congr 1
  simpa [FDRep.ofLinearChar] using
    FDRep.char_ofLinearChar (psiEZeta p ha ζ) x

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phiSum_apply_product_eq_combine
statement:
lemma phiSum_apply_product_eq_combine [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    (∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
        (((psiEZeta p ha ζ)
            ⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩ : kˣ) : k) *
          (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) x : kˣ) : k))
      =
    ∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
        (((psiEZeta p ha ζ)
            (⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩ * x) : kˣ) : k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro ζ _
  have hmul :
      (psiEZeta p ha ζ)
          (⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩ * x)
        =
      (psiEZeta p ha ζ) ⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩ *
        (psiEZeta p ha ζ) x := by
    exact MonoidHom.map_mul (psiEZeta p ha ζ) ⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩ x
  rw [hmul]
  simp only [Units.val_mul]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.sum_psiEZeta_eq_zero_of_not_mem_P
statement:
lemma sum_psiEZeta_eq_zero_of_not_mem_P
    [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (y : E_subgroup p a)
    (hyP : (y : G) ∉ P_of_Z p a) :
    (∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
        (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) y : kˣ) : k)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let y_G : G := (y : G)
  have hy_H : y_G ∈ Cyc a ⊔ P_of_Z p a := y.property
  let y_sub : ↥(Cyc a ⊔ P_of_Z p a) := ⟨y_G, hy_H⟩

  let H_elem := associatedSubgroup ha
  let iso := mulEquivProd H_elem
  let c_sub := (iso.symm y).1
  let s_sub := (iso.symm y).2

  obtain ⟨n, hn_eq⟩ : ∃ n : ℤ, (c_sub : G) = a ^ n := by
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp c_sub.property
    exact ⟨n, hn.symm⟩

  have hn_toCyc : ((E_to_Cyc p a ha y : Cyc a) : G) = a ^ n := by
      have hcyc :
          ((E_to_Cyc p a ha y : Cyc a) : G) =
            (c_sub : G) := by
        simp only [E_to_Cyc_apply, E_Cyc_equiv_apply_coe, H_elem, c_sub, iso]
      exact hcyc.trans hn_eq

  have h_ndiv : ¬ (orderOf a : ℤ) ∣ n := by
    intro h_div
    have h_an_one : a ^ n = 1 := orderOf_dvd_iff_zpow_eq_one.mp h_div
    have hc_one : (c_sub : G) = 1 := by rw [hn_eq, h_an_one]
    have h_prod : (c_sub : G) * (s_sub : G) = y_G := by
      have h_eval : (iso (c_sub, s_sub) : G) =
          (c_sub : G) * (s_sub : G) := rfl
      rw [← h_eval]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val (iso.apply_symm_apply y_sub)
    have hy_in_P : y_G ∈ P_of_Z p a := by
      have h_y_eq_u : y_G = (s_sub : G) := by
        calc
          y_G = (c_sub : G) * (s_sub : G) := h_prod.symm
          _ = 1 * (s_sub : G) := by rw [hc_one]
          _ = (s_sub : G) := one_mul _
      rw [h_y_eq_u]
      exact s_sub.property
    exact hyP hy_in_P

  have h_sum :
      (∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
          (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) y : kˣ) : k))
        =
      ∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
          (((ζ : kˣ) ^ n : kˣ) : k) := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ζ _
    have hn_toCyc : ((E_to_Cyc p a ha y : Cyc a) : G) = a ^ n := by
      simp only [E_to_Cyc_apply, E_Cyc_equiv_apply_coe]
      simpa [E_to_Cyc_apply, E_Cyc_equiv, c_sub] using hn_eq
    rw [psiEZeta_apply_eq_zpow_of_cycPart_eq_zpow
      (k := k) (p := p) ha y hn_toCyc ζ]

  rw [h_sum]
  have:  NeZero (orderOf a) := IsPRegular.neZero_orderOf p ha
  exact rootsOfUnity.sum_zpow_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (orderOf a) n h_ndiv

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phi_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma phi_apply
    (k : Type u) [CommRing k]
    {a : G} (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    phi  p k a x =
      if Group.pRegular p (x : G) = a then (orderOf a : k) else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phi_mem_C_Z
statement:
lemma phi_mem_C_Z (a : G)
    (k : Type u) [CommRing k] :
    phi p k a ∈ C_Z k (E_subgroup p a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  by_cases h : Group.pRegular p (x : G) = a
  · refine ⟨(orderOf a : ℤ), ?_⟩
    simp [phi, h]
  · refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    simp [phi, h]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phi_eq_phiSum
statement:
lemma phi_eq_phiSum
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    phi p k a = phiSum p ha
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [phi_apply p k x]
  rw [phiSum_apply_expand p ha x]
  rw [phiSum_apply_product_eq_combine p ha x]
  let aInvE : E_subgroup p a := ⟨a⁻¹, inv_mem_E_subgroup p a⟩
  haveI : NeZero (orderOf a) := IsPRegular.neZero_orderOf p ha
  by_cases h_reg : Group.pRegular p (x : G) = a
  · have h_in_P :
        ((aInvE * x : E_subgroup p a) : G) ∈ P_of_Z  p a := by
      have h_fiber := (mem_associatedSubgroup_fiber ha x).mp h_reg
      obtain ⟨s, hs_P, h_x_eq⟩ := h_fiber
      have h_ax_eq_s : ((aInvE * x : E_subgroup p a) : G) = s := by
        push_cast
        rw [h_x_eq, inv_mul_cancel_left]
      rw [h_ax_eq_s]
      exact hs_P
    have h_psi_one :
        ∀ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
            psiEZeta p ha ζ (aInvE * x) = 1 := by
      intro ζ
      exact psiEZeta_apply_eq_one_of_mem_P
        (k := k) (p := p) ha ζ (aInvE * x) h_in_P
    have hcard :
        Fintype.card (rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k) = orderOf a := by
      rw [← Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
      exact HasEnoughRootsOfUnity.natCard_rootsOfUnity k (orderOf a)
    change
      (if Group.pRegular p (x : G) = a then (orderOf a : k) else 0)
        =
      ∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k, (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) (aInvE * x) : kˣ) : k)
    simp only [
      h_reg, ↓reduceIte, h_psi_one, Units.val_one,
      Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one
    ]
    exact_mod_cast hcard.symm
  · have h_not_in_P :
        ((aInvE * x : E_subgroup p a) : G) ∉ P_of_Z p a := by
      intro hyP
      apply h_reg
      have h_fiber := mem_associatedSubgroup_fiber ha x
      apply h_fiber.mpr
      refine ⟨((aInvE * x : E_subgroup p a) : G), hyP, ?_⟩
      change (x : G) = a * (a⁻¹ * (x : G))
      simp only [mul_inv_cancel_left]
    have hsum0 :
        (∑ ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k,
          (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) (aInvE * x) : kˣ) : k)) = 0 :=
      sum_psiEZeta_eq_zero_of_not_mem_P
        (k := k) (p := p) ha (aInvE * x) h_not_in_P
    simp only [h_reg, ↓reduceIte]
    exact by
      simpa using hsum0.symm

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phiSum_mem_R_Lambda
statement:
lemma phiSum_mem_R_Lambda
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    phiSum p ha ∈ R_Lambda k G (E_subgroup p a)
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [phiSum]

  have haMem : a ∈ E_subgroup p a := by
    refine (le_sup_left : Cyc a ≤ E_subgroup p a) ?_
    refine (Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff).2 ?_
    exact ⟨(1 : ℤ), by simp⟩

  have haInvMem : a⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a :=
    (E_subgroup p a).inv_mem haMem

  change
    (Finset.univ.sum (fun ζ : rootsOfUnity (orderOf a) k =>
      (((psiEZeta p ha ζ) ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩ : kˣ) : k)
        • ClassFun.character (VpsiEZeta (k := k) p ha ζ)))
      ∈ R_Lambda k G (E_subgroup p a)

  refine Submodule.sum_mem _ ?_
  intro ζ hζ

  let c : Lambda k G :=
    ⟨(((psiEZeta (k := k) p ha ζ) ⟨a⁻¹, haInvMem⟩ : kˣ) : k),
      psiEZeta_apply_a_inv_mem_Lambda
      (k := k) p ha ζ haInvMem⟩

  change
    c • ClassFun.character (VpsiEZeta p ha ζ)
      ∈ R_Lambda k G (E_subgroup p a)

  exact Submodule.smul_mem _ c
    (R_Lambda.char_mem (k := k) (E_subgroup p a) (VpsiEZeta p ha ζ))


                                                                        
 lemma phi_mem_R_Lambda
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (a : G) (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    phi p k a ∈ R_Lambda k G (E_subgroup p a) := by
    have hEq : phi p k a = phiSum p ha := by
      exact phi_eq_phiSum p ha
    simpa [hEq] using (phiSum_mem_R_Lambda p ha)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phi_mem_R_Lambda
statement:
lemma phi_mem_R_Lambda
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (a : G) (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    phi p k a ∈ R_Lambda k G (E_subgroup p a)
proof:
:= by
    have hEq : phi p k a = phiSum p ha := by
      exact phi_eq_phiSum p ha
    simpa [hEq] using (phiSum_mem_R_Lambda p ha)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.phi_mem_Q
statement:
lemma phi_mem_Q
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] [CharZero k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (a : G) (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    phi p k a ∈ Q_sys k G (E_subgroup p a)
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨
    phi_mem_R_Lambda p a ha,
    phi_mem_C_Z p a k
  ⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localFunction_mem_PElementarySpanLambda
statement:
lemma localFunction_mem_PElementarySpanLambda
    [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (a : G) (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    PElementary.f (k := k) p a ∈
      PElementarySpanLambda (k := k) (G := G) p
proof:
:= by
  simpa [PElementary.f] using
    PElementarySpanLambda.ind_mem
      (k := k) (G := G) p
      (PElementary.E_subgroup p a)
      (PElementary.E_isPElementary p ha)
      (PElementary.phi_mem_Q (k := k) p a ha).1

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localFunction_mem_C_Z
statement:
lemma localFunction_mem_C_Z
    [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (a : G) (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    PElementary.f (k := k) p a ∈ ClassFun.C_Z k G
proof:
:= by
  intro g

  have htop :=
    ClassFun.C_Z.ind_mem_C_Z
      (k := k) (G := G)
      (PElementary.phi_mem_Q (k := k) p a ha).2

  simpa [PElementary.f] using
    htop ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.finset_sum_mem_C_Z
statement:
private lemma finset_sum_mem_C_Z
    {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι)
    (F : ι → ClassFun k G)
    (hF : ∀ i ∈ s, F i ∈ ClassFun.C_Z k G) :
    s.sum F ∈ ClassFun.C_Z k G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simpa using
        (ClassFun.C_Z.zero_mem (k := k) (G := G))

  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert ha]
      apply ClassFun.C_Z.add_mem
      · exact hF a (Finset.mem_insert_self a s)
      · apply ih
        intro i hi
        exact hF i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localSum_mem_PElementarySpanLambda
statement:
lemma localSum_mem_PElementarySpanLambda
    [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    localSum (k := k) p ∈
      PElementarySpanLambda (k := k) (G := G) p
proof:
:= by
  unfold localSum
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro C hC
  exact localFunction_mem_PElementarySpanLambda
    (k := k) p C.repr (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localSum_mem_C_Z
statement:
lemma localSum_mem_C_Z
    [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k] :
    localSum (k := k) p ∈ ClassFun.C_Z k G
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold localSum
  apply finset_sum_mem_C_Z
  intro C hC
  exact localFunction_mem_C_Z
    (k := k) p C.repr
      (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localFunction_apply_pRegular
statement:
lemma localFunction_apply_pRegular
    [Finite G] [CharZero k]
    (C : PRegularClass p G)
    (g : G) (hg : IsPRegular p g) :
    PElementary.f (k := k) p C.repr g =
      if IsConj C.repr g then
        (PElementary.index p C.repr : k)
      else
        0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hC : IsConj C.repr g

  · rw [if_pos hC]
    calc
      PElementary.f (k := k) p C.repr g
          =
        PElementary.f (k := k) p C.repr C.repr := by
          exact
            (PElementary.f (k := k) p C.repr).map_conj
              g C.repr hC.symm
      _ = (PElementary.index p C.repr : k) := by
          exact
            PElementary.f_apply_a_eq_index
              (k := k) p
              (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C)

  · rw [if_neg hC]
    apply PElementary.f_apply_eq_zero_of_not_isConj

    rw [Group.pRegular_eq_self_of_isPRegular
      (hf := isOfFinOrder_of_finite g)
      (hr := hg)]

    intro h
    exact hC h.symm

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localSum_apply_of_pRegular
statement:
lemma localSum_apply_of_pRegular
    [Finite G] [CharZero k]
    (g : G) (hg : IsPRegular p g) :
    ∃ C : PRegularClass p G,
      IsConj C.repr g ∧
      localSum (k := k) p g =
        (PElementary.index p C.repr : k)
proof:
:= by
  classical

  rcases PRegularClass.unique_of_isPRegular p g hg with
    ⟨C₀, hC₀, hC_unique⟩

  refine ⟨C₀, hC₀, ?_⟩

  simp only [localSum, ClassFun.sum_apply]

  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single C₀]

  · rw [localFunction_apply_pRegular
      (k := k) p C₀ g hg]
    rw [if_pos hC₀]

  · intro C hC_mem hC_ne
    have h_not_conj : ¬ IsConj C.repr g := by
      intro hC
      exact hC_ne (hC_unique C hC)

    rw [localFunction_apply_pRegular
      (k := k) p C g hg]
    rw [if_neg h_not_conj]

  · intro hC₀_not_mem
    exact (hC₀_not_mem (Finset.mem_univ C₀)).elim

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.localSum_apply_of_pRegular_not_dvd
statement:
lemma localSum_apply_of_pRegular_not_dvd
    [Finite G] [CharZero k]
    (g : G) (hg : IsPRegular p g) :
    ∃ n : ℤ,
      localSum (k := k) p g = (n : k) ∧
      ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ n
proof:
:= by
  rcases localSum_apply_of_pRegular
      (k := k) p g hg with
    ⟨C, hC, hsum⟩

  rcases PElementary.f_apply_self_coprime
      (k := k) p
      (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C) with
    ⟨n, hn, hn_not_dvd⟩

  refine ⟨n, ?_, hn_not_dvd⟩

  calc
    localSum (k := k) p g
        =
      (PElementary.index p C.repr : k) := hsum
    _ =
      PElementary.f (k := k) p C.repr C.repr := by
        symm
        exact
          PElementary.f_apply_a_eq_index
            (k := k) p
            (PRegularClass.repr_isPRegular C)
    _ = (n : k) := hn

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.coe_localSumElement
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_localSumElement :
    (localSumElement (k := k) (G := G) p : ClassFun k G) =
        PElementary.localSum p
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementaryIdeal.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    (φ : ClassFun.CharacterRing k G) :
    φ ∈ PElementaryIdeal p ↔
      (φ : ClassFun k G) ∈ PElementarySpanChar p
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementaryIdeal.le_BrauerIdeal
statement:
lemma le_BrauerIdeal [Fact p.Prime] :
    PElementaryIdeal p ≤ BrauerIdeal (k := k) (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  exact InducedCharacterIdeal.mono
    (P := fun H => IsPElementary p H)
    (Q := fun H => IsBrauerElementary H)
    (fun H hH => IsBrauerElementary.ofIsPElementary p hH)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanChar.inducedCharacter_mem
statement:
lemma inducedCharacter_mem
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hH : IsPElementary p H)
    (V : FDRep k H) :
    ClassFun.ind H
      (ClassFun.character V) ∈ PElementarySpanChar p
proof:
:= by
  exact InducedCharacterSpan.inducedCharacter_mem
      (P := fun K => IsPElementary p K) H hH V

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanChar.le_BrauerSpanChar
statement:
lemma le_BrauerSpanChar [Fact p.Prime] :
    PElementarySpanChar p ≤ BrauerSpanChar (k := k) (G := G)
proof:
:= by
  apply InducedCharacterSpan.mono
  intro H hH
  exact IsBrauerElementary.ofIsPElementary p hH

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanChar.character_mul_mem
statement:
lemma character_mul_mem
    (V : FDRep k G)
    {φ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ PElementarySpanChar p) :
    ClassFun.character V * φ ∈
      PElementarySpanChar p
proof:
:= by
  exact InducedCharacterSpan.character_mul_mem
    (fun H => IsPElementary p H) V hφ

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanChar.mul_mem
statement:
lemma mul_mem
    {φ ψ : ClassFun k G}
    (hφ : φ ∈ PElementarySpanChar p)
    (hψ : ψ ∈ PElementarySpanChar p) :
    φ * ψ ∈ PElementarySpanChar p
proof:
:= by
  exact InducedCharacterSpan.mul_mem
     (fun H => IsPElementary p H) hφ hψ

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanChar.induction_mem
proof:
:= by
  apply InducedCharacterSpan.induction_mem
    (P := fun K : Subgroup H => IsPElementary p K)
    (Q := fun K : Subgroup G => IsPElementary p K)
    ?_ hφ
  intro K hK
  exact IsPElementary.ofMulEquiv
    p hK (K.equivMapOfInjective H.subtype Subtype.coe_injective)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.inducedCharacter_mem
statement:
lemma inducedCharacter_mem
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hH : IsPElementary p H)
    (V : FDRep k H) :
    ClassFun.ind H (ClassFun.character V) ∈
      PElementarySpanLambda p
proof:
:= by
  apply Submodule.subset_span
  exact ⟨H, hH, V, rfl⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.ind_mem
statement:
lemma ind_mem
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (hH : IsPElementary p H)
    {q : ClassFun k H}
    (hq : q ∈ ClassFun.R_Lambda k G H) :
    ClassFun.ind H q ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun q _ => ClassFun.ind H q ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hq
  · rintro χ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    exact inducedCharacter_mem p H hH V
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [ClassFun.ind_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    change
      ClassFun.ind H
        (((a : ClassFun.Lambda k G) : k) • x) ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p
    rw [ClassFun.ind_smul]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.le_R_Lambda_top
statement:
lemma le_R_Lambda_top :
    PElementarySpanLambda p ≤
      ClassFun.R_Lambda.top k G
proof:
:= by
  rw [PElementarySpanLambda, Submodule.span_le]
  rintro χ ⟨H, hH, V, rfl⟩
  rw [← ClassFun.char_ind]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨FDRep.ind H V, rfl⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.mul_mem_left_R_Lambda_top
statement:
lemma mul_mem_left_R_Lambda_top
    {f g : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ ClassFun.R_Lambda.top k G)
    (hg : g ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p) :
    f * g ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun g _ =>
      f * g ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hg
  · rintro _ ⟨H, hH, V, rfl⟩
    rw [ClassFun.projection_formula]
    apply ind_mem p H hH
    apply ClassFun.R_Lambda.mul_mem
    · exact ClassFun.R_Lambda.top_res_to_subgroup H hf
    · exact ClassFun.R_Lambda.char_mem H V
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [mul_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro a x _ hx
    rw [mul_smul_comm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ a hx

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.mul_mem
statement:
lemma mul_mem
    {f g : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p)
    (hg : g ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p) :
    f * g ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p
proof:
:= by
  exact mul_mem_left_R_Lambda_top p (le_R_Lambda_top p hf)  hg

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.pow_succ_mem
statement:
lemma pow_succ_mem
    {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p)
    (n : ℕ) : f ^ (n + 1) ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      simpa using hf
  | succ n ih =>
      simpa [pow_succ, Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
        mul_mem p ih hf

name: BrauerInduction.PElementarySpanLambda.pow_mem
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      exact (hn rfl).elim
  | succ n =>
      simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using
        pow_succ_mem p hf n

name: BrauerInduction.PElementaryCyclotomicIdeal.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    (f : ClassFun.CyclotomicCharacterAlgebra) :
    f ∈ PElementaryCyclotomicIdeal (k := k) (G := G) p ↔
      (f : ClassFun k G) ∈ PElementarySpanLambda p
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.isPSingular_of_mem_P
statement:
lemma isPSingular_of_mem_P [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) {g : G} (hg : g ∈ e.P) :
    IsPSingular p g
proof:
:= by
  rcases (IsPGroup.iff_orderOf).1 e.P_isPGroup ⟨g, hg⟩ with ⟨k, hk⟩
  exact ⟨k, by simpa [Subgroup.orderOf_coe] using hk⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.mem_P_iff_pSingular
statement:
lemma mem_P_iff_pSingular [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) {g : G} :
    g ∈ e.P ↔ IsPSingular p g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    exact e.isPSingular_of_mem_P hg
  · intro hgu
    rcases e.decompose g with ⟨c, cC, q, qP, hg_eq⟩
    have hcr : IsPRegular p c := e.C_isPRegular cC
    have hqs  : IsPSingular p q := e.isPSingular_of_mem_P qP
    have hf : IsOfFinOrder (c * q) := by
      rw [hg_eq]
      exact hgu.isOfFinOrder
    have hcomm : q * c = c * q := by
      rw [e.comm cC qP]
    obtain ⟨hq_eq, hc_eq⟩ :=
      Group.pSingular_pRegular_unique p hf hcomm rfl hqs  hcr
    have hc1 : c = 1 := by
      rw [hc_eq]
      exact Group.isPSingular_pRegular_eq_one p hf (by simpa [hg_eq] using hgu)
    rw [← hg_eq, hc1, one_mul]
    exact qP

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.mem_C_iff_pRegular
statement:
lemma mem_C_iff_pRegular [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) {g : G} :
    g ∈ e.C ↔ IsPRegular p g
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hg
    exact e.C_isPRegular hg
  · intro hgr
    rcases e.decompose g with ⟨c, cC, q, qP, hg_eq⟩
    have hps  : IsPSingular p q := e.isPSingular_of_mem_P qP
    have hpr : IsPRegular p c := e.C_isPRegular cC
    have hf : IsOfFinOrder (c * q) := by
      rw [hg_eq]
      exact hgr.isOfFinOrder
    have hcomm : q * c = c * q := by
      rw [e.comm cC qP]
    obtain ⟨hq_eq, hc_eq⟩ :=
      Group.pSingular_pRegular_unique p hf hcomm rfl hps  hpr
    have hq1 : q = 1 := by
      rw [hq_eq]
      exact Group.isPRegular_pSingular_eq_one p hf (by simpa [hg_eq] using hgr)
    rw [← hg_eq, hq1, mul_one]
    exact cC

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.finite_C
statement:
lemma finite_C [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) :
    Finite e.C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top.mp e.C_isCyclic
  have hp_reg : IsPRegular p (g : G) := e.C_isPRegular g.property
  have hfin : IsOfFinOrder (g : G) := IsPRegular.isOfFinOrder p hp_reg
  have h_ord : 0 < orderOf g := by
    have h_ordG : 0 < orderOf (g : G) := orderOf_pos_iff.mpr hfin
    simp only [Subgroup.orderOf_coe] at h_ordG ⊢
    exact h_ordG
  let φ : Subgroup.zpowers g ≃ e.C :=
    (MulEquiv.subgroupCongr hg).toEquiv.trans Subgroup.topEquiv.toEquiv
  have h_card : Nat.card e.C = Nat.card (Subgroup.zpowers g) :=
    Nat.card_congr φ.symm
  have h_pos : 0 < Nat.card e.C := by
    rw [h_card, Nat.card_zpowers]
    exact h_ord
  exact (Nat.card_pos_iff.mp h_pos).2

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.isOfFinOrder
statement:
lemma isOfFinOrder [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) (g : G) :
    IsOfFinOrder g
proof:
:= by
  rcases e.decompose g with ⟨c, hc, q, hq, rfl⟩
  exact Commute.isOfFinOrder_mul
    (e.comm hc hq)
    (IsPRegular.isOfFinOrder p (e.C_isPRegular hc))
    (IsPSingular.isOfFinOrder p (e.isPSingular_of_mem_P hq))

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.card_C_coprime_p
statement:
lemma card_C_coprime_p [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) :
    Nat.Coprime (Nat.card e.C) p
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsCyclic e.C := e.C_isCyclic
  letI : CommGroup e.C := IsCyclic.commGroup
  haveI : Finite e.C := e.finite_C

  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ : ∃ g : e.C, orderOf g = Monoid.exponent e.C := by
    apply Monoid.exists_orderOf_eq_exponent
    exact Monoid.ExponentExists.of_finite

  have hg_regG : IsPRegular p (g : G) := e.C_isPRegular g.property

  have hg_coprimeG : Nat.Coprime (orderOf (g : G)) p :=
    IsPRegular.order_coprime p hg_regG

  have hg_coprimeC : Nat.Coprime (orderOf g) p := by
    simpa [Subgroup.orderOf_coe] using hg_coprimeG

  have : Nat.Coprime (Monoid.exponent e.C) p := by
    simpa [hg] using hg_coprimeC

  rw [← IsCyclic.exponent_eq_card]
  exact this

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.inf_C_P_eq_bot
statement:
lemma inf_C_P_eq_bot [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) : e.C ⊓ e.P = ⊥
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Subgroup.mem_inf, Subgroup.mem_bot]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hx_C, hx_P⟩
    have hs  : IsPSingular p x := (e.mem_P_iff_pSingular).mp hx_P
    have hr : IsPRegular p x := (e.mem_C_iff_pRegular).mp hx_C
    exact IsPSingular.isPRegular_eq_one p x hs  hr
  · rintro rfl
    exact ⟨Subgroup.one_mem _, Subgroup.one_mem _⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.finite_P_of_finite
statement:
private lemma finite_P_of_finite
    (e : PElementary p G) [Finite G] :
    Finite e.P
proof: := inferInstance

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.isNilpotent_of_finite_P
statement:
lemma isNilpotent_of_finite_P [Fact p.Prime]
    (e : PElementary p G) [Finite e.P] :
    Group.IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Group.IsNilpotent e.C :=
    @CommGroup.isNilpotent e.C (e.C_isCyclic.commGroup)
  haveI : Group.IsNilpotent e.P :=
    IsPGroup.isNilpotent e.P_isPGroup
  exact Group.nilpotent_of_mulEquiv e.mulEquivProd

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.isNilpotent
statement:
lemma isNilpotent
    [Fact p.Prime] [Finite G]
    (e : PElementary p G) :
    Group.IsNilpotent G
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite e.P := finite_P_of_finite e
  exact e.isNilpotent_of_finite_P

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.cyc_isCyclic
statement:
@[simp]
lemma cyc_isCyclic (x : G) : IsCyclic (Cyc x)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Subgroup.isCyclic_iff_exists_zpowers_eq_top]
  use x

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.commute_of_mem_Z_of_mem_Cyc
statement:
lemma commute_of_mem_Z_of_mem_Cyc {x z c : G} (hz : z ∈ Z x)
    (hc : c ∈ Cyc x) : Commute c z
proof:
:= by
  rcases Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hc with ⟨n, rfl⟩
  exact Commute.zpow_left (hz x rfl) n

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.P_of_Z_isPGroup
statement:
lemma P_of_Z_isPGroup (x : G) :
    IsPGroup p (P_of_Z p x)
proof: := IsPGroup.map (P_in_Z p x).isPGroup' (inclZ x)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.P_of_Z_le_Z
statement: lemma P_of_Z_le_Z (x : G) : P_of_Z p x ≤ Z x
proof:
:= by
  rw [P_of_Z]
  apply Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap.mpr
  intro g _
  exact g.property

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.card_P_of_Z_eq_card_P_in_Z
statement:
lemma card_P_of_Z_eq_card_P_in_Z [Fact p.Prime] (x : G) :
    Nat.card ↥(P_of_Z p x)
      =
    Nat.card ↥((P_in_Z p x : Subgroup (Z x)))
proof:
:= by
  simpa [P_of_Z, PElementary.inclZ] using
    (Subgroup.card_map_of_injective (f := inclZ x) Subtype.coe_injective)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.p_not_dvd_cardCentralizer_div_cardP
statement:
lemma p_not_dvd_cardCentralizer_div_cardP
    [Fact p.Prime] (x : G) [Finite (Z x)] :
    ¬ p ∣ (Nat.card (Z x : Set G) / Nat.card (P_of_Z p x))
proof:
:= by
  rw [PElementary.card_P_of_Z_eq_card_P_in_Z x]

  haveI : Finite (P_in_Z p x : Subgroup (Z x)) := inferInstance
  haveI : (P_in_Z p x : Subgroup (Z x)).FiniteIndex := inferInstance

  have h_div :
      Nat.card ↥(Z x : Set G) /
          Nat.card ↥(P_in_Z p x : Subgroup (Z x))
        =
      (P_in_Z p x : Subgroup (Z x)).index := by
    exact Nat.div_eq_of_eq_mul_left
      Nat.card_pos
      (Subgroup.index_mul_card (P_in_Z p x : Subgroup (Z x))).symm

  rw [h_div]
  exact Sylow.not_dvd_index (PElementary.P_in_Z p x)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.sup_decompose_of_commute
statement:
lemma sup_decompose_of_commute
    {C P : Subgroup G}
    (hcomm : ∀ ⦃c p : G⦄, c ∈ C → p ∈ P → Commute c p) :
    ∀ {h : G}, h ∈ C ⊔ P → ∃ c ∈ C, ∃ p ∈ P, c * p = h
proof:
:= by
  intro h hh
  have eq_closure : C ⊔ P = Subgroup.closure ((C : Set G) ∪ P) := by
    symm
    simp [Subgroup.closure_union]
  rw [eq_closure] at hh
  refine Subgroup.closure_induction
    (p := fun x _ => ∃ c ∈ C, ∃ p ∈ P, c * p = x)
    ?mem ?one ?mul ?inv hh
  · rintro x (hx | hx)
    · exact ⟨x, hx, 1, P.one_mem, by simp⟩
    · exact ⟨1, C.one_mem, x, hx, by simp⟩
  · exact ⟨1, C.one_mem, 1, P.one_mem, by simp⟩
  · rintro a b - - ⟨c1, hc1, p1, hp1, rfl⟩ ⟨c2, hc2, p2, hp2, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨c1 * c2, C.mul_mem hc1 hc2, p1 * p2, P.mul_mem hp1 hp2, ?_⟩
    calc (c1 * c2) * (p1 * p2)
      _ = c1 * (c2 * p1) * p2 := by simp [mul_assoc]
      _ = c1 * (p1 * c2) * p2 := by rw [(hcomm hc2 hp1).eq]
      _ = (c1 * p1) * (c2 * p2) := by simp [mul_assoc]
  · rintro a - ⟨c, hc, p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c⁻¹, C.inv_mem hc, p⁻¹, P.inv_mem hp,
      by simp [mul_inv_rev, (hcomm hc hp).inv_left.inv_right.eq]⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.mem_associatedSubgroup_fiber
statement:
lemma mem_associatedSubgroup_fiber [Fact p.Prime]
    {r : G} (hr : IsPRegular p r)
    (h : ↥(Subgroup.zpowers r ⊔ P_of_Z p r)) :
    Group.pRegular p (h : G) = r ↔ ∃ s ∈ P_of_Z p r, (h : G) = r * s
proof:
:= by
  let H := Subgroup.zpowers r ⊔ P_of_Z p r
  let eH := associatedSubgroup (p := p) hr
  have hf : IsOfFinOrder (h : G) := by
    have hfH : IsOfFinOrder h := eH.isOfFinOrder h
    exact (Submonoid.isOfFinOrder_coe (x := h)).2 hfH
  constructor
  · intro h_reg_is_s
    let s := Group.pSingular p (h : G)
    have h_decomp : (h : G) = r * s := by
      simp only [← h_reg_is_s]
      rw [Group.pDecomp' p hf]
    use s
    constructor
    · have s_in_H : s ∈ H := by
        rw [eq_inv_mul_iff_mul_eq.mpr h_decomp.symm]
        apply Subgroup.mul_mem
        · apply Subgroup.inv_mem
          apply Subgroup.mem_sup_left
          simp only [Subgroup.mem_zpowers]
        · exact h.property
      have hsH : (⟨s, s_in_H⟩ : H) ∈ eH.P := by
        rw [eH.mem_P_iff_pSingular]
        exact
          (IsPSingular.subtype_iff p (x := ⟨s, s_in_H⟩)).1
              (Group.isPSingular_pSingular p (h : G))
      exact hsH
    · exact h_decomp
  · rintro ⟨s, hs, h_eq⟩
    rw [h_eq]
    have hsr_fin : IsOfFinOrder (r * s) := by
      simpa [← h_eq] using hf
    apply Group.pRegular_mul_eq_self_of_pSingular_commute p hsr_fin
    · exact hr
    · have s_in_H : s ∈ H := Subgroup.mem_sup_right hs
      have hsH : (⟨s, s_in_H⟩ : H) ∈ eH.P := hs
      have : IsPSingular p (⟨s, s_in_H⟩ : H) := (eH.mem_P_iff_pSingular).mp hsH
      exact (IsPSingular.subtype_iff p (x := ⟨s, s_in_H⟩)).2 this
    · have h_comm := P_of_Z_le_Z (p := p) r hs
      simp only [Subgroup.mem_centralizer_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff] at h_comm
      exact (commute_iff_eq r s).mpr (h_comm r rfl)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.card_fixedPoints_pSingular_modEq
statement:
lemma card_fixedPoints_pSingular_modEq
    [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (H : Subgroup G) [H.FiniteIndex] (s : G) (hs : IsPSingular p s) :
    Nat.card { c : G ⧸ H // s • c = c } ≡ Nat.card (G ⧸ H) [MOD p]
proof:
:= by
  let zs := Subgroup.zpowers s
  have h_pgroup : IsPGroup p zs := by
    intro ⟨g, hg⟩
    rcases hs with ⟨k, hk⟩
    use k
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hg
    ext
    simp only [Subgroup.coe_pow, Subgroup.coe_one]
    rw [← zpow_natCast, ← zpow_mul, mul_comm, zpow_mul, zpow_natCast]
    have hs_one : s ^ (p ^ k) = 1 := by rw [← hk, pow_orderOf_eq_one]
    rw [hs_one, one_zpow]

  have h_fix_eq : Nat.card { c : G ⧸ H // s • c = c } =
                  Nat.card (MulAction.fixedPoints zs (G ⧸ H)) := by
    apply Nat.card_congr
    refine { toFun := fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ⟨c, ?_⟩,
             invFun := fun ⟨c, hc⟩ => ⟨c, ?_⟩,
             left_inv := fun _ => by ext; rfl,
             right_inv := fun _ => by ext; rfl }
    · intro ⟨g, hg⟩
      let cStab : Subgroup G := MulAction.stabilizer G c
      have hs_cStab : s ∈ cStab := by change s • c = c;  simpa using hc
      rcases (Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hg) with ⟨n, rfl⟩
      have : (s ^ n) ∈ cStab := by exact cStab.zpow_mem hs_cStab n
      exact MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff.mp this
    · exact hc ⟨s, Subgroup.mem_zpowers s⟩

  rw [h_fix_eq]
  exact (h_pgroup.card_modEq_card_fixedPoints (G ⧸ H)).symm

name: BrauerInduction.IsPElementary.ofMulEquiv
statement:
lemma ofMulEquiv
    (p : ℕ)
    {G : Type u} {G' : Type v} [Group G] [Group G']
    (hG : IsPElementary p G) (e : G ≃* G') :
    IsPElementary p G'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨eG⟩ := hG
  exact ⟨PElementary.ofMulEquiv eG e⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsPElementary.iff
statement:
lemma iff :
    IsPElementary p G ↔ ∃ (C P : Subgroup G),
      IsCyclic C ∧ IsPGroup p P ∧
      (∀ {c : G}, c ∈ C → IsPRegular p c) ∧
      (∀ {c q : G}, c ∈ C → q ∈ P → Commute c q) ∧
      (∀ h : G, ∃ c ∈ C, ∃ q ∈ P, c * q = h)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hG
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hG
    exact ⟨e.C, e.P, e.C_isCyclic, e.P_isPGroup,
           e.C_isPRegular, e.comm, e.decompose⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨C, P, C_cyc, P_pg, C_reg, comm, decomp⟩ := h
    exact ⟨{
      C := C,
      P := P,
      C_isCyclic := C_cyc,
      P_isPGroup := P_pg,
      C_isPRegular := C_reg,
      comm := comm,
      decompose := decomp
    }⟩

name: BrauerInduction.IsPElementary.ofIsPGroup
statement:
lemma ofIsPGroup
    (hG : IsPGroup p G) : IsPElementary p G
proof:
:= by
  rw [IsPElementary.iff]
  refine ⟨⊥, ⊤, isCyclic_of_subsingleton, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact IsPGroup.of_equiv hG Subgroup.topEquiv.symm
  · intro c hc
    rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact IsPRegular.one p
  · intro c q hc _
    rw [Subgroup.mem_bot] at hc
    rw [hc]
    exact Commute.one_left q
  · intro g
    use 1, Subgroup.one_mem ⊥, g, Subgroup.mem_top g
    rw [one_mul]

name: BrauerInduction.IsPElementary.of_isCyclic
statement:
lemma of_isCyclic [Finite G] [h_cyc : IsCyclic G]
    [Fact p.Prime] : IsPElementary p G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  let x := Classical.choose (IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := G))
  have hx_gen := Classical.choose_spec (IsCyclic.exists_generator (α := G))
  have hfx : IsOfFinOrder x := isOfFinOrder_of_finite x
  let x_reg  := Group.pRegular p x
  let x_sing := Group.pSingular p x
  exact {
    C := Subgroup.zpowers x_reg
    P := Subgroup.zpowers x_sing
    C_isCyclic := Subgroup.isCyclic_zpowers x_reg
    P_isPGroup := by
      rw [← IsPSingular.iff_zpowers_isPGroup]
      exact Group.isPSingular_pSingular p x
    C_isPRegular := by
      intro c hc
      have h_dvd : orderOf c ∣ orderOf x_reg := orderOf_dvd_of_mem_zpowers hc
      have h_reg_gen : IsPRegular p x_reg := Group.isPRegular_pRegular p hfx
      exact Nat.Coprime.coprime_dvd_left h_dvd h_reg_gen
    comm := by
      intro c s hc hs
      obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hc
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp hs
      apply Commute.zpow_zpow
      exact Group.pRegular_pSingular_commute p rfl
    decompose := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Subgroup.mem_zpowers_iff.mp (hx_gen h)
      use x_reg ^ k, Subgroup.zpow_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers x_reg) k
      use x_sing ^ k, Subgroup.zpow_mem _ (Subgroup.mem_zpowers x_sing) k
      rw [← Commute.mul_zpow (Group.pDecomp_commute p x).symm]
      rw [Group.pDecomp' p hfx]
      exact hk
  }

name: BrauerInduction.IsPElementary.bot
statement:
lemma bot [Fact p.Prime] :
      IsPElementary (G := (⊥ : Subgroup G)) p
proof:
:= by
  exact ofIsPGroup (p := p) (G := (⊥ : Subgroup G)) IsPGroup.of_bot

name: BrauerInduction.IsPElementary.zpowers_of_isOfFinOrder
statement:
lemma zpowers_of_isOfFinOrder [Fact p.Prime]
    (x : G) (hx : IsOfFinOrder x) :
    IsPElementary p (Subgroup.zpowers x)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : Finite (Subgroup.zpowers x) := Finite.of_equiv _ (finEquivZPowers hx)
  exact of_isCyclic (p := p) (G := Subgroup.zpowers x)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_isPElementary
statement:
lemma E_isPElementary
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    IsPElementary p (E_subgroup p a)
proof:
:=
     ⟨PElementary.associatedSubgroup ha⟩

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_le_centralizer
statement:
lemma E_le_centralizer (a : G) :
    E_subgroup p a ≤ Subgroup.centralizer {a}
proof:
:= by
  rw [E_subgroup, sup_le_iff]
  constructor
  · exact Subgroup.zpowers_le_centralizer a
  · exact PElementary.P_of_Z_le_Z a

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_commutes_with_a
statement:
lemma E_commutes_with_a (a : G)
    (y : E_subgroup p a) :
    (y : G) * a * (y : G)⁻¹ = a
proof:
:= by
  have hy : (y : G) ∈ Subgroup.centralizer {a} := E_le_centralizer p a y.property
  have h_comm : (y : G) * a = a * (y : G) := by exact Eq.symm (SemiconjBy.eq (hy a rfl))
  calc (y : G) * a * (y : G)⁻¹
    _ = a * (y : G) * (y : G)⁻¹ := by rw [h_comm]
    _ = a := by rw [mul_inv_cancel_right]

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.self_mem_E_subgroup
statement:
lemma self_mem_E_subgroup (a : G) :
    a ∈ E_subgroup p a
proof:
:= by
  refine (le_sup_left : Cyc a ≤ E_subgroup p a) ?_
  exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers a

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.inv_mem_E_subgroup
statement:
lemma inv_mem_E_subgroup (a : G) :
    a⁻¹ ∈ E_subgroup p a
proof:
:=
  (E_subgroup p a).inv_mem (self_mem_E_subgroup p a)

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_to_Cyc_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma E_to_Cyc_apply [Fact p.Prime]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    E_to_Cyc p a ha x =
      E_Cyc_equiv (p := p) a ha
        (((PElementary.mulEquivProd
          (PElementary.associatedSubgroup (p := p) ha)).symm x).1)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_to_Cyc_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma E_to_Cyc_apply_coe [Fact p.Prime]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (x : E_subgroup p a) :
    ((E_to_Cyc p a ha x : PElementary.Cyc a) : G) =
      (((((PElementary.mulEquivProd
        (PElementary.associatedSubgroup (p := p) ha)).symm x).1 :
          (PElementary.associatedSubgroup (p := p) ha).C) :
          (PElementary.Cyc a ⊔ PElementary.P_of_Z p a : Subgroup G)) : G)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_Cyc_equiv_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp]
lemma E_Cyc_equiv_apply_coe [Fact p.Prime]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a)
    (c : (associatedSubgroup (p := p) ha).C) :
    ((E_Cyc_equiv (p := p) a ha c : Cyc a) : G) =
      ((c : (Cyc a ⊔ P_of_Z p a : Subgroup G)) : G)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: BrauerInduction.PElementary.E_card
statement:
lemma E_card [Fact p.Prime] [Finite G]
    {a : G} (ha : IsPRegular p a) :
    Nat.card (E_subgroup p a) =
      orderOf a * Nat.card (P_of_Z p a)
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G

  let H : Subgroup G := E_subgroup p a

  let eH := associatedSubgroup (p := p) ha
  let h_iso : eH.C × eH.P ≃* H := mulEquivProd eH

  have hH :
      Nat.card H = Nat.card (eH.C × eH.P) := by
    simpa using Nat.card_congr h_iso.toEquiv.symm

  have hC :
      Nat.card eH.C = orderOf a := by
    have hCcard :
        Nat.card eH.C = Nat.card (Cyc a) := by
      simpa using
        Nat.card_congr
          (E_Cyc_equiv (p := p) a ha).toEquiv
    rw [hCcard]
    simpa [Cyc] using Nat.card_zpowers a

  have hP :
      Nat.card eH.P = Nat.card (P_of_Z p a) := by
    simpa using
      Nat.card_congr
        (E_P_equiv (p := p) a ha).toEquiv

  calc
    Nat.card H
        = Nat.card (eH.C × eH.P) := hH
    _ = Nat.card eH.C * Nat.card eH.P := by
        simp
    _ = orderOf a * Nat.card (P_of_Z p a) := by
        rw [hC, hP]

name: FDRep.IsZero_biproduct_empty

name: FDRep.exists_equiv_of_iso_counts
statement:
lemma exists_equiv_of_iso_counts
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (f : ι → FDRep k G) (g : κ → FDRep k G)
    (hcount_f :
      ∀ i₀ : ι,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (f i₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (f i₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0))
    (hcount_g :
      ∀ j₀ : κ,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0)) :
    ∃ σ : ι ≃ κ, ∀ i, Nonempty (f i ≅ g (σ i))
proof:
:= by
  let Setoid_ι : Setoid ι :=
    { r := fun i i' => Nonempty (f i ≅ f i')
      iseqv :=
        ⟨ fun _ => ⟨Iso.refl _⟩,
          fun ⟨h⟩ => ⟨h.symm⟩,
          fun ⟨h1⟩ ⟨h2⟩ => ⟨h1.trans h2⟩ ⟩ }

  let Classes := Quotient Setoid_ι
  let classOf : ι → Classes := Quotient.mk Setoid_ι

  have h_surj (j : κ) : ∃ i, Nonempty (f i ≅ g j) := by
    by_contra h_none
    push Not at h_none

    have h_lhs_zero :
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (g j ≅ f i) then 1 else 0) = 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
      intro i _
      rw [if_neg]
      intro h
      rcases h with ⟨e⟩
      exact @IsEmpty.false (f i ≅ g j) (h_none i) e.symm

    have h_rhs_pos :
        1 ≤ ∑ x : κ, if Nonempty (g j ≅ g x) then 1 else 0 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_add_sum_sdiff_singleton_of_mem]
      · rw [if_pos ⟨Iso.refl _⟩]
        exact Nat.le_add_right 1 _
      · simp

    have h_eq := hcount_g j
    rw [h_lhs_zero] at h_eq
    rw [← h_eq] at h_rhs_pos
    exact Nat.not_succ_le_zero 0 h_rhs_pos

  let classOf' (j : κ) : Classes :=
    Quotient.mk Setoid_ι (Classical.choose (h_surj j))

  have card_fibers_eq :
      ∀ c : Classes,
        Fintype.card { i // classOf i = c } =
          Fintype.card { j // classOf' j = c } := by
    intro c
    obtain ⟨rep, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep c

    have hS := hcount_f rep
    simp only [Finset.sum_boole] at hS

    rw [Fintype.card_subtype (fun i => classOf i = ⟦rep⟧),
        Fintype.card_subtype (fun j => classOf' j = ⟦rep⟧)]

    have h_left :
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => Nonempty (f rep ≅ f x))).card =
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => classOf i = ⟦rep⟧)).card := by
      apply congrArg
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro i _
      rw [Quotient.eq]
      constructor
      · intro h
        exact ⟨h.some.symm⟩
      · intro h
        exact ⟨h.some.symm⟩

    have h_right :
        (Finset.univ.filter (fun x => Nonempty (f rep ≅ g x))).card =
          (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => classOf' j = ⟦rep⟧)).card := by
      apply congrArg
      apply Finset.filter_congr
      intro j _
      rw [Quotient.eq]
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h_link := Classical.choose_spec (h_surj j)
        exact ⟨h_link.some.trans h.some.symm⟩
      · intro h
        have h_link := Classical.choose_spec (h_surj j)
        exact ⟨h.some.symm.trans h_link.some⟩

    rw [h_left, h_right] at hS
    exact hS

  let e1 : ι ≃ (c : Classes) × { i // classOf i = c } :=
    (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv classOf).symm

  let e_mid :
      ((c : Classes) × { i // classOf i = c }) ≃
        ((c : Classes) × { j // classOf' j = c }) :=
    Equiv.sigmaCongrRight
      (fun c => Fintype.equivOfCardEq (card_fibers_eq c))

  let e2 : κ ≃ (c : Classes) × { j // classOf' j = c } :=
    (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv classOf').symm

  let σ := e1.trans (e_mid.trans e2.symm)

  refine ⟨σ, ?_⟩
  intro i

  have h_classes_eq : classOf' (σ i) = classOf i := by
    let y := e_mid (e1 i)

    have h_proj : classOf' (e2.symm y) = y.1 := by
      change classOf' (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv classOf' y) = y.1
      rw [Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv_apply]
      exact y.snd.property

    have h_mid : y.1 = (e1 i).1 := rfl

    have h_first : (e1 i).1 = classOf i := by
      rw [Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv_symm_apply_fst]

    dsimp [σ]
    rw [h_proj, h_mid, h_first]

  rw [Quotient.eq] at h_classes_eq
  obtain ⟨h_iso_fiber⟩ := h_classes_eq
  obtain ⟨h_link⟩ := Classical.choose_spec (h_surj (σ i))
  exact ⟨h_iso_fiber.symm.trans h_link⟩

name: FDRep.biproduct_iso_of_iso_counts
statement:
theorem biproduct_iso_of_iso_counts
    {ι κ : Type} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]
    (f : ι → FDRep k G) (g : κ → FDRep k G)
    [HasBiproduct f] [HasBiproduct g]
    (hcount_f :
      ∀ i₀ : ι,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (f i₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (f i₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0))
    (hcount_g :
      ∀ j₀ : κ,
        (∑ i, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ f i) then 1 else 0)
          =
        (∑ j, if Nonempty (g j₀ ≅ g j) then 1 else 0)) :
    Nonempty ((⨁ f) ≅ (⨁ g))
proof:
:= by
  rcases exists_equiv_of_iso_counts f g hcount_f hcount_g with ⟨σ, hσ⟩
  exact ⟨FDRep.biproductIsoOfReindex
    (k := k) (G := G) (f := f) (g := g) σ hσ⟩

name: FDRep.finrank_hom_to_biproduct_eq_sum
statement:
lemma finrank_hom_to_biproduct_eq_sum
    {ι : Type wι} [Fintype ι]
    {k : Type u} {G : Type v} [Field k] [Monoid G]
    (S : FDRep k G) (f : ι → FDRep k G)
    [HasBiproduct f] :
    Module.finrank k (S ⟶ ⨁ f) =
      ∑ i, Module.finrank k (S ⟶ f i)
proof:
:= by
  let e := hom_to_biproduct_linearEquiv (k := k) (G := G) S f
  calc
    Module.finrank k (S ⟶ ⨁ f)
        = Module.finrank k (∀ i, S ⟶ f i) := LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e
    _ = ∑ i, Module.finrank k (S ⟶ f i) := by
        simpa using
          (Module.finrank_pi_fintype k :
            Module.finrank k (∀ i, S ⟶ f i) =
              ∑ i, Module.finrank k (S ⟶ f i))

name: FDRep.finrank_biprod
statement:
lemma finrank_biprod (X Y : FDRep k G) :
      (X ⊞ Y).finrank = X.finrank + Y.finrank
proof:
:= by
  have e := FDRep.linearEquivBiprod (X := X) (Y := Y)
  have h :
      (X ⊞ Y).finrank = Module.finrank k ( X.V.obj × Y.V.obj ) := LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e
  rw [h,Module.finrank_prod]

      Nat.card (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel I)) * finrank σ
proof:

    FDRep.finrank_coind_of_basis
      (I := I) (σ := σ)

name: FDRep.finrank_ind_rightRel
statement:
theorem finrank_ind_rightRel
    (I : Subgroup G)

    (FDRep.ind I σ).finrank =
      Nat.card (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel I)) * σ.finrank
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (FDRep.ind I σ).finrank
        = (FDRep.coind I σ).finrank := by
            exact finrank_congr (FDRep.indIsoCoind I σ)
    _ = Nat.card (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel I)) * σ.finrank := by
            simpa [finrank] using FDRep.finrank_coind_rightRel I σ

name: FDRep.CoindBaseChange.coindComap_apply_eq_of_mul_inv_mem_kernel
statement:
private lemma coindComap_apply_eq_of_mul_inv_mem_kernel
    [Finite G]
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    (Q : Subgroup (G ⧸ K))
    (σ : FDRep k Q)
    {x y : G}
    (hxy : x * y⁻¹ ∈ K)
    (w :
      (FDRep.coind (quotientPreimage K Q)
        (FDRep.comap (quotientPreimageMap K Q) σ))) :
    w.val x = w.val y
proof:
:= by
  let π : G →* G ⧸ K := quotientMap K
  let H : Subgroup G := quotientPreimage K Q
  let π_res : H →* Q := quotientPreimageMap K Q
  have hπ : π (x * y⁻¹) = 1 := by
    simpa [π, quotientMap] using
      ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff (N := K) (x := x * y⁻¹)).mpr hxy)
  let h : H :=
    ⟨x * y⁻¹, by
      change π (x * y⁻¹) ∈ Q
      rw [hπ]
      exact Q.one_mem⟩
  have hw := w.property h y
  change
    w.val ((x * y⁻¹) * y)  = σ.ρ (π_res h) (w.val y)  at hw
  have hxy_mul : (x * y⁻¹) * y = x := by
    group
  have hπ_res : π_res h = 1 := by
    ext
    change π (x * y⁻¹) = 1
    exact hπ
  rw [hxy_mul] at hw
  rw [hπ_res, map_one] at hw
  simpa using hw

name: FDRep.CoindBaseChange.coindComap_apply_eq_of_quotientMap_eq
statement:
private lemma coindComap_apply_eq_of_quotientMap_eq
    [Finite G]
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    (Q : Subgroup (G ⧸ K))
    (σ : FDRep k Q)
    {x y : G}
    (hxy : quotientMap K x = quotientMap K y)
    (w :
      (FDRep.coind (quotientPreimage K Q)
        (FDRep.comap (quotientPreimageMap K Q) σ))) :
    w.val x = w.val y
proof:
:= by
  apply coindComap_apply_eq_of_mul_inv_mem_kernel K Q σ ?_ w

  have hπ : quotientMap K (x * y⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [MonoidHom.map_mul, MonoidHom.map_inv, hxy, mul_inv_cancel]

  exact
    ((QuotientGroup.eq_one_iff
      (N := K) (x := x * y⁻¹)).mp
      (by simpa [quotientMap] using hπ))

name: FDRep.exists_scalar_action_of_simple_abelian
statement:
lemma exists_scalar_action_of_simple_abelian
    [IsMulCommutative G] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ] (g : G) :
    ∃ c : k, ρ.ρ g = c • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
    CategoryTheory.endomorphism_simple_eq_smul_id
      (𝕜 := k) (f := FDRep.endoOfAction ρ g)
  refine ⟨c, ?_⟩
  ext v
  have h :=
    congrArg
      (fun f : ρ ⟶ ρ => FDRep.homToLinearMap f v)
      hc
  change ρ.ρ g v = c • v
  calc
    ρ.ρ g v
        = FDRep.homToLinearMap (FDRep.endoOfAction ρ g) v := by
            rw [FDRep.endoOfAction_hom_apply]
    _ = FDRep.homToLinearMap (c • 𝟙 ρ : ρ ⟶ ρ) v := by
            exact h.symm
    _ = c • v := by
            rfl

name: FDRep.abelian_simple_is_linear
statement:
lemma abelian_simple_is_linear
    [IsMulCommutative G] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ] :
    Module.finrank k ρ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hρnz : Nontrivial ρ := FDRep.nontrivial_of_simple ρ
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ : ∃ v : ρ, v ≠ 0 := by
    exact exists_ne (0 : ρ)
  let W : Submodule k ρ := Submodule.span k ({v} : Set ρ)
  have hstable : ∀ g : G, W ≤ W.comap (ρ.ρ g) := by
    intro g x hx
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      FDRep.exists_scalar_action_of_simple_abelian (ρ := ρ) g
    change ρ.ρ g x ∈ W
    rw [hc]
    exact W.smul_mem c hx
  let σ : FDRep k G := FDRep.ofSubmodule ρ W hstable
  let i : σ ⟶ ρ := FDRep.ofSubmoduleIncl ρ W hstable
  haveI : Mono i := by
    apply ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective
      (C := FDRep k G)
    exact
      (Set.injective_codRestrict Subtype.property).mp
        fun ⦃a₁ a₂⦄ h ↦ h
  have hi_ne : i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    have h_app :
        FDRep.homToLinearMap i
            (⟨v, Submodule.subset_span (by simp)⟩ : W)
          =
        FDRep.homToLinearMap (0 : σ ⟶ ρ)
            (⟨v, Submodule.subset_span (by simp)⟩ : W) := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun f : σ ⟶ ρ =>
          FDRep.homToLinearMap f
            (⟨v, Submodule.subset_span (by simp)⟩ : W))
        hi
    have hv0 : v = 0 := not_neZero.mp fun a ↦ hv h_app
    exact hv hv0
  haveI : IsIso i := isIso_of_mono_of_nonzero (f := i) hi_ne
  have hWtop : W = ⊤ := by
    apply eq_top_iff.mpr
    intro x hx
    let y : W := (inv i).hom x
    have hy : i.hom y = x := by
      change ((inv i ≫ i).hom) x = ((𝟙 ρ : ρ ⟶ ρ).hom) x
      rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id i]
    have hyW : (y : ρ) ∈ W := y.2
    simpa [i, FDRep.ofSubmoduleIncl_apply] using hy ▸ hyW
  have hspan_top :
      k ∙ v = (⊤ : Submodule k ρ) := by
    simpa [W] using hWtop
  exact (finrank_eq_one_iff_of_nonzero v hv).2 hspan_top

name: FDRep.exists_iso_biprod_of_splitMono
statement:
lemma exists_iso_biprod_of_splitMono
    {G : Type v} [Monoid G]
    {S V : FDRep k G} (f : S ⟶ V) (sf : SplitMono f) :
    Nonempty (V ≅ S ⊞ cokernel f)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsSplitMono f := ⟨⟨sf⟩⟩
  have i₀ :
      IsColimit
        (Cofork.ofπ (cokernel.π f)
          ((cokernel.condition f).trans zero_comp.symm)) :=
    cokernelIsCokernel (f := f)
  have i : IsColimit
      (CokernelCofork.ofπ (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)) := by
    simpa [CokernelCofork.ofπ] using i₀
  let b := binaryBiconeOfIsSplitMonoOfCokernel (f := f) i
  have hb : b.IsBilimit :=
    isBilimitBinaryBiconeOfIsSplitMonoOfCokernel (f := f) i
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  simpa [b] using
    (biprod.uniqueUpToIso (X := S) (Y := cokernel f) hb)

name: FDRep.exists_simple_subobject
statement:
theorem exists_simple_subobject
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G]
    [Finite G] [hne : NeZero (Nat.card G : k)]
    (V : FDRep k G) (hV : ¬ IsZero V) :
    ∃ (S : FDRep k G) (f : S ⟶ V), Simple S ∧ Mono f
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_nz : Nontrivial V := by
    by_contra hnt
    have hsub : Subsingleton V :=
      not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hnt
    exact hV ((isZero_iff_subsingleton V).mpr hsub)
  let P : ℕ → Prop := fun n =>
    ∀ (V' : FDRep k G), Nontrivial V' → Module.finrank k V' ≤ n →
      ∃ (S : FDRep k G) (f : S ⟶ V'), Simple S ∧ Mono f

  have hP : ∀ n, P n := by
    intro n
    refine Nat.strong_induction_on n ?_
    intro m ih V' h_nz' hn'
    by_cases h_simp : Simple V'
    · exact ⟨V', 𝟙 V', h_simp, inferInstance⟩
    · haveI : Nontrivial V' := h_nz'
      have h_not_simp :
          ¬ (∀ (W : FDRep k G) (f : W ⟶ V') [Mono f],
              IsIso f ∨ f = 0) := by
        intro h
        apply h_simp
        refine ⟨?_⟩
        intro W f hf_mono
        haveI : Mono f := hf_mono
        constructor
        · intro hf_iso
          haveI : IsIso f := hf_iso
          exact isIso_hom_ne_zero_of_nontrivial
              (k := k) (G := G) (W := W) (V := V') f
        · intro hf_ne
          rcases h W f with hf_iso | hf_zero
          · exact hf_iso
          · exact False.elim (hf_ne hf_zero)
      push Not at h_not_simp
      rcases h_not_simp with ⟨W, f, h_mono, h_not_iso, hf_ne_zero⟩
      haveI : Mono f := h_mono
      
      haveI sm : SplitMono f := splitMono_of_mono f
      let Q : FDRep k G := CategoryTheory.Limits.cokernel f
      have h_iso : Nonempty (V' ≅ W ⊞ Q) := by
        simpa [Q] using exists_iso_biprod_of_splitMono f sm
      let iso : V' ≅ W ⊞ Q := h_iso.some
      have h_dim_sum :
          Module.finrank k V' =
            Module.finrank k W + Module.finrank k Q := by
        have e1 : V' ≃ₗ[k] (W ⊞ Q : FDRep k G) :=
          FDRep.isoToLinearEquiv iso
        have e2 : (W ⊞ Q : FDRep k G) ≃ₗ[k] W × Q :=
          linearEquivBiprod W Q
        have e : V' ≃ₗ[k] W × Q :=
          e1.trans e2
        calc
          Module.finrank k V'
              = Module.finrank k (W × Q) :=
                  LinearEquiv.finrank_eq e
          _ = Module.finrank k W + Module.finrank k Q :=
                  Module.finrank_prod
      have h_pos_coker : 0 < Module.finrank k Q := by
        apply Nat.pos_of_ne_zero
        intro h_zero_dim
        have h_zero : IsZero Q :=
          (finrank_eq_zero_iff_IsZero Q).mp h_zero_dim
        haveI : Epi f := by
          dsimp [Q] at h_zero
          exact (Preadditive.epi_iff_isZero_cokernel f).mpr h_zero
        haveI : IsIso f := isIso_of_mono_of_epi f
        exact h_not_iso inferInstance
      
      have h_dim_W : Module.finrank k W < Module.finrank k V' := by
        rw [h_dim_sum]
        exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ h_pos_coker
      have h_nz_W : Nontrivial W := by
        by_contra hc
        have h_sub : Subsingleton W := not_nontrivial_iff_subsingleton.mp hc
        have h_zero : IsZero W := (isZero_iff_subsingleton W).mpr h_sub
        exact hf_ne_zero (h_zero.eq_of_src f 0)
      
      have h_lt : Module.finrank k W < m := lt_of_lt_of_le h_dim_W hn'
      rcases ih (Module.finrank k W) h_lt W h_nz_W le_rfl with ⟨S, g, hS_simp, hg_mono⟩
      
      exact ⟨S, g ≫ f, hS_simp, inferInstance⟩
  
  exact hP (Module.finrank k V) V h_nz le_rfl

name: FDRep.exists_simple_decomposition
statement:
theorem exists_simple_decomposition
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G]
    [Finite G] [NeZero (Nat.card G : k)] (V : FDRep k G) :
    ∃ (ι : Type) (f : ι → FDRep k G) (_ : Fintype ι)
      (_ : ∀ i, Simple (f i)), Nonempty (V ≅ ⨁ f)
proof:
:= by
  let P : ℕ → Prop :=
    fun n =>
      ∀ V : FDRep k G,
        finrank V = n →
        ∃ (ι : Type) (f : ι → FDRep k G) (_ : Fintype ι)
          (_ : ∀ i, Simple (f i)), Nonempty (V ≅ ⨁ f)
  have hP : ∀ n, P n := by
    intro n
    refine Nat.strong_induction_on n ?step
    intro n IH V h_dim
    cases n with
    | zero =>
        have hV0 : IsZero V := by
          exact (finrank_eq_zero_iff_IsZero V).mp h_dim
        let ι : Type := PEmpty
        let f : ι → FDRep k G := fun i => PEmpty.elim i
        letI : Fintype ι := Fintype.ofFinite ι
        have hB0 : IsZero (⨁ f) :=
          IsZero_biproduct_empty f
        have h_simples : ∀ i : ι, Simple (f i) := by
          intro i
          cases i
        have hIso : V ≅ ⨁ f :=
          hV0.iso hB0
        exact ⟨ι, f, inferInstance, h_simples, ⟨hIso⟩⟩
    | succ n =>
        have hV_not_IsZero : ¬ IsZero V := by
          intro hzero
          have hz : finrank V = 0 :=
            (finrank_eq_zero_iff_IsZero V).mpr hzero
          have hsucc : Nat.succ n = 0 := by
            simp [h_dim] at hz
          exact Nat.succ_ne_zero n hsucc
        obtain ⟨S, f, hS_simple, hf_mono⟩ :=
          exists_simple_subobject V hV_not_IsZero
        haveI : Mono f := hf_mono
        let sf : SplitMono f :=
          splitMono_of_mono f
        let K := cokernel f
        obtain ⟨iso_split⟩ :=
          exists_iso_biprod_of_splitMono f sf
        have hsum :
            finrank (S ⊞ K) = finrank S + finrank K := finrank_biprod S K
        have hV_eq :
            finrank (S ⊞ K) = Nat.succ n := by
          simpa [K] using (finrank_congr iso_split.symm).trans h_dim
        have hS_pos : 0 < finrank S := by
          have hnot : ¬ IsZero S := Simple.not_isZero S
          have hne : finrank S ≠ 0 := by
            intro hz
            exact hnot ((finrank_eq_zero_iff_IsZero S).mp hz)
          exact Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hne
        have hSK : finrank S + finrank K = Nat.succ n := by
          simpa [hsum] using hV_eq
        have hK_lt : finrank K < Nat.succ n := by
          have hlt : finrank K < finrank S + finrank K :=
            Nat.lt_add_of_pos_left hS_pos
          exact hlt.trans_eq hSK
        rcases IH (finrank K) hK_lt K rfl with
          ⟨ι, g, hι, hg_simple, ⟨isoK⟩⟩
        have iso₀ : V ≅ S ⊞ (⨁ g) :=
          iso_split ≪≫ (biprod.mapIso (Iso.refl S) isoK)
        let ι' := Option ι
        let f' : ι' → FDRep k G := fun t => Option.rec S g t
        haveI : Fintype ι' := inferInstance
        have hf'_simple : ∀ i', Simple (f' i') := by
          intro i'
          cases i' with
          | none =>
              simpa [f'] using hS_simple
          | some i =>
              simpa [f'] using hg_simple i
        have iso₁ : S ⊞ (⨁ g) ≅ ⨁ f' := by
          simpa [f'] using (FDRep.biproductOptionIso (S := S) (K := g))
        exact ⟨ι', f', inferInstance, hf'_simple, ⟨iso₀ ≪≫ iso₁⟩⟩
  exact hP (finrank V) V rfl

statement:

    (h : ∀ x : V,

        =
      (((forget₂ (FDRep k G) (Rep k G)).map g).hom x)) :

proof:
:= by

  apply Rep.hom_ext
  ext x

name: FDRep.hom_comp_ρ
statement:
lemma hom_comp_ρ {X Y : FDRep k G} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : G) :
    f.hom.hom.hom ∘ₗ X.ρ g = Y.ρ g ∘ₗ f.hom.hom.hom
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  have h_cat := Action.Hom.comm f g
  let h := congr_arg (fun φ => φ.hom.hom) h_cat
  change f.hom.hom.hom ∘ₗ X.ρ g = Y.ρ g ∘ₗ f.hom.hom.hom at h
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: FDRep.homToLinearMap_comm
statement:
lemma homToLinearMap_comm
    {V W : FDRep k G} (f : V ⟶ W) (g : G) (x : V) :
    homToLinearMap f (V.ρ g x) =
      W.ρ g (homToLinearMap f x)
proof:
:= by
  let F := (forget₂ (FDRep k G) (Rep k G)).map f
  change F.hom (V.ρ g x) = W.ρ g (F.hom x)
  exact
    Representation.IntertwiningMap.isIntertwining ((forget₂ (FDRep k G) (Rep k G)).obj V).ρ
      ((forget₂ (FDRep k G) (Rep k G)).obj W).ρ (Rep.Hom.hom F) g x

name: FDRep.forget₂HomLinearEquiv_symm_apply

lemma forget₂HomLinearEquiv_symm_apply

      (forget₂ (FDRep k G) (Rep k G)).map f
