proof:
:= by
  ext v
  exact LinearMap.congr_fun (action_naturality f α) v

name: ClassFun.actionHom_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma actionHom_eq_zero_iff [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G) :
    actionHom f V = 0 ↔ ClassFun.action f V = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    ext v
    have hv :=
      congrArg (fun m : V ⟶ V => FDRep.homToLinearMap m v) h
    exact LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.mp hv
  · intro h
    ext v
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v

name: ClassFun.trace_action_eq_scalar_mul_finrank
statement:
lemma trace_action_eq_scalar_mul_finrank
    [Fintype G] (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G)
    (lambda : k) (h : actionHom f V = lambda • 𝟙 V) :
    LinearMap.trace k V (action f V) =
      lambda * (Module.finrank k V : k)
proof:
:= by
  let F : (V ⟶ V) → (V →ₗ[k] V) :=
    fun m => FDRep.homToLinearMap m

  have h_map :
      F (actionHom f V) = F (lambda • 𝟙 V) :=
    congrArg F h

  have h_LHS :
      F (actionHom f V) = action f V := by
    rfl

  have h_RHS :
      F (lambda • 𝟙 V) =
        lambda • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[k] V) := by
    ext v
    rfl

  have h_lin :
      action f V =
        lambda • (LinearMap.id : V →ₗ[k] V) := by
    simpa [h_LHS, h_RHS] using h_map

  rw [h_lin]
  simp only [map_smul, LinearMap.trace_id, smul_eq_mul]

name: ClassFun.actionHom_is_scalar
statement:
lemma actionHom_is_scalar [Fintype G] [IsAlgClosed k]
  (f : ClassFun k G) (V : FDRep k G) [Simple V] :
    ∃ lambda : k, actionHom f V = lambda • 𝟙 V
proof:
:= by
  exact FDRep.end_eq_smul_id_of_simple V (actionHom f V)

name: ClassFun.action_zero_of_iso
statement:
lemma action_zero_of_iso
    [Fintype G]
    (f : ClassFun k G)
    {A B : FDRep k G}
    (e : A ≅ B)
    (hB : ClassFun.action f B = 0) :
    ClassFun.action f A = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (actionHom_eq_zero_iff f A).mp

  have hBhom : actionHom f B = 0 :=
    (actionHom_eq_zero_iff f B).mpr hB

  rw [← cancel_mono e.hom]
  simpa [hBhom] using
    actionHom_naturality f e.hom

name: ClassFun.action_eq_zero_iff_of_iso
statement:
lemma action_eq_zero_iff_of_iso [Fintype G]
    {V W : FDRep k G}
    (f : ClassFun k G) (e : V ≅ W) :
    action f V = 0 ↔ action f W = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact action_zero_of_iso f e.symm
  · exact action_zero_of_iso f e

name: ClassFun.actionHom_eq_zero_of_biproduct
statement:
lemma actionHom_eq_zero_of_biproduct
    [Fintype G] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (f : ClassFun k G) (S : ι → FDRep k G)
    (hS : ∀ i, ClassFun.action f (S i) = 0) :
    actionHom f (biproduct S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply biproduct.hom_ext
  intro i
  have hnat :
      actionHom f (biproduct S) ≫ biproduct.π S i =
        biproduct.π S i ≫ actionHom f (S i) :=
    actionHom_naturality f (biproduct.π S i)
  have hz : actionHom f (S i) = 0 :=
    (actionHom_eq_zero_iff f (S i)).mpr (hS i)
  rw [hz] at hnat
  simpa using hnat

name: ClassFun.action_zero_of_biproduct
statement:
lemma action_zero_of_biproduct
    [Fintype G] {ι : Type*} [Finite ι]
    (f : ClassFun k G) (S : ι → FDRep k G)
    (hS : ∀ i, ClassFun.action f (S i) = 0) :
    ClassFun.action f (biproduct S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact
    (actionHom_eq_zero_iff f (biproduct S)).mp
      (actionHom_eq_zero_of_biproduct f S hS)

name: ClassFun.eq_zero_of_action_leftRegular_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_action_leftRegular_eq_zero
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Fintype G] (f : ClassFun k G)
    (h_zero : ClassFun.action f (FDRep.leftRegular k G) = 0) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  ext g

  let R : FDRep k G := FDRep.leftRegular k G

  let v : R := by
    change MonoidAlgebra k G
    exact MonoidAlgebra.single 1 1

  let coeff : R →ₗ[k] k := by
    change MonoidAlgebra k G →ₗ[k] k
    exact
      (Finsupp.lapply g⁻¹).comp
        (MonoidAlgebra.coeffLinearEquiv k).toLinearMap

  have h_apply :
      ClassFun.action f R v = 0 := by
    change ClassFun.action f (FDRep.leftRegular k G) v = 0
    rw [h_zero]
    rfl

  have h_coeff_zero :
      coeff (ClassFun.action f R v) = 0 := by
    simpa using congrArg coeff h_apply

  have h_coeff_action :
      coeff (ClassFun.action f R v) = f g := by
    dsimp [ClassFun.action]
    rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
    rw [map_sum]

    have h_coeff_single (y : G) :
        coeff (MonoidAlgebra.single y (1 : k) : R)
          =
        if y = g⁻¹ then 1 else 0 := by
      dsimp only [coeff, R]
      exact Finsupp.single_apply

    have h_term :
        ∀ x : G,
          coeff (f x • R.ρ x⁻¹ v)
            =
          if x = g then f g else 0 := by
      intro x
      rw [map_smul]

      have h_rho :
          R.ρ x⁻¹ v =
            (MonoidAlgebra.single x⁻¹ (1 : k) : R) := by
        dsimp [R, v]
        simpa only [mul_one] using
          FDRep.leftRegular_rho_single
            (a := x⁻¹) (b := 1) (r := (1 : k))
      rw [h_rho, h_coeff_single]
      by_cases hx : x = g
      · subst x
        simp
      · have hne : x⁻¹ ≠ g⁻¹ := by
          intro h
          exact hx (inv_injective h)
        simp [hx, hne]
    calc
      (∑ x : G,
          coeff (((f x) • R.ρ x⁻¹ : R →ₗ[k] R) v))
          =
        ∑ x : G, if x = g then f g else 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro x _
          exact h_term x
      _ = f g := by
          simp

  rw [h_coeff_action] at h_coeff_zero
  exact h_coeff_zero

name: ClassFun.indSummand_mul_right
statement:
private lemma indSummand_mul_right
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H)
    (g x : G) (h : H) :
    indSummand H φ g (x * (h : G)) =
      indSummand H φ g x
proof:
:= by
  unfold indSummand
  have halg :
      (x * (h : G))⁻¹ * g * (x * (h : G)) =
        (h⁻¹ : H).val * (x⁻¹ * g * x) * (h : H).val := by
    simp only [mul_inv_rev, InvMemClass.coe_inv]
    group
  by_cases hx : x⁻¹ * g * x ∈ H
  · have hxh :
        (x * (h : G))⁻¹ * g * (x * (h : G)) ∈ H :=
      halg.symm ▸
        H.mul_mem
          (H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem h.property) hx)
          h.property
    simp only [dif_pos hx, dif_pos hxh]
    have hconj :
        IsConj
          (⟨(x * (h : G))⁻¹ * g * (x * (h : G)), hxh⟩ : H)
          (⟨x⁻¹ * g * x, hx⟩ : H) := by
      rw [isConj_iff]
      use h
      ext
      push_cast
      rw [halg]
      simp only [InvMemClass.coe_inv]
      group
    exact φ.map_conj _ _ hconj
  · have hxh :
        (x * (h : G))⁻¹ * g * (x * (h : G)) ∉ H := by
      intro hmem
      apply hx
      have halg_inv :
          x⁻¹ * g * x =
            (h : H).val *
              ((x * (h : G))⁻¹ * g * (x * (h : G))) *
              (h⁻¹ : H).val := by
        simp only [mul_inv_rev, InvMemClass.coe_inv]
        group
      exact halg_inv.symm ▸
        H.mul_mem
          (H.mul_mem h.property hmem)
          (H.inv_mem h.property)
    simp only [dif_neg hx, dif_neg hxh]

name: ClassFun.indSummand_conj_mul_left
statement:
private lemma indSummand_conj_mul_left
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H)
    {x y : G} (a z : G)
    (ha : a * x * a⁻¹ = y) :
    indSummand H φ y (a * z) =
      indSummand H φ x z
proof:
:= by
  unfold indSummand
  have harg :
      (a * z)⁻¹ * y * (a * z) =
        z⁻¹ * x * z := by
    rw [← ha]
    group
  rw [harg]

name: ClassFun.indSummand_smul_quotient
statement:
private lemma indSummand_smul_quotient
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H)
    {x y : G} (a : G)
    (ha : a * x * a⁻¹ = y)
    (q : G ⧸ H) :
    indSummand H φ y (a • q).out =
      indSummand H φ x q.out
proof:
:= by
  have hq :
      (a • q : G ⧸ H) =
        (↑(a * q.out) : G ⧸ H) := by
    rw [← QuotientGroup.out_eq' q]
    simpa using
      (MulAction.Quotient.smul_mk H a q.out)
  obtain ⟨h, hout⟩ :=
    QuotientGroup.mk_out_eq_mul H (a * q.out)
  have hout' :
      (a • q).out =
        a * q.out * (h : G) := by
    rw [hq]
    exact hout
  calc
    indSummand H φ y (a • q).out
        =
      indSummand H φ y
        ((a * q.out) * (h : G)) := by
          rw [hout']
    _ =
      indSummand H φ y (a * q.out) :=
        indSummand_mul_right H φ y (a * q.out) h
    _ =
      indSummand H φ x q.out :=
        indSummand_conj_mul_left H φ a q.out ha

name: ClassFun.ind_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ind_apply
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    ind H φ g =
      ∑ q : G ⧸ H,
        if hx : q.out⁻¹ * g * q.out ∈ H then
          φ ⟨q.out⁻¹ * g * q.out, hx⟩
        else
          0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ClassFun.ind_apply_rightCosets
statement:
lemma ind_apply_rightCosets
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    ind H φ g =
      ∑ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H),
        if hx : q.out * g * q.out⁻¹ ∈ H then
          φ ⟨q.out * g * q.out⁻¹, hx⟩
        else
          0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ind_apply]
  let e :
      Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) ≃ G ⧸ H :=
    QuotientGroup.quotientRightRelEquivQuotientLeftRel H
  change
    (∑ p : G ⧸ H, indSummand H φ g p.out) =
      ∑ q : Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H),
        if hx : q.out * g * q.out⁻¹ ∈ H then
          φ ⟨q.out * g * q.out⁻¹, hx⟩
        else
          0
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  have heq :
      e q = (↑(q.out⁻¹) : G ⧸ H) := by
    calc
      e q = e (Quotient.mk (QuotientGroup.rightRel H) q.out) := by
        exact congrArg e (Quotient.out_eq q).symm
      _ = (↑(q.out⁻¹) : G ⧸ H) := by
        rfl
  obtain ⟨h, hout⟩ := QuotientGroup.mk_out_eq_mul H q.out⁻¹
  have hout' : (e q).out = q.out⁻¹ * (h : G) := by
    rw [heq]
    exact hout
  calc
    indSummand H φ g (e q).out
        =
      indSummand H φ g (q.out⁻¹ * (h : G)) := by
        rw [hout']
    _ =
      indSummand H φ g q.out⁻¹ :=
        indSummand_mul_right H φ g q.out⁻¹ h
    _ =
      if hx : q.out * g * q.out⁻¹ ∈ H then
        φ ⟨q.out * g * q.out⁻¹, hx⟩
      else
        0 := by
      unfold indSummand
      simp only [inv_inv]

name: ClassFun.ind_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ind_add {H : Subgroup G} (φ ψ : ClassFun k H) :
    ind H (φ + ψ) = ind H φ + ind H ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [ind_apply, add_apply]
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro x _
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: ClassFun.ind_sum
statement:
lemma ind_sum (H : Subgroup G) {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (f : ι → ClassFun k H) :
    ind H (∑ i, f i) = ∑ i, ind H (f i)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp [ind_apply, Finset.sum_comm]

name: ClassFun.ind_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ind_zero {H : Subgroup G} :
    ind H (0 : ClassFun k H) = 0
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp [ind_apply, zero_apply, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: ClassFun.ind_apply_of_fintype
statement:
lemma ind_apply_of_fintype [Fintype G]
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    ind H φ g =
      ∑ q : G ⧸ H, indSummand H φ g q.out
proof:
:= by
  rw [ind_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr
  · ext q
    simp
  · intro q _
    rfl

name: ClassFun.ind_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ind_smul [Finite G]
    {H : Subgroup G} (r : R) (φ : ClassFun k H) :
    ind H (r • φ) = r • ind H φ
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [ind_apply, smul_apply]
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  by_cases hq : q.out⁻¹ * g * q.out ∈ H
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceDIte]
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceDIte, smul_zero]

name: ClassFun.indLinearMap_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma indLinearMap_apply [Finite G]
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H) :
    indLinearMap (R := R) H φ = ind H φ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: ClassFun.ind_zsmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ind_zsmul
    {H : Subgroup G} (n : ℤ) (φ : ClassFun k H) :
    ind H (n • φ) = n • ind H φ
proof:
:= by
  letI: Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
  exact ind_smul n φ

name: ClassFun.ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum
statement:
lemma ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    ind H φ g =
      (Nat.card H : k)⁻¹ *
        ∑ x : G,
          if hx : x⁻¹ * g * x ∈ H then
            φ ⟨x⁻¹ * g * x, hx⟩
          else
            0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ind_apply]
  let f : G → k := indSummand H φ g
  calc
    _ = ∑ q : G ⧸ H, f q.out := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr
      · ext q
        simp
      · intro q _
        rfl
    _ = (Nat.card H : k)⁻¹ * ∑ x : G, f x := by
      have hsum :
          (∑ x : G, f x) =
            (Nat.card H : k) * ∑ q : G ⧸ H, f q.out := by
        simpa using
          Subgroup.sum_of_left_coset_constant
            H f (indSummand_mul_right H φ g)
      rw [hsum]
      have hcard : (Nat.card H : k) ≠ 0 := by
        have hcardNat : Nat.card H ≠ 0 := by
          exact (Nat.card_ne_zero).mpr ⟨⟨1⟩, inferInstance⟩
        exact_mod_cast hcardNat

      rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hcard, one_mul]

name: ClassFun.ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum_mul_inv
statement:
lemma ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum_mul_inv
    (H : Subgroup G) (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    ind H φ g =
      (Nat.card H : k)⁻¹ *
        ∑ x : G,
          if hx : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H
          then φ ⟨x * g * x⁻¹, hx⟩
          else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [ind_apply_eq_inv_mul_sum]
  congr 1
  refine Finset.sum_bij
    (fun x (_ : x ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset G)) => (x : G)⁻¹)
    ?map_mem ?map_eq ?inj ?surj
  · intro x hx
    simp
  · intro x hx
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, inv_inj, imp_self, implies_true]
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨y⁻¹, by simp, ?_⟩
    simp only [inv_inv]
  · intro x₁ hx₁
    simp only [inv_inv]

name: ClassFun.sum_indSummand_ind_eq_sigma
statement:
private lemma sum_indSummand_ind_eq_sigma
    {k : Type u} [AddCommMonoid k]
    [Fintype G]
    (K : Subgroup G) (H : Subgroup K)
    (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G) :
    (∑ qK : G ⧸ K,
        indSummand K (ind H φ) g qK.out)
      =
    ∑ p : Σ (_ : G ⧸ K), K ⧸ H,
      iteratedIndSummand K H φ g p
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  apply Fintype.sum_congr
  intro qK
  unfold iteratedIndSummand indSummand
  by_cases hK : qK.out⁻¹ * g * qK.out ∈ K
  · simp only [dif_pos hK]
    simpa only [indSummand] using
      (ind_apply_of_fintype
        (G := K)
        (H := H)
        (φ := φ)
        (g := ⟨qK.out⁻¹ * g * qK.out, hK⟩))
  · simp only [dif_neg hK, Finset.sum_const_zero]

name: ClassFun.iteratedIndSummand_eq_product
statement:
private lemma iteratedIndSummand_eq_product
    {k : Type u} [Zero k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    (K : Subgroup G) (H : Subgroup K)
    (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G)
    (qK : G ⧸ K) (qH : K ⧸ H) :
    let eH := H.equivMapOfInjective K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
    let ψ := (ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv (k := k) eH).symm φ
    iteratedIndSummand K H φ g ⟨qK, qH⟩
      =
    indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g (qK.out * (qH.out : G))
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  let eH := H.equivMapOfInjective K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
  let ψ := (ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv (k := k) eH).symm φ
  let gK : G := qK.out⁻¹ * g * qK.out
  let xGH : G := qK.out * (qH.out : G)
  change
    (if hK : gK ∈ K then indSummand H φ ⟨gK, hK⟩ qH.out else 0)
      =
    indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g xGH
  by_cases hK : gK ∈ K
  · rw [dif_pos hK]
    let gH : K := qH.out⁻¹ * ⟨gK, hK⟩ * qH.out
    have harg : xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH = (gH : G) := by dsimp [xGH, gH, gK]; group
    have hmem_iff :
        xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH ∈ H.map K.subtype ↔ gH ∈ H := by
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨z, hz, hz_eq⟩
        have hzg : z = gH := by
          apply Subtype.ext
          exact hz_eq.trans harg
        simpa [hzg] using hz
      · intro hgH
        exact ⟨gH, hgH, harg.symm⟩
    unfold indSummand
    change
      (if hH : gH ∈ H then φ ⟨gH, hH⟩ else 0)
        =
      if hmap : xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH ∈ H.map K.subtype then
        ψ ⟨xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH, hmap⟩ else 0
    by_cases hH : gH ∈ H
    · have hmap : xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH ∈ H.map K.subtype := hmem_iff.mpr hH
      rw [dif_pos hH, dif_pos hmap]
      have hpreimage :
          eH.symm ⟨xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH, hmap⟩ =⟨gH, hH⟩ := by
        apply eH.injective
        rw [eH.apply_symm_apply]
        apply Subtype.ext
        change xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH = (gH : G)
        exact harg
      rw [ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv_symm_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun z : H => φ z) hpreimage.symm
    · have hmap : xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH ∉ H.map K.subtype := fun h => hH (hmem_iff.mp h)
      rw [dif_neg hH, dif_neg hmap]
  · rw [dif_neg hK]
    have hmap : xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH ∉ H.map K.subtype := by
      intro hm
      apply hK
      rcases hm with ⟨z, hz, hz_eq⟩
      have hambient_mem_K : xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH ∈ K := by
        rw [← hz_eq]; exact z.property
      have hgK : gK = (qH.out : G) * (xGH⁻¹ * g * xGH) * (qH.out : G)⁻¹ := by
        dsimp [gK, xGH]
        group
      rw [hgK]
      exact K.mul_mem
        (K.mul_mem qH.out.property hambient_mem_K)
        (K.inv_mem qH.out.property)
    unfold indSummand
    rw [dif_neg hmap]

name: ClassFun.iteratedIndSummand_eq_sigmaEquiv
statement:
private lemma iteratedIndSummand_eq_sigmaEquiv
    {k : Type u} [Zero k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    (K : Subgroup G) (H : Subgroup K)
    (φ : ClassFun k H) (g : G)
    (p : Σ (_ : G ⧸ K), K ⧸ H) :
    let e := (QuotientGroup.equivSigmaQuotient (G := G) (K := K) H).symm
    let eH := H.equivMapOfInjective K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
    let ψ := (ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv (k := k) eH).symm φ
    iteratedIndSummand K H φ g p =
      indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g (e p).out
proof:
:= by
  dsimp only
  rcases p with ⟨qK, qH⟩
  let e := (QuotientGroup.equivSigmaQuotient (G := G) (K := K) H).symm
  let eH := H.equivMapOfInjective K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
  let ψ := (ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv (k := k) eH).symm φ
  let xGH : G := qK.out * (qH.out : G)
  let s : G ⧸ H.map K.subtype := e ⟨qK, qH⟩
  have hproduct := iteratedIndSummand_eq_product K H φ g qK qH
  dsimp only at hproduct
  change
    iteratedIndSummand K H φ g ⟨qK, qH⟩ =
      indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g s.out
  rw [hproduct]
  have h_s_rel :
      s.out⁻¹ * xGH ∈ H.map K.subtype := by
    have h_qH_out :
        ((Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq
            (Subgroup.subgroupOf_map_subtype_eq_self H)).symm qH)
          =
        (⟦qH.out⟧ :
          K ⧸ (H.map K.subtype).subgroupOf K) := by
      let hEq := Subgroup.subgroupOf_map_subtype_eq_self H
      exact calc
        ((Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq hEq).symm qH)
            =
          ((Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq hEq).symm
            (⟦qH.out⟧ : K ⧸ H)) := by
              exact congrArg
                (fun q : K ⧸ H =>
                  (Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq hEq).symm q)
                (Quotient.out_eq qH).symm
        _ =
          (Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq hEq.symm)
            (⟦qH.out⟧ : K ⧸ H) := by
              rfl
        _ =
          (⟦qH.out⟧ :
            K ⧸ (H.map K.subtype).subgroupOf K) := by
              exact
                Subgroup.quotientEquivOfEq_mk
                  hEq.symm qH.out

    rw [← QuotientGroup.eq]
    dsimp [s, e, QuotientGroup.equivSigmaQuotient, xGH]
    simp only [
      Equiv.sigmaEquivProd_apply,
      Equiv.prodCongr_apply,
      Equiv.coe_refl,
      Prod.map_apply,
      id_eq,
      Subgroup.quotientEquivProdOfLE_symm_apply,
      Quotient.out_eq,
      h_qH_out,
      Quotient.map'_mk
    ]
  let h : H.map K.subtype := ⟨s.out⁻¹ * xGH, h_s_rel⟩
  have hx : s.out * (h : G) = xGH := by dsimp [h]; group
  calc
    indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g xGH
        =
      indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g
        (s.out * (h : G)) := by
          rw [hx]
    _ =
      indSummand (H.map K.subtype) ψ g s.out :=
        indSummand_mul_right
          (H.map K.subtype) ψ g s.out h

name: ClassFun.ind_trans
statement:
lemma ind_trans
    {k : Type u} [AddCommMonoid k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G] [Finite G]
    {K : Subgroup G} {H : Subgroup K}
    (φ : ClassFun k H) :
    ind K (ind H φ) =
      ind (H.map K.subtype)
        ((ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv
          (k := k)
          (H.equivMapOfInjective
            K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective)).symm φ)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  rw [ind_apply, ind_apply]
  letI: Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
  change
    (∑ qK : G ⧸ K,
        indSummand K (ind H φ) g qK.out)
      =
    ∑ q : G ⧸ H.map K.subtype,
      indSummand
        (H.map K.subtype)
        ((ClassFun.equivOfMulEquiv
          (k := k)
          (H.equivMapOfInjective
            K.subtype Subtype.coe_injective)).symm φ)
        g q.out

  rw [sum_indSummand_ind_eq_sigma K H φ g]
  let e := (QuotientGroup.equivSigmaQuotient (G := G) (K := K) H).symm
  rw [← Equiv.sum_comp e]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p _
  exact iteratedIndSummand_eq_sigmaEquiv K H φ g p

name: ClassFun.projection_formula
statement:
lemma projection_formula
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (ψ : ClassFun k G)
    (χ : ClassFun k H) :
    ψ * ind H χ = ind H (res H ψ * χ)
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [mul_apply, ind_apply]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  by_cases hq : q.out⁻¹ * g * q.out ∈ H
  · simp only [dif_pos hq, res_apply]
    rw [map_conj_eq]
  · simp only [dif_neg hq, mul_zero]

name: ClassFun.ind_postcomp
statement:
@[simp]
lemma ind_postcomp
    (F : R →+ S)
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (φ : ClassFun R H) :
    ind H (φ.postcomp F) =
      (ind H φ).postcomp F
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  simp only [ind_apply, postcomp_apply]
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  by_cases hq : q.out⁻¹ * g * q.out ∈ H
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceDIte]
  · simp only [hq, ↓reduceDIte, map_zero]

name: LinearChar.mem_psiEigenspace_iff
statement:
lemma mem_psiEigenspace_iff
    (ρ : FDRep k G) (A : Subgroup G) (ψ : A →* kˣ) (v : ρ) :
    v ∈ psiEigenspace ρ A ψ
      ↔ ∀ a : A, ρ.ρ (a : G) v = (ψ a : k) • v
proof:
:= by
  simp only [psiEigenspace, Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply,
    sub_eq_zero]

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspace_invariant
statement:
lemma psiEigenspace_invariant
    (ρ : FDRep k G) (A : Subgroup G) [hA : A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (g : LinearChar.inertia (H := A) ψ)
    (v : ρ)
    (hv : v ∈ psiEigenspace ρ A ψ) :
    ρ.ρ (g : G) v ∈ psiEigenspace ρ A ψ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_psiEigenspace_iff] at hv ⊢
  intro a
  have hmem : g.1⁻¹ * (a : G) * g.1 ∈ A := by
    simpa using Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem hA (a : G) a.2 (g.1⁻¹)
  let a' : A := ⟨g.1⁻¹ * (a : G) * g.1, hmem⟩
  have hag : (a : G) * (g : G) = (g : G) * (a' : G) := by
    dsimp [a']
    group
  calc
    ρ.ρ (a : G) (ρ.ρ (g : G) v)
        = ρ.ρ ((a : G) * (g : G)) v := by
          simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    _ = ρ.ρ ((g : G) * (a' : G)) v := by
          rw [hag]
    _ = ρ.ρ (g : G) (ρ.ρ (a' : G) v) := by
          simp only [map_mul, Module.End.mul_apply]
    _ = ρ.ρ (g : G) ((ψ a' : k) • v) := by
          rw [hv a']
    _ = ρ.ρ (g : G) ((ψ a : k) • v) := by
          have hψ_units : ψ a' = ψ a := by
            have hg_inv : LinearChar.conj (H := A) ψ ((g : G)⁻¹) = ψ := by
              exact (LinearChar.mem_inertia_iff (H := A) ψ ((g : G)⁻¹)).mp
                (Subgroup.inv_mem (LinearChar.inertia (H := A) ψ) g.2)
            calc
              ψ a' = LinearChar.conj (H := A) ψ ((g : G)⁻¹) a := by
                rw [LinearChar.conj_apply]
                congr
                ext
                simp [a']
              _ = ψ a := by
                rw [hg_inv]
          have hψ : ((ψ a' : kˣ) : k) = ((ψ a : kˣ) : k) :=
            congrArg (fun z : kˣ => (z : k)) hψ_units
          rw [hψ]
    _ = (ψ a : k) • ρ.ρ (g : G) v := by
          exact (ρ.ρ (g : G)).map_smul (ψ a : k) v

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep_rho_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma psiEigenspaceFDRep_rho_apply
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (g : inertia ψ)
    (v : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ) :
    (psiEigenspaceFDRep ρ A ψ).ρ g v
      =
    (⟨ρ.ρ (g : G) v.1,
      psiEigenspace_invariant ρ A ψ g v.1 v.2⟩ : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep_rho_eq_smul_id
statement:
lemma psiEigenspaceFDRep_rho_eq_smul_id
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (a : A) :
    let I : Subgroup G := LinearChar.inertia (H := A) ψ
    let aI : I :=
      ⟨(a : G), LinearChar.le_inertia_of_isMulCommutative
        (A := A) ψ a.2⟩
    (psiEigenspaceFDRep ρ A ψ).ρ aI
      =
    (ψ a : k) • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [psiEigenspaceFDRep_rho_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (mem_psiEigenspace_iff
    ρ A ψ v.1).mp v.2 a

name: LinearChar.sigma_rho_eq_smul_id_of_mono_into_psiEigenspace
statement:
lemma sigma_rho_eq_smul_id_of_mono_into_psiEigenspace
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (ι : σ ⟶ psiEigenspaceFDRep ρ A ψ)
    [Mono ι]
    (a : A) :
    let I : Subgroup G := LinearChar.inertia ψ
    let aI : I := ⟨(a : G), LinearChar.le_inertia_of_isMulCommutative ψ a.2⟩
    σ.ρ aI = (ψ a : k) • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  intro I aI
  ext x
  have hιinj : Function.Injective (FDRep.homToLinearMap ι) := by
      apply (FDRep.mono_iff_injective ι).mp
      exact MorphismProperty.monomorphisms.infer_property ι
  have h_val :
      FDRep.homToLinearMap ι (σ.ρ aI x)
        =
      (psiEigenspaceFDRep ρ A ψ).ρ aI (FDRep.homToLinearMap ι x) := by
    exact FDRep.homToLinearMap_rho_apply ι aI x
  rw [psiEigenspaceFDRep_rho_eq_smul_id
    ρ A ψ (a := a)] at h_val
  apply hιinj
  calc
    FDRep.homToLinearMap ι (σ.ρ aI x)
        = (ψ a : k) • FDRep.homToLinearMap ι x := h_val
    _ = FDRep.homToLinearMap ι ((ψ a : k) • x) := by
        simp only [map_smul]

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspace_ne_bot_of_hom_aux
statement:
private lemma psiEigenspace_ne_bot_of_hom_aux
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G)
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    {σ : FDRep k A}
    (hσ : ∀ (a : A) (x : σ), σ.ρ a x = (ψ a : k) • x)
    (f : σ ⟶ ρ.res A)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  intro hW
  apply hf
  ext x

  have hxW :
      (((FDRep.homToLinearMap f x : ρ.res A) : ρ) ∈
        psiEigenspace ρ A ψ) := by
    refine
      (mem_psiEigenspace_iff ρ A ψ
        (((FDRep.homToLinearMap f x : ρ.res A) : ρ))).2 ?_
    intro a
    calc
      ρ.ρ (a : G)
          (((FDRep.homToLinearMap f x : ρ.res A) : ρ))
          =
        ((ρ.res A).ρ a) (FDRep.homToLinearMap f x) := by
          rfl
      _ =
        FDRep.homToLinearMap f (σ.ρ a x) := by
          exact (FDRep.homToLinearMap_rho_apply f a x).symm
      _ =
        FDRep.homToLinearMap f ((ψ a : k) • x) := by
          rw [hσ a x]
      _ =
        (ψ a : k) • FDRep.homToLinearMap f x := by
          simp

  have hxBot :
      (((FDRep.homToLinearMap f x : ρ.res A) : ρ) ∈
        (⊥ : Submodule k ρ)) := by
    simpa [hW] using hxW

  have hxZero :
      (((FDRep.homToLinearMap f x : ρ.res A) : ρ) = 0) := by
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hxBot

  
  exact LinearMap.mem_eqLocus.mp hxBot

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspace_ne_bot_of_hom
statement:
lemma psiEigenspace_ne_bot_of_hom
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G)
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (f : FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ ⟶ ρ.res A)
    (hf : f ≠ 0) :
    psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥
proof:
:= by
  have hσ :
      ∀ (a : A) (x : (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ)),
        (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ).ρ a x =
          (ψ a : k) • x := by
    intro a x
    exact FDRep.ofLinearChar_rho_apply
      (k := k) ψ a x
  exact psiEigenspace_ne_bot_of_hom_aux ρ A ψ hσ f hf

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspace_invariant_of_inertia_eq_top
statement:
lemma psiEigenspace_invariant_of_inertia_eq_top
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hI : LinearChar.inertia ψ = ⊤)
    (g : G)
    (v : ρ)
    (hv : v ∈ psiEigenspace ρ A ψ) :
    ρ.ρ g v ∈ psiEigenspace ρ A ψ
proof:
:= by
  have hg : g ∈ LinearChar.inertia ψ := by
    simp only [hI, Subgroup.mem_top]
  exact psiEigenspace_invariant
    ρ A ψ
    ⟨g, hg⟩ v hv

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop_apply
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hI : LinearChar.inertia ψ = ⊤)
    (x : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ) :
    (psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop
      ρ A ψ hI).hom x
      =
    (x : ρ)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop_ne_zero
statement:
lemma psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop_ne_zero
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hI : LinearChar.inertia ψ = ⊤)
    (hW : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥) :
    psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop
      ρ A ψ hI ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hi
  apply hW
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro x hx
    let xW : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ := ⟨x, hx⟩
    have h_app :
        (psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop ρ A ψ hI).hom xW
          =
        (0 : psiEigenspaceFDRepOfInertiaEqTop ρ A ψ hI ⟶ ρ).hom xW := by
      exact congrArg
        (fun f :
          psiEigenspaceFDRepOfInertiaEqTop ρ A ψ hI ⟶ ρ => f.hom xW) hi
    have h_app :=
      congrArg
        (fun f : psiEigenspaceFDRepOfInertiaEqTop ρ A  ψ hI ⟶ ρ => f.hom xW) hi
    have hx0 : x = 0 := by
      change x = 0 at h_app
      exact h_app
    simpa [Submodule.mem_bot] using hx0
  · exact bot_le

name: LinearChar.psiEigenspace_eq_top_of_inertia_eq_top
statement:
lemma psiEigenspace_eq_top_of_inertia_eq_top
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hI : LinearChar.inertia ψ = ⊤)
    (hW : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥)
    [Simple ρ] :
    psiEigenspace ρ A ψ = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  let W : Submodule k ρ := psiEigenspace ρ A ψ
  let σ : FDRep k G := psiEigenspaceFDRepOfInertiaEqTop ρ A ψ hI
  let i : σ ⟶ ρ := psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop ρ A ψ hI
  have hi_ne : i ≠ 0 := psiEigenspaceInclOfInertiaEqTop_ne_zero ρ A ψ hI hW
  haveI : Mono i := by
    apply ConcreteCategory.mono_of_injective
      (C := FDRep k G)
    exact
      (Set.injective_codRestrict Subtype.property).mp
        fun ⦃a₁ a₂⦄ h ↦ h
  haveI : IsIso i := by
    exact isIso_of_mono_of_nonzero (f:=i) hi_ne
  apply eq_top_iff.mpr
  intro x hx
  let y : W := (inv i).hom x
  have hy : i.hom y = x := by
    change ((inv i ≫ i).hom) x = ((𝟙 ρ : ρ ⟶ ρ).hom) x
    rw [IsIso.inv_hom_id i]
  have hyW : (y : ρ) ∈ W := y.2
  simpa [W, i, FDRep.ofSubmoduleIncl_apply] using hy ▸ hyW

name: LinearChar.rho_eq_smul_of_inertia_eq_top
statement:
lemma rho_eq_smul_of_inertia_eq_top
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ]
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hI : LinearChar.inertia ψ = ⊤)
    (hW : LinearChar.psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∀ a : A, ρ.ρ (a : G) = (ψ a : k) • LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  have hW_top :
    LinearChar.psiEigenspace ρ A ψ = ⊤ :=
      psiEigenspace_eq_top_of_inertia_eq_top ρ A ψ hI hW
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro v
  have hv : v ∈ LinearChar.psiEigenspace ρ A ψ := by
    simp only [hW_top, Submodule.mem_top]
  exact
    (LinearChar.mem_psiEigenspace_iff ρ A ψ v).1 hv a

name: FDRep.mackeyHomTerm_eq_zero_of_inv_not_mem_inertia
statement:
lemma mackeyHomTerm_eq_zero_of_inv_not_mem_inertia
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (ι : σ ⟶ LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep ρ A ψ)
    [Mono ι]
    (g : G)
    (hg : g⁻¹ ∉ LinearChar.inertia ψ)
    (f : mackeyHomTerm (k := k) (I := LinearChar.inertia ψ) σ g) :
    f = 0
proof:
:= by
  let I : Subgroup G := LinearChar.inertia ψ
  let Ig : Subgroup G := mackeyConjSubgroup I g
  let H : Subgroup G := mackeyIntersection I g
  let σH : FDRep k H := mackeyLeftRes (k := k) I σ g
  let σgH : FDRep k H := mackeyConjRes (k := k) I σ g
  ext v
  
  obtain ⟨a, ha_neq⟩ :=
    LinearChar.exists_conj_coe_apply_ne_of_not_mem_inertia ψ hg
  have hAI : A ≤ I :=
    LinearChar.le_inertia_of_isMulCommutative (A := A) ψ
  have hAIg : A ≤ Ig :=
    FDRep.le_conjMap_of_normal A I hAI g
  have hAH : A ≤ H := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨hAI hx, hAIg hx⟩
  let aH : H := ⟨(a : G), hAH a.2⟩
  have hcomm :
      f.hom (σH.ρ aH v)
        =
      σgH.ρ aH (f.hom v) := FDRep.homToLinearMap_rho_apply f aH v
  have hsrc :
      σH.ρ aH v = (ψ a : k) • v := by
    change σ.ρ ⟨(a : G), hAI a.2⟩ v = (ψ a : k) • v
    have hlin :=
      LinearChar.sigma_rho_eq_smul_id_of_mono_into_psiEigenspace ρ A ψ σ ι a
    have happ :=
      congrArg
        (fun F : σ →ₗ[k] σ => F v)
        hlin
    simpa [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_apply] using happ
  have htgt :
      σgH.ρ aH (f.hom v)
        =
      ((LinearChar.conj ψ g⁻¹) a : k) • f.hom v := by
    have h1 :
        σgH.ρ aH (f.hom v)
          =
        (FDRep.conjMap (k := k) I g σ).ρ
          ⟨(a : G), hAIg a.2⟩ (f.hom v) := rfl
    rw [h1]
    have h2 :=
      FDRep.conjMap_rho_apply_of_mem_normal (k := k) A I hAI g σ a (v := f.hom v)
    rw [h2]
    let a_conj_val : G := g⁻¹ * (a : G) * g
    have h_mem_A : a_conj_val ∈ A := by
      simpa [a_conj_val] using
        (Subgroup.Normal.conj_mem'
          (inferInstance : A.Normal) (a : G) a.2 g)
    let a_conj_A : A := ⟨a_conj_val, h_mem_A⟩
    have hlin :=
      LinearChar.sigma_rho_eq_smul_id_of_mono_into_psiEigenspace ρ A ψ σ ι a_conj_A
    have happ :=
      congrArg
        (fun F : σ →ₗ[k] σ => F (f.hom v))
        hlin
    have hscalar :
        σ.ρ ⟨a_conj_val, hAI h_mem_A⟩ (f.hom v)
          =
        (ψ a_conj_A : k) • f.hom v := by
      exact cancel_hom_of_mono ι (congrArg (⇑(ConcreteCategory.hom ι.hom)) happ)
    rw [hscalar]
    congr 1
    rw [LinearChar.conj_apply]
    congr
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp [a_conj_A, a_conj_val]
  
  
  rw [hsrc, htgt] at hcomm
  rw [map_smul] at hcomm
  have hscalar_eq :
      (ψ a : k) • f.hom v =
        ((LinearChar.conj ψ g⁻¹) a : k) • f.hom v := hcomm
  have hscalar_ne :
      (ψ a : k) ≠ ((LinearChar.conj ψ g⁻¹) a : k) := Ne.symm ha_neq
  have hz :
      (((ψ a : k) - ((LinearChar.conj ψ g⁻¹) a : k)) • f.hom v) = 0 := by
    rw [sub_smul, sub_eq_zero]
    exact hscalar_eq
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hz).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hscalar_ne)

name: FDRep.finrank_mackeyHomTerm_eq_zero_of_ne_oneDC
statement:
lemma finrank_mackeyHomTerm_eq_zero_of_ne_oneDC
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (ι : σ ⟶ LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep
      (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ))
    [Mono ι]
    (d : DoubleCoset.Quotient
      (G := G) (LinearChar.inertia ψ) (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (hd : d ≠ DoubleCoset.oneDC (G := G) (LinearChar.inertia ψ)) :
    Module.finrank k
      (mackeyHomTerm
        (k := k)
        (I := LinearChar.inertia ψ)
        σ
        (Quotient.out d)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let I : Subgroup G := LinearChar.inertia ψ
  have hg : Quotient.out d ∉ I := by
    exact DoubleCoset.out_not_mem_of_ne_one
      (G := G) I d hd
  have hg_inv : (Quotient.out d)⁻¹ ∉ I := by
    intro hinv
    apply hg
    simpa using I.inv_mem hinv
  apply finrank_zero_iff_forall_zero.mpr
  intro f
  exact mackeyHomTerm_eq_zero_of_inv_not_mem_inertia ρ A ψ σ ι (Quotient.out d) hg_inv f

name: FDRep.sum_mackeyHomTerm_eq_identity_term
statement:
lemma sum_mackeyHomTerm_eq_identity_term
    [Finite G]
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (ι : σ ⟶ LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep
      (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ))
    [Mono ι] :
    letI : Fintype (DoubleCoset.Quotient
      (G := G) (LinearChar.inertia ψ) (LinearChar.inertia ψ)) :=
      DoubleCoset.quotientFintype
        (LinearChar.inertia ψ) (LinearChar.inertia ψ)
    (∑ d : DoubleCoset.Quotient
        (G := G) (LinearChar.inertia ψ) (LinearChar.inertia ψ),
      Module.finrank k
        (mackeyHomTerm
          (k := k)
          (I := LinearChar.inertia ψ)
          σ
          (Quotient.out d)))
      =
    Module.finrank k
      (mackeyHomTerm
        (k := k)
        (I := LinearChar.inertia ψ)
        σ
        (Quotient.out
          (DoubleCoset.oneDC
            (G := G) (LinearChar.inertia ψ))))
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fintype (DoubleCoset.Quotient
      (G := G) (LinearChar.inertia ψ) (LinearChar.inertia ψ)) :=
    DoubleCoset.quotientFintype
      (LinearChar.inertia ψ) (LinearChar.inertia ψ)
  apply Fintype.sum_eq_single
  · intro d hd
    exact finrank_mackeyHomTerm_eq_zero_of_ne_oneDC ρ A ψ σ ι d hd

name: FDRep.finrank_end_ind_eq_sum_mackeyHomTerm
statement:
lemma finrank_end_ind_eq_sum_mackeyHomTerm
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G] [CharZero k]
    (I : Subgroup G)
    (σ : FDRep k I) :
    Module.finrank k (FDRep.ind I σ ⟶ FDRep.ind I σ)
      =
    letI : Fintype (DoubleCoset.Quotient (G := G) I I) :=
      DoubleCoset.quotientFintype I I
    ∑ d : DoubleCoset.Quotient (G := G) I I,
      Module.finrank k
        (mackeyHomTerm (k := k) I σ (Quotient.out d))
proof:
:= by
  calc
    Module.finrank k (FDRep.ind I σ ⟶ FDRep.ind I σ)
        =
      Module.finrank k
        (σ ⟶ FDRep.res (FDRep.ind I σ) I) :=
      FDRep.finrank_end_ind_eq_hom_res_ind (k := k) I σ
    _ =
      letI : Fintype (DoubleCoset.Quotient (G := G) I I) :=
        DoubleCoset.quotientFintype I I
      ∑ d : DoubleCoset.Quotient (G := G) I I,
        Module.finrank k
          (mackeyHomTerm (k := k) I σ (Quotient.out d)) :=
      FDRep.finrank_hom_res_ind_eq_sum_mackeyHomTerm
        (k := k) I σ

name: FDRep.finrank_end_ind_from_inertia_eq_one
statement:
theorem finrank_end_ind_from_inertia_eq_one
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (ι : σ ⟶ LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep
      (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ))
    [Mono ι] [Simple σ] :
    Module.finrank k (FDRep.ind (LinearChar.inertia ψ) σ ⟶
      FDRep.ind (LinearChar.inertia ψ) σ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  let I : Subgroup G := LinearChar.inertia ψ
  letI : Fintype (DoubleCoset.Quotient (G := G) I I) :=
    DoubleCoset.quotientFintype I I
  calc
    Module.finrank k (FDRep.ind I σ ⟶ FDRep.ind I σ)
        =
      ∑ d : DoubleCoset.Quotient (G := G) I I,
        Module.finrank k
          (mackeyHomTerm (k := k) I σ (Quotient.out d)) := by
        exact FDRep.finrank_end_ind_eq_sum_mackeyHomTerm
          (k := k) (G := G) I σ
    _ =
      Module.finrank k
        (mackeyHomTerm
          (k := k) I σ
          (Quotient.out (DoubleCoset.oneDC (G := G) I))) := by
        exact FDRep.sum_mackeyHomTerm_eq_identity_term
          (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ) (σ := σ) (ι := ι)
    _ =
      Module.finrank k (σ ⟶ σ) := finrank_mackeyHomTerm_oneDC_eq_end I σ
    _ = 1 := CategoryTheory.finrank_endomorphism_simple_eq_one k σ

name: FDRep.linearCharOfOneDim_spec
statement:
lemma linearCharOfOneDim_spec
    (σ : FDRep k G)
    (h_dim : Module.finrank k σ = 1) (g : G) :
    (linearCharOfOneDim σ h_dim g : k) = σ.character g
proof:
:= by
  let i : ofLinearChar (linearCharOfOneDim σ h_dim) ≅ σ :=
    isoLinearCharOfOneDim (k := k) σ h_dim
  have hchar_g :
      (ofLinearChar (linearCharOfOneDim σ h_dim)).character g =
        σ.character g := by
    exact congrArg
      (fun χ : ClassFun k G => χ g)
      (ClassFun.char_eq_of_iso i)
  simpa only [char_ofLinearChar] using hchar_g

name: FDRep.exists_iso_ofLinearChar_of_finrank_one
statement:
lemma exists_iso_ofLinearChar_of_finrank_one
    (σ : FDRep k G)
    (h_dim : Module.finrank k σ = 1) :
    ∃ ψ : G →* kˣ, Nonempty (σ ≅ ofLinearChar ψ)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨linearCharOfOneDim σ h_dim, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨(isoLinearCharOfOneDim σ h_dim).symm⟩

name: FDRep.comap_quotient_linearChar_summand_eq
statement:
private lemma comap_quotient_linearChar_summand_eq
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    (Q : Subgroup (G ⧸ K))
    (ψ_Q : Q →* kˣ)
    (g x : G) :
    let π : G →* G ⧸ K := QuotientGroup.mk' K
    let H : Subgroup G := Q.comap π
    let π_res : H →* Q :=
      (π.comp H.subtype).codRestrict Q (fun h ↦ h.2)
    let ψ_H : H →* kˣ := ψ_Q.comp π_res
    (if hx : π x * π g * (π x)⁻¹ ∈ Q then
        (ψ_Q ⟨π x * π g * (π x)⁻¹, hx⟩ : k)
      else 0)
      =
    (if hx : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H then (ψ_H ⟨x * g * x⁻¹, hx⟩ : k)
      else 0)
proof:
:= by
  intro π H π_res ψ_H
  have hiff :
      π x * π g * (π x)⁻¹ ∈ Q ↔ x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H := by
    dsimp [H]
    rw [Subgroup.mem_comap]
    simp [map_mul, map_inv]
  by_cases hxH : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H
  · have hxQ : π x * π g * (π x)⁻¹ ∈ Q := hiff.mpr hxH
    rw [dif_pos hxQ, dif_pos hxH]
    dsimp [ψ_H, π_res]
    simp [map_mul, map_inv]
  · have hxQ : ¬ π x * π g * (π x)⁻¹ ∈ Q := by
      intro hxQ
      exact hxH (hiff.mp hxQ)
    rw [dif_neg hxQ, dif_neg hxH]

name: FDRep.rightRel_conj_linearChar_summand_eq
statement:
private lemma rightRel_conj_linearChar_summand_eq
    {Γ : Type v} [Group Γ]
    (S : Subgroup Γ) (ψ : S →* kˣ) (g : Γ)
    {x y : Γ}
    (hxy : QuotientGroup.rightRel S x y) :
    (if hx : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ S then
        (ψ ⟨x * g * x⁻¹, hx⟩ : k)
      else 0)
      =
    (if hy : y * g * y⁻¹ ∈ S then
        (ψ ⟨y * g * y⁻¹, hy⟩ : k)
      else 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hxyS : x * y⁻¹ ∈ S := by
    exact (QuotientGroup.rightRel_iff_mul_inv_mem S x y).1 hxy
  let s : S := ⟨x * y⁻¹, hxyS⟩
  have h_conj :
      x * g * x⁻¹ =
        (s : Γ) * (y * g * y⁻¹) * (s : Γ)⁻¹ := by
    dsimp [s]
    group
  have hmem_iff :
      x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ S ↔ y * g * y⁻¹ ∈ S := by
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have hs_inv : (s : Γ)⁻¹ ∈ S := S.inv_mem s.2
      have hs : (s : Γ) ∈ S := s.2
      have htmp :
          (s : Γ)⁻¹ * (x * g * x⁻¹) * (s : Γ) ∈ S :=
        S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem hs_inv hx) hs
      simpa [h_conj, mul_assoc] using htmp
    · intro hy
      rw [h_conj]
      exact S.mul_mem (S.mul_mem s.2 hy) (S.inv_mem s.2)
  by_cases hy : y * g * y⁻¹ ∈ S
  · have hx : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ S := hmem_iff.mpr hy
    rw [dif_pos hx, dif_pos hy]
    have hsub :
        (⟨x * g * x⁻¹, hx⟩ : S) =
          s * ⟨y * g * y⁻¹, hy⟩ * s⁻¹ := by
      apply Subtype.ext
      simp only [h_conj, Subgroup.coe_mul, InvMemClass.coe_inv]
    rw [hsub]
    simp [map_mul, map_inv, mul_assoc]
  · have hx : ¬ x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ S := by
      intro hx
      exact hy (hmem_iff.mp hx)
    rw [dif_neg hx, dif_neg hy]

name: FDRep.char_coindLin_comap_quotient
statement:
lemma char_coindLin_comap_quotient
     {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G] [CharZero k]
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    (Q : Subgroup (G ⧸ K)) (ψ_Q : Q →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    let π : G →* G ⧸ K := QuotientGroup.mk' K
    let H : Subgroup G := Q.comap π
    let π_res : H →* Q :=
      (π.comp H.subtype).codRestrict Q (fun x => x.2)
    let ψ_H : H →* kˣ := ψ_Q.comp π_res
    (FDRep.coindLin (k := k) (G := G ⧸ K) Q ψ_Q).character (π g) =
      (FDRep.coindLin (k := k) (G := G) H ψ_H).character g
proof:
:= by
  dsimp
  have hχ :
      ClassFun.character
          (FDRep.comap (quotientMap K)
            (FDRep.coindLin Q ψ_Q))
        =
      ClassFun.character
          (FDRep.coindLin (quotientPreimage K Q)
            (ψ_Q.comp (quotientPreimageMap K Q))) := by
    exact ClassFun.char_eq_of_iso
      (FDRep.comap_coindLin_quotient_iso (k := k) K Q ψ_Q)
  have hχg :=
    congrArg (fun χ : ClassFun k G => χ g) hχ
  change
    (FDRep.comap (quotientMap K)
      (FDRep.coindLin (k := k) (G := G ⧸ K) Q ψ_Q)).character g
      =
    (FDRep.coindLin (k := k) (G := G)
      (quotientPreimage K Q)
      (ψ_Q.comp (quotientPreimageMap K Q))).character g
  exact hχg

name: FDRep.exists_indLin_of_lift_exists_indLin
statement:
theorem exists_indLin_of_lift_exists_indLin
     {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G] [CharZero k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    (K : Subgroup G) [K.Normal]
    (hK : ∀ x ∈ K, ρ.ρ x = 1) :
    (∃ (Q : Subgroup (G ⧸ K)) (ψ : Q →* kˣ),
      Nonempty (FDRep.lift ρ K hK ≅ FDRep.indLin Q ψ)) →
    ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ),
      Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.indLin H ψ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨Q, ψQ, ⟨eQ⟩⟩
  let π : G →* G ⧸ K := QuotientGroup.mk' K
  let H : Subgroup G := Q.comap π
  let πH : H →* Q :=
    (π.comp H.subtype).codRestrict Q (by
      intro h
      exact h.2)
  let ψH : H →* kˣ := ψQ.comp πH
  refine ⟨H, ψH, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  apply FDRep.iso_of_char_eq
  ext g
  rw [← FDRep.char_lift (ρ := ρ) (K := K) hK g]
  have hchar :
      (FDRep.lift ρ K hK).character (π g) =
        (FDRep.indLin Q ψQ).character (π g) := by
    simpa using congrFun (FDRep.char_eq_of_iso eQ) (π g)
  rw [hchar]
  rw [FDRep.char_indLin_eq_char_coindLin]
  rw [FDRep.char_indLin_eq_char_coindLin]
  simpa [π, H, πH, ψH] using
    char_coindLin_comap_quotient
      (K := K) (Q := Q) (ψ_Q := ψQ) g

name: FDRep.ofLinearChar_rho_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma ofLinearChar_rho_apply (ψ : G →* kˣ) (g : G) (x : k) :
    (ofLinearChar (k := k) ψ).ρ g x = (ψ g : k) * x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [ofLinearChar]
  change ↑(ψ g) * LinearMap.id x = ↑(ψ g) * x
  simp only [LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq]

name: FDRep.char_ofLinearChar
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_ofLinearChar {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (ψ : G →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    (ofLinearChar ψ).character g = (ψ g : k)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [character, ofLinearChar]
  change
    (LinearMap.trace k k)
        ((ψ g : k) • (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k))
      =
    (ψ g : k)
  rw [LinearMap.trace_eq_matrix_trace
    (b := Module.Basis.singleton Unit k)]
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Finset.univ_unique, PUnit.default_eq_unit,
    Matrix.diag_apply, LinearMap.toMatrix_singleton, Finset.sum_const,
    Finset.card_singleton, one_smul]
  change
    (((ψ g : k) • (LinearMap.id : k →ₗ[k] k)) 1)
      =
    (ψ g : k)
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_one]

name: FDRep.finrank_ofLinearChar
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_ofLinearChar
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    (ψ : G →* kˣ) :
    (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ).finrank = 1
proof:
:= by
  change Module.finrank k k = 1
  simp only [finrank_self]

name: LinearChar.exists_apply_ne
statement:
lemma LinearChar.exists_apply_ne
    {A : Subgroup G} {χ χ' : A →* kˣ} (hχ : χ ≠ χ') :
    ∃ a : A, (χ a : k) ≠ (χ' a : k)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  apply hχ
  ext a
  have hnne : ¬ (χ a : k) ≠ (χ' a : k) := (not_exists.mp h) a
  exact not_ne_iff.mp hnne

name: LinearChar.char_ofTop_ulift_of
statement:
@[simp]
lemma LinearChar.char_ofTop_ulift_of
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [Finite G]
    (ψ : (⊤ : Subgroup G) →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    (FDRep.ofTop
        (FDRep.ofLinearChar (k := k) ψ)).character g
      =
    (ψ ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩ : k)
proof:
:= by
  change
    (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ).character
        (Subgroup.topEquiv.symm g)
      =
    (ψ ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩ : k)
  have htop :
      Subgroup.topEquiv.symm g =
        (⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩ : (⊤ : Subgroup G)) := by
    rfl
  rw [htop]
  exact FDRep.char_ofLinearChar
    ψ
    ⟨g, Subgroup.mem_top g⟩

name: LinearChar.conj_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma conj_apply (ψ : H →* kˣ) (g : G) (h : H) :
    conj ψ g h = ψ (((MulAut.conjNormal g) : H ≃* H) h)
proof: := rfl

name: LinearChar.conj_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma conj_one (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    conj (H := H) ψ (1 : G) = ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  simp [conj]

name: LinearChar.conj_mul
statement:
lemma conj_mul (ψ : H →* kˣ) (g₁ g₂ : G) :
    conj ψ (g₁ * g₂) = conj (conj ψ g₁) g₂
proof:
:= by
  ext h
  simp [conj, map_mul]

name: LinearChar.mem_inertia_iff
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_inertia_iff (ψ : H →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    g ∈ inertia (H := H) ψ ↔ conj (H := H) ψ g = ψ
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: LinearChar.inertia_eq_stabilizer
statement:
lemma inertia_eq_stabilizer (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    inertia (H := H) ψ = MulAction.stabilizer G ψ
proof:
:= by
  ext g
  change
    conj (H := H) ψ g = ψ ↔
      conj (H := H) ψ g⁻¹ = ψ
  constructor
  · intro hg
    have hg_mem : g ∈ inertia (H := H) ψ := hg
    exact
      (mem_inertia_iff (H := H) ψ g⁻¹).1
        (Subgroup.inv_mem _ hg_mem)
  · intro hg
    have hginv_mem : g⁻¹ ∈ inertia (H := H) ψ := hg
    have := Subgroup.inv_mem (inertia (H := H) ψ) hginv_mem
    simpa using this

name: LinearChar.le_inertia_of_isMulCommutative
statement:
lemma le_inertia_of_isMulCommutative
    {A : Subgroup G} [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ) :
    A ≤ LinearChar.inertia (H := A) ψ
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rw [mem_inertia_iff]
  ext x
  let aA : A := ⟨a, ha⟩
  have hx : ((MulAut.conjNormal (H := A) a) x) = x := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hcomm : aA * x = x * aA := by exact mul_comm' aA x
    have hcommG : (a : G) * (x : G) = (x : G) * (a : G) :=
      congrArg (fun y : A => (y : G)) hcomm
    calc
      (a : G) * (x : G) * (a : G)⁻¹
          = ((x : G) * (a : G)) * (a : G)⁻¹ := by simp [mul_assoc, hcommG]
      _   = (x : G) * ((a : G) * (a : G)⁻¹) := by simp [mul_assoc]
      _   = (x : G) := by simp
  rw [conj_apply, hx]

name: LinearChar.mem_inertia_iff_smul_eq
statement:
@[simp] lemma mem_inertia_iff_smul_eq (ψ : H →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    g ∈ LinearChar.inertia (H := H) ψ ↔ g • ψ = ψ
proof:
:= by
  simp [LinearChar.inertia_eq_stabilizer,
      MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff (G := G) (a := ψ) (g := g)]

name: LinearChar.exists_conj_coe_apply_ne_of_not_mem_inertia
statement:
lemma exists_conj_coe_apply_ne_of_not_mem_inertia
    {A : Subgroup G} [A.Normal]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ) {g : G}
    (hg : g ∉ LinearChar.inertia ψ) :
    ∃ a : A,
      ((LinearChar.conj ψ g) a : k) ≠ (ψ a : k)
proof:
:= by
  apply LinearChar.exists_apply_ne
  intro h
  exact hg ((LinearChar.mem_inertia_iff (H := A) ψ g).2 h)

name: FDRep.exists_linearChar_of_restrict
statement:
theorem exists_linearChar_of_restrict
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ]
    (A : Subgroup G) [IsMulCommutative A] :
    ∃ ψ : A →* kˣ,
      ∃ f : FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ ⟶ ρ.res A,
        f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hres_nz : Nontrivial (ρ.res A) := by
    change Nontrivial ρ
    exact FDRep.nontrivial_of_simple ρ
  have h_notIsZero: ¬ Limits.IsZero (ρ.res A) :=
     (nontrivial_iff_not_IsZero (ρ.res A)).mp hres_nz
  haveI : NeZero (Nat.card A : k) :=
    ⟨One.natCast_natCard_ne_zero_of_finite A k⟩
  obtain ⟨σ, i, hσsimp, hi_mono⟩ :=
    FDRep.exists_simple_subobject (ρ.res A) h_notIsZero
  haveI : Simple σ := hσsimp
  haveI : Mono i := hi_mono
  have hi_ne : i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    have hinj : Function.Injective i.hom :=
      FDRep.hom_injective_of_mono i
    have hσnz : Nontrivial σ :=
      FDRep.nontrivial_of_simple σ
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne σ
    apply hxy
    apply hinj
    simp only [hi]
    exact LinearMap.sub_mem_ker_iff.mp rfl
  have hdim : Module.finrank k σ = 1 :=
    FDRep.abelian_simple_is_linear σ
  let ψ : A →* kˣ := σ.linearCharOfOneDim hdim
  let e : FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ ≅ σ :=
    σ.isoLinearCharOfOneDim hdim
  let f : FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ ⟶ ρ.res A :=
    e.hom ≫ i

  refine ⟨ψ, f, ?_⟩
  intro hf
  apply hi_ne
  calc
    i = 𝟙 σ ≫ i := by simp
    _ = (e.inv ≫ e.hom) ≫ i := by
      rw [e.inv_hom_id]
    _ = e.inv ≫ (e.hom ≫ i) := by
      simp only [Category.assoc]
    _ = e.inv ≫ f := rfl
    _ = e.inv ≫ 0 := by rw [hf]
    _ = 0 := by simp

name: FDRep.simple_ind_of_inertia_submodule
statement:
lemma simple_ind_of_inertia_submodule
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ]
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ))
    (ι : σ ⟶ LinearChar.psiEigenspaceFDRep
      (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ))
    [Mono ι] [Simple σ] :
    Simple (FDRep.ind (LinearChar.inertia ψ) σ)
proof:
:= by

  haveI : NeZero (Nat.card G : k) := ⟨One.natCast_natCard_ne_zero_of_finite G k⟩
  rw [FDRep.simple_iff_end_is_rank_one]
  exact finrank_end_ind_from_inertia_eq_one ρ A ψ σ ι

name: FDRep.rho_trivial_of_mem_normalClosure_singleton
statement:
private lemma rho_trivial_of_mem_normalClosure_singleton
    {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    (ρ : FDRep k G)
    {c z : G}
    (hc : ρ.ρ c = LinearMap.id)
    (hz : z ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure ({c} : Set G)) :
    ρ.ρ z = LinearMap.id
proof:
:= by
  let K : Subgroup G := MonoidHom.ker ρ.ρ
  have hK_normal : K.Normal := by
    infer_instance
  have hcK : c ∈ K := by
    change ρ.ρ c = 1
    exact MonoidHom.mem_ker.mp hc
  have hle : Subgroup.normalClosure ({c} : Set G) ≤ K := by
    intro x hx
    exact Subgroup.normalClosure_le_normal
      (by
        intro y hy
        simp only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hy
        subst y
        exact hcK)
      hx
  have hzK : z ∈ K := hle hz
  change ρ.ρ z = 1 at hzK
  change ρ.ρ z = (1 : ρ →ₗ[k] ρ)
  exact hzK

name: FDRep.simple_of_commGroup_iso_indLin_top
statement:
theorem simple_of_commGroup_iso_indLin_top
     [IsMulCommutative G]
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ] :
    ∃ ψ : (⊤ : Subgroup G) →* kˣ,
      Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.indLin (⊤ : Subgroup G) ψ)
proof:
:= by
  let T : Subgroup G := ⊤

  
  have hdim : Module.finrank k (ρ.res T) = 1 := by
    
    change Module.finrank k ρ = 1
    exact FDRep.abelian_simple_is_linear ρ

  let ψ : T →* kˣ :=
     (ρ.res T).linearCharOfOneDim hdim

  refine ⟨ψ, ?_⟩

  let eχ : FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ ≅ ρ.res T :=
    (ρ.res T).isoLinearCharOfOneDim hdim

  let eind :
      FDRep.indLin T ψ ≅ FDRep.ofTop (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ) :=
        indLin_top_iso_self ψ

  let eres : FDRep.ofTop (ρ.res T) ≅ ρ := FDRep.ofTop_res_top_iso ρ

  let eχ_top :
    FDRep.ofTop (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ) ≅
      FDRep.ofTop (ρ.res T) :=
  (FDRep.ofTopFunctor (k := k) (G := G)).mapIso eχ

  exact ⟨eres.symm ≪≫ eχ_top.symm ≪≫ eind.symm⟩

name: FDRep.exists_indLin_of_centralKernel_ne_bot
statement:
theorem exists_indLin_of_centralKernel_ne_bot
    [Group.IsNilpotent G]
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [CategoryTheory.Simple ρ]
    (hKne : FDRep.centralKernel ρ ≠ ⊥)
    (IH :
      ∀ (Q : Type u) [Group Q] [Finite Q] [Group.IsNilpotent Q],
        Nat.card Q < Nat.card G →
        ∀ (σ : FDRep k Q), [Simple σ] →
          ∃ (H : Subgroup Q) (ψ : H →* kˣ),
            Nonempty (σ ≅ FDRep.indLin H ψ)) :
    ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ),
      Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.indLin H ψ)
proof:
:= by

  let K : Subgroup G := FDRep.centralKernel ρ

  haveI : K.Normal := by
    dsimp [K]
    infer_instance

  have hKne' : K ≠ ⊥ := by
    simpa [K] using hKne

  have htriv : ∀ x ∈ K, ρ.ρ x = 1 := by
    intro x hx
    dsimp [K] at hx
    exact rho_eq_one_of_mem_centralKernel ρ x hx

  let ρbar : FDRep k (G ⧸ K) :=
    FDRep.lift ρ K htriv

  haveI : Finite (G ⧸ K) := by
    infer_instance

  haveI : Group.IsNilpotent (G ⧸ K) := by
    infer_instance

  have hcard : Nat.card (G ⧸ K) < Nat.card G := by
    exact QuotientGroup.natCard_quotient_lt_natCard_of_ne_bot K hKne'

  haveI : Simple ρbar := by
    dsimp [ρbar]
    exact FDRep.lift_simple_of_simple ρ K htriv

  obtain ⟨Q, ψQ, hQ⟩ :=
    IH (G ⧸ K) hcard ρbar

  exact
    FDRep.exists_indLin_of_lift_exists_indLin
      (ρ := ρ) (K := K) htriv
      ⟨Q, ψQ, hQ⟩

name: LinearChar.exists_induced_from_inertia
statement:
theorem exists_induced_from_inertia
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ]
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hW : psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥) :
    ∃ σ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ),
        Simple σ ∧ Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.ind (LinearChar.inertia ψ) σ)
proof:
:= by

  let Iψ : Subgroup G := LinearChar.inertia ψ
  let W : FDRep k Iψ :=
    psiEigenspaceFDRep (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ)

  have hW_nontrivial : Nontrivial W := by
    change Nontrivial (psiEigenspace ρ A ψ)
    exact Submodule.nontrivial_iff_ne_bot.mpr hW

  have hW_notIsZero:  ¬ Limits.IsZero W := by
    exact (FDRep.nontrivial_iff_not_IsZero W).mp hW_nontrivial

  haveI : NeZero ↑(Nat.card ↥Iψ) :=
    neZero_iff.mpr (One.natCard_ne_zero_of_finite ↥Iψ)

  obtain ⟨σ, ι, hσsimp, hιmono⟩ :=
    FDRep.exists_simple_subobject W hW_notIsZero

  haveI : Simple σ := hσsimp
  haveI : Mono ι := hιmono

  let incl : W ⟶ FDRep.res ρ Iψ :=
    psiEigenspaceIncl (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ)

  haveI : Mono incl := psiEigenspaceIncl_mono ρ A ψ

  let j : σ ⟶ FDRep.res ρ Iψ := ι ≫ incl

  have hι_ne : ι ≠ 0 := by
    intro hι_zero
    have hinj : Function.Injective ι.hom :=
      FDRep.hom_injective_of_mono ι
    have hσnz : Nontrivial σ :=
      FDRep.nontrivial_of_simple σ
    obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := exists_pair_ne σ
    apply hxy
    apply hinj
    simp only [hι_zero]
    exact LinearMap.sub_mem_ker_iff.mp rfl

  have hj_ne : j ≠ 0 := by
    intro hj_zero
    apply hι_ne
    have hj_zero' : ι ≫ incl = 0 ≫ incl := by
      simpa [j] using hj_zero
    exact (cancel_mono incl).1 hj_zero'

  let e : (FDRep.ind Iψ σ ⟶ ρ) ≃ₗ[k] (σ ⟶ FDRep.res ρ Iψ)
    := FDRep.indHomComapEquiv Iψ.subtype σ ρ

  let f : FDRep.ind Iψ σ ⟶ ρ := e.symm j

  have hf_ne : f ≠ 0 := by
    intro hf_zero
    apply hj_ne
    have hj_eq : j = e f := by
      simpa only [f] using (e.apply_symm_apply j).symm
    calc
      j = e f := hj_eq
      _ = e 0 := by rw [hf_zero]
      _ = 0 := by simp

  haveI : Simple (FDRep.ind Iψ σ) :=
    FDRep.simple_ind_of_inertia_submodule ρ A ψ σ ι

  haveI : IsIso f :=
    CategoryTheory.isIso_of_hom_simple hf_ne

  refine ⟨σ, hσsimp, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨(asIso f).symm⟩

name: LinearChar.exists_induced_from_normal_abelian
statement:
theorem exists_induced_from_normal_abelian
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ]
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A] :
    ∃ (ψ : A →* kˣ),
      LinearChar.psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥ ∧
      ∃ (τ : FDRep k (LinearChar.inertia ψ)),
        Simple τ ∧
          Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.ind (LinearChar.inertia ψ) τ)
proof:
:= by

  obtain ⟨ψ, f, hf⟩ :=
    FDRep.exists_linearChar_of_restrict
      (ρ := ρ) A

  have hW : LinearChar.psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥ :=
      LinearChar.psiEigenspace_ne_bot_of_hom
        (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ) f hf

  obtain ⟨σ, hσsimp, hiso⟩ :=
    LinearChar.exists_induced_from_inertia
      (ρ := ρ) (A := A) (ψ := ψ) hW

  exact ⟨ψ, hW, σ, hσsimp, hiso⟩

name: LinearChar.commutator_ne_one_of_mul_ne
statement:
private lemma commutator_ne_one_of_mul_ne {G : Type v} [Group G]
    {g a : G} (hga : g * a ≠ a * g) :
    g * a * g⁻¹ * a⁻¹ ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  apply hga
  have hconj : g * a * g⁻¹ = a := by
    apply mul_inv_eq_one.mp
    simpa [mul_assoc] using hc
  calc
    g * a = (g * a * g⁻¹) * g := by
      simp [mul_assoc]
    _ = a * g := by
      rw [hconj]

name: LinearChar.inertia_ne_top_of_centralKernel_eq_bot
statement:
theorem inertia_ne_top_of_centralKernel_eq_bot
    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    {G : Type v} [Group G]
    [Group.IsNilpotent G]
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ]
    (hck : FDRep.centralKernel ρ = ⊥)
    (A : Subgroup G) [A.Normal] [IsMulCommutative A]
    (hA : Subgroup.center G < A)
    (ψ : A →* kˣ)
    (hW : LinearChar.psiEigenspace ρ A ψ ≠ ⊥) :
    LinearChar.inertia ψ ≠ ⊤
proof:
:= by
  intro hI

  have hA_scalar :
      ∀ a : A, ρ.ρ (a : G) = (ψ a : k) • LinearMap.id :=
    rho_eq_smul_of_inertia_eq_top ρ A ψ hI hW

  
  obtain ⟨a, haA, ha_not_center⟩ : ∃ a : G, a ∈ A ∧ a ∉ Subgroup.center G := by
    by_contra h'; push Not at h'; exact (not_le_of_gt hA) h'

  
  obtain ⟨g, hga_ne⟩ : ∃ g : G, g * a ≠ a * g := by
    by_contra h; push Not at h; exact ha_not_center ((Subgroup.mem_center_iff).2 h)

  
  let c : G := g * a * g⁻¹ * a⁻¹
  have hc_ne_one : c ≠ 1 := by
    dsimp [c]; exact commutator_ne_one_of_mul_ne hga_ne

  
  
  have hc_trivial :
      ρ.ρ c = LinearMap.id := by
    let aA : A := ⟨a, haA⟩
    have ha_scalar :
        ρ.ρ a = (ψ aA : k) • LinearMap.id := by
      simpa [aA] using hA_scalar aA
    have hainv_scalar :
        ρ.ρ a⁻¹ = (ψ aA⁻¹ : k) • LinearMap.id := by
      simpa [aA] using hA_scalar aA⁻¹
    dsimp [c]
    rw [map_mul, map_mul, map_mul]
    rw [ha_scalar, hainv_scalar]
    ext v
    simp only [Module.End.mul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.id_coe, id_eq,
      map_smul, smul_smul]
    simp only [map_inv, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val, ne_eq, Units.ne_zero, not_false_eq_true,
      inv_mul_cancel₀, Representation.self_inv_apply, one_smul]

  
  
  obtain ⟨z, hz_center, hz_nc, hz_ne⟩ :
      ∃ z : G,
        z ∈ Subgroup.center G ∧
        z ∈ Subgroup.normalClosure ({c} : Set G) ∧
        z ≠ 1 := by
    
    exact Group.exists_center_mem_normalClosure_singleton_of_ne_one hc_ne_one

  
  have hz_trivial :
      ρ.ρ z = LinearMap.id := by
      exact FDRep.rho_trivial_of_mem_normalClosure_singleton ρ hc_trivial hz_nc

  
  
  have hz_ck : z ∈ FDRep.centralKernel ρ := by
    exact
      (FDRep.center_coe_mem_centralKernel_iff ρ ⟨z, hz_center⟩).2 hz_trivial

  have hz_one : z = 1 := by
    have : z ∈ (⊥ : Subgroup G) := by
      simpa [hck] using hz_ck
    simpa using this

  exact hz_ne hz_one

name: FDRep.exists_indLin_of_nilpotent_simple
statement:
theorem exists_indLin_of_nilpotent_simple
    [Group.IsNilpotent G]
    (ρ : FDRep k G) [Simple ρ] :
    ∃ (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ),
      Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.indLin H ψ)
proof:
:= by


  let P : ℕ → Prop :=
    fun n =>
      ∀ (Q : Type u) [Group Q] [Finite Q] [Group.IsNilpotent Q],
        Nat.card Q = n →
        ∀ (σ : FDRep k Q), [Simple σ] →
          ∃ (H : Subgroup Q) (ψ : H →* kˣ),
            Nonempty (σ ≅ FDRep.indLin H ψ)

  have hP : ∀ n, P n := by
    intro n
    refine Nat.strong_induction_on n ?_
    intro n IHn Q _ _ _ hcard σ _

    have IH :
        ∀ (Q' : Type u) [Group Q'] [Finite Q'] [Group.IsNilpotent Q'],
          Nat.card Q' < Nat.card Q →
          ∀ (σ' : FDRep k Q'), [Simple σ'] →
            ∃ (H : Subgroup Q') (ψ : H →* kˣ),
              Nonempty (σ' ≅ FDRep.indLin H ψ) := by
      intro Q' _ _ _ hlt σ' _
      have hlt_n : Nat.card Q' < n := by
        simpa [hcard] using hlt
      exact (IHn (Nat.card Q') hlt_n) Q' rfl σ'

    
    by_cases hcomm : IsMulCommutative Q
    · obtain ⟨ψ, hρ⟩ :=
        FDRep.simple_of_commGroup_iso_indLin_top
          (G := Q) (k := k) σ
      exact ⟨⊤, ψ, hρ⟩

    by_cases hKne : FDRep.centralKernel σ ≠ ⊥
    · exact
        exists_indLin_of_centralKernel_ne_bot
          (ρ := σ) hKne IH

    have hKbot : FDRep.centralKernel σ = ⊥ := by
      by_contra h
      exact hKne h

    obtain ⟨A, hA_normal, hA_comm, hA_gt⟩ :=
      Group.exists_normal_abelian_gt_center
        (G := Q) hcomm

    haveI : A.Normal := hA_normal
    haveI : IsMulCommutative A := hA_comm

    obtain ⟨ψ, hW, τ, hτ_simple, hσ_ind⟩ :=
      LinearChar.exists_induced_from_normal_abelian
        (ρ := σ) A

    haveI : Simple τ := hτ_simple

    have hI_ne_top :
        LinearChar.inertia ψ ≠ ⊤ := by
      exact
        LinearChar.inertia_ne_top_of_centralKernel_eq_bot
          (ρ := σ) (hck := hKbot) (A := A)
          hA_gt ψ hW

    have hcardI :
        Nat.card (LinearChar.inertia ψ) < Nat.card Q :=
      Subgroup.natCard_lt_natCard_of_ne_top
        (LinearChar.inertia ψ) hI_ne_top

    obtain ⟨H, θ, hτ_lin⟩ :=
      IH (LinearChar.inertia ψ) hcardI τ

    rcases hσ_ind with ⟨eσ⟩
    rcases hτ_lin with ⟨eτ⟩

    let I : Subgroup Q := LinearChar.inertia ψ

    let eτ_ind :
        FDRep.ind I τ ≅ FDRep.ind I (FDRep.indLin H θ) :=
      (FDRep.indHomFunctor
        (k := k)
        (G := I)
        (H := Q)
        I.subtype).mapIso eτ

    let HG : Subgroup Q := H.map I.subtype
    let eH : H ≃* HG :=
      H.equivMapOfInjective I.subtype Subtype.coe_injective
    let θG : HG →* kˣ :=
      θ.comp eH.symm.toMonoidHom

    let estage :
        FDRep.ind I (FDRep.indLin H θ) ≅
          FDRep.indLin HG θG :=
      FDRep.indLin_trans
        (I := I) (H := H) θ

    refine ⟨HG, θG, ?_⟩
    exact ⟨eσ ≪≫ eτ_ind ≪≫ estage⟩

  exact (hP (Nat.card G)) G rfl ρ

name: FDRep.indLin_character
statement:
lemma indLin_character
    [Fintype G] [CharZero k]
    (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    (FDRep.indLin H ψ).character g =
      (Fintype.card H : k)⁻¹ * ∑ x : G,
        if h : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H then
          (ψ ⟨x * g * x⁻¹, h⟩ : k)
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  change
    (FDRep.ind H (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ)).character g
      =
    (Fintype.card H : k)⁻¹ * ∑ x : G,
      if h : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H then
        (ψ ⟨x * g * x⁻¹, h⟩ : k)
      else 0

  simpa only [FDRep.char_ofLinearChar, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card] using
    (FDRep.char_ind_as_avg_mul_inv
      (I := H)
      (σ := FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ)
      (g := g))

name: FDRep.char_indLin_eq_char_coindLin
statement:
lemma char_indLin_eq_char_coindLin
    (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    (FDRep.indLin H ψ).character =
      (FDRep.coindLin H ψ).character
proof:
:= by
  exact FDRep.char_eq_of_iso
    (FDRep.indLinCoindLinIso H ψ)

name: FDRep.coindLin_character
statement:
lemma coindLin_character [Fintype G] [CharZero k]
    (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ) (g : G) :
    (FDRep.coindLin H ψ).character g =
      (Fintype.card H : k)⁻¹ * ∑ x : G,
        if h : x * g * x⁻¹ ∈ H then
          (ψ ⟨x * g * x⁻¹, h⟩ : k)
        else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← congrFun (FDRep.char_indLin_eq_char_coindLin H ψ) g]
  exact FDRep.indLin_character H ψ g

name: ClassFun.character_indLin
statement:
lemma character_indLin
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    ClassFun.character (FDRep.indLin (G := G) H ψ) =
      ClassFun.ind (G := G) (k := k) H
        (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ))
proof:
:= by
  change
    ClassFun.character
      (FDRep.ind (G := G) H
        (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ))
      =
    ClassFun.ind (G := G) H
      (ClassFun.character (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ))
  exact ClassFun.char_ind (G := G) H (FDRep.ofLinearChar ψ)

name: FDRep.coindLin_ρ_apply
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coindLin_ρ_apply (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ)
    (g : G) (v : (FDRep.coindLin H ψ)) (x : G) :
    ((FDRep.coindLin H ψ).ρ g v).1 x = v.1 (x * g)
proof: := rfl

name: FDRep.indLin_eq_of_rep_ind
statement:
theorem indLin_eq_of_rep_ind
    {G k : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G] [Field k]
    (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    FDRep.indLin (k := k) (G := G) H ψ =
      (let A : Rep k H :=
          (CategoryTheory.forget₂ (FDRep k H) (Rep k H)).obj
            (FDRep.ofLinearChar (k := k) ψ)
       let τind : Rep k G := Rep.ind H.subtype A
       have h_fin_τ : Module.Finite k τind.V := by
         letI : Fintype G := Fintype.ofFinite G
         haveI : Module.Finite k A.V := by
           change Module.Finite k (FDRep.ofLinearChar (k := k) ψ)
           infer_instance
         exact Module.Finite.of_surjective
           (Representation.Coinvariants.mk _) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
       haveI : Module.Finite k τind.V := h_fin_τ
       FDRep.of τind.ρ)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: FDRep.nonempty_iso_indLin_iff_coindLin
statement:
lemma nonempty_iso_indLin_iff_coindLin
    (ρ : FDRep k G) (H : Subgroup G) (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.indLin (k := k) (G := G) H ψ) ↔
    Nonempty (ρ ≅ FDRep.coindLin (k := k) (G := G) H ψ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact ⟨i ≪≫ FDRep.indLinCoindLinIso (k := k) (G := G) H ψ⟩
  · rintro ⟨i⟩
    exact ⟨i ≪≫ (FDRep.indLinCoindLinIso (k := k) (G := G) H ψ).symm⟩

name: FDRep.finrank_indLin_rightRel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem finrank_indLin_rightRel
    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    {G : Type u} [Group G] [Finite G]
    (H : Subgroup G)
    (ψ : H →* kˣ) :
    (FDRep.indLin H ψ).finrank =
      Nat.card (Quotient (QuotientGroup.rightRel H))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  dsimp [FDRep.indLin]
  rw [FDRep.finrank_ind_rightRel]
  simp only [finrank_ofLinearChar, mul_one]

name: Int.pow_totient_primePow_modEq_one
statement:
lemma pow_totient_primePow_modEq_one
    (p r : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] {m : ℤ}
    (hm : ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ m) :
    m ^ (p ^ r).totient ≡ 1 [ZMOD ((p ^ r : ℕ) : ℤ)]
proof:
:= by
  have hp_not_dvd : ¬ p ∣ m.natAbs := by
    intro h
    exact hm (Int.ofNat_dvd_left.mpr h)
  have hcopNat : m.natAbs.Coprime (p ^ r) := by
    have hcop : m.natAbs.Coprime p :=
      ((Nat.Prime.coprime_iff_not_dvd
        (Fact.out : Nat.Prime p)).2 hp_not_dvd).symm
    simpa using hcop.pow 1 r
  have hcopInt : IsCoprime m (((p ^ r : ℕ) : ℤ)) := by
    rw [Int.isCoprime_iff_nat_coprime]
    simpa using hcopNat
  let z : (ZMod (p ^ r))ˣ :=
    ZMod.unitOfIsCoprime m hcopInt
  have hz := ZMod.pow_totient z
  apply
    (ZMod.intCast_eq_intCast_iff
      (m ^ (p ^ r).totient) 1 (p ^ r)).mp
  simp only [Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_one]
  have hz' :=
    congrArg
      (fun a : (ZMod (p ^ r))ˣ =>
        (a : ZMod (p ^ r))) hz
  change
    (z : ZMod (p ^ r)) ^ (p ^ r).totient = 1
    at hz'
  simpa only [z, ZMod.unitOfIsCoprime] using hz'

name: Int.eq_zero_of_forall_two_pow_dvd
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_forall_two_pow_dvd
    {z : ℤ}
    (h : ∀ N : ℕ, (2 : ℤ) ^ N ∣ z) :
    z = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hz
  have hz_pos : 0 < z.natAbs := Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hz
  have hdvd : (2 : ℕ) ^ z.natAbs ∣ z.natAbs :=
    ofNat_dvd_left.mp (h z.natAbs)
  have hle : (2 : ℕ) ^ z.natAbs ≤ z.natAbs :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd hz_pos hdvd
  have hlt : z.natAbs < (2 : ℕ) ^ z.natAbs :=
    Nat.lt_two_pow_self
  grind only

name: ZMod.eq_zero_of_primePow_smul
statement:
lemma eq_zero_of_primePow_smul
    (p e : ℕ)
    {x : ZMod (p ^ e)}
    (h : ∃ y : ZMod (p ^ e),
      (((p ^ e : ℕ) : ℤ) • y) = x) :
    x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, rfl⟩ := h
  simp only [Nat.cast_pow, zsmul_eq_mul, Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_natCast]
  rw [← Nat.cast_pow]
  simp only [CharP.cast_eq_zero, zero_mul]

name: AddCommGroup.eq_zero_of_forall_primePow_smul
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_forall_primePow_smul
    {M : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module.Finite ℤ M]
    {x : M}
    (h :
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
        ∀ N : ℕ,
          ∃ y : M,
            (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • y) = x) :
        x = 0
proof:
:= by
  letI : AddGroup.FG M :=
    (Module.Finite.iff_addGroup_fg).mp
      (inferInstance : Module.Finite ℤ M)
  obtain ⟨n, ι, instι, p, hp, e, ⟨E⟩⟩ :=
    AddCommGroup.equiv_free_prod_directSum_zmod M
  apply E.injective
  rw [map_zero]
  apply Prod.ext
  · ext i
    apply Int.eq_zero_of_forall_two_pow_dvd
    intro N
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h 2 Nat.prime_two N
    refine ⟨(E y).1 i, ?_⟩
    have hy' :
        (((2 ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • (E y).1 i) =
          (E x).1 i := by
      simpa using congrArg (fun z => (E z).1 i) hy
    calc
      (E x).1 i
          = (((2 ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • (E y).1 i) :=
            hy'.symm
      _ = (2 : ℤ) ^ N * (E y).1 i := by
            simp only [zsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat]
            simp only [Int.cast_pow, Int.cast_ofNat]

  · apply DFinsupp.ext
    intro i
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h (p i) (hp i) (e i)
    let n : ℤ := (p i ^ e i : ℕ)

    have hyE : n • E y = E x := by
      rw [← map_zsmul]
      exact congrArg E hy

    have hy2 : n • (E y).2 = (E x).2 := by
      exact congrArg Prod.snd hyE

    have hcoord : n • (E y).2 i = (E x).2 i := congrArg (fun z => z i) hy2
    exact
      ZMod.eq_zero_of_primePow_smul
        (p i) (e i) ⟨(E y).2 i, hcoord⟩

name: Submodule.mem_of_forall_primePow_congr
statement:
theorem mem_of_forall_primePow_congr
    {L : Type u} [AddCommGroup L]
    [Module.Finite ℤ L]
    (A : Submodule ℤ L)
    {x : L}
    (h :
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
        ∀ N : ℕ,
          ∃ y : L,
            x - (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • y) ∈ A) :
    x ∈ A
proof:
:= by
  have hcofg : A.CoFG :=
    Submodule.CoFG.of_finite
      (R := ℤ) (M := L) (S := A)
  letI : AddGroup.FG (L ⧸ A) :=
    (Module.Finite.iff_addGroup_fg).mp hcofg
  have hquot :
      ∀ p : ℕ, p.Prime →
        ∀ N : ℕ,
          ∃ y : L ⧸ A,
            (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • y) =
              Submodule.Quotient.mk x := by
    intro p hp N
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := h p hp N
    refine ⟨Submodule.Quotient.mk y, ?_⟩
    have hz :
        Submodule.Quotient.mk
            (x - (((p ^ N : ℕ) : ℤ) • y)) = (0 : L ⧸ A) :=
      (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).2 hy
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz).symm
  have hzero :
      Submodule.Quotient.mk x = (0 : L ⧸ A) :=
    AddCommGroup.eq_zero_of_forall_primePow_smul hquot

  exact (Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero A).1 hzero

name: ClassFun.characterSpan.character_mem
statement:
lemma character_mem
    (V : FDRep k G) :
    ClassFun.character V ∈ characterSpan k G
proof:
:=
  Submodule.subset_span ⟨V, rfl⟩

name: ClassFun.characterSpan.one_mem
statement:
lemma one_mem :
    (1 : ClassFun k G) ∈ characterSpan k G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← ClassFun.char_trivial (k := k) (G := G)]
  exact character_mem (FDRep.trivial k G)

name: ClassFun.characterSpan.character_mul_mem
statement:
lemma character_mul_mem
    (V : FDRep k G)
    {f : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ characterSpan k G) :
    ClassFun.character V * f ∈ characterSpan k G
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ =>
      ClassFun.character V * f ∈ characterSpan k G)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hf
  · rintro _ ⟨W, rfl⟩
    rw [← ClassFun.char_tensor]
    exact character_mem (FDRep.tensor V W)
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [mul_add]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro n x _ hx
    rw [mul_smul_comm]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx

name: ClassFun.characterSpan.mul_mem
statement:
lemma mul_mem
    {f g : ClassFun k G}
    (hf : f ∈ characterSpan k G)
    (hg : g ∈ characterSpan k G) :
    f * g ∈ characterSpan k G
proof:
:= by
  refine Submodule.span_induction
    (p := fun f _ => f * g ∈ characterSpan k G)
    ?gen ?zero ?add ?smul hf
  · rintro _ ⟨V, rfl⟩
    exact character_mul_mem V hg
  · simp
  · intro x y _ _ hx hy
    rw [add_mul]
    exact Submodule.add_mem _ hx hy
  · intro n x _ hx
    rw [smul_mul_assoc]
    exact Submodule.smul_mem _ n hx

name: ClassFun.CharacterRing.mem_iff
statement:
@[simp]
lemma mem_iff
    {f : ClassFun k G} :
    f ∈ CharacterRing k G ↔ f ∈ characterSpan k G

:=

name: ClassFun.CharacterRing.coe_character
statement:
@[simp]
lemma coe_character
    (V : FDRep k G) :

name: ClassFun.CharacterRing.character_trivial

name: ClassFun.char_one

name: ClassFun.char_eq_of_iso

name: ClassFun.char_trivial
statement:
@[simp]
lemma char_trivial

name: ClassFun.char_prod

name: ClassFun.char_tensor
statement:
@[simp]
theorem char_tensor
    (V W : FDRep k G) :

    ClassFun.character V * ClassFun.character W
proof:

name: ClassFun.char_dual
statement:

    ClassFun.character (V.dual) = ClassFun.involution (ClassFun.character V)
proof:
